It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

AI.tldr: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源的本地化 AI 科研助手，研究者自带模型访问权限，应用提供运行环境、科研脚手架与完整记录，并通过"观测式日志"应对模型过度声称问题，在 20 个跨学科研究提示上于科学质量与研究执行两方面领先两个托管平台。
AI.motivation: 现有聊天助手与通用编码智能体缺乏科研领域支撑，无法保证研究过程可追溯、结果可复现；尤其模型的"过度声称"（overclaiming）是最常见失败模式，而单纯防止无法根治，故需让声明可被核查。同时研究者需要数据、代码与记录保留在自有机器上、多年后仍可读取。论文动机为针对上述缺陷设计一款在研究者自管环境中运行、带有科研脚手架与不可篡改记录的开源助手。
AI.method: K-Dense BYOK 在研究者本机运行，采用 BYOK（bring your own keys）模式，模型可托管或本地部署。其方法有三项关键区别：一是内置科学程序库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录，以及可转交工作的审稿人与写作者角色；二是维护"Living Lab Notebook"，条目链式构成论证且只增不删；三是通过观察智能体行为而非采信其自述来记录过程，日志对智能体只读、无写入工具。项目以普通文件夹形式组织，数据、代码、结果与记录均存于研究者管理的机器上。
AI.result: 在 20 个跨学科研究提示、按预先固定评分标准评估下，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均优于两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现结果命令的。其中一个托管平台运行相同前沿模型，却既未提供软件记录也未提供复现命令。环境记录系智能体所写文件，而非观测日志的一部分，当前日志尚未捕获软件环境本身。
AI.conclusion: K-Dense BYOK 通过本地运行、科研脚手架与"观测式"只增日志，将模型过度声称转向可核查，在跨学科研究任务上优于托管平台，并保留可长期读取的完整记录。其局限在于环境记录仍由智能体生成、非观测日志内容，日志尚未覆盖软件环境本身。代码以 MIT 许可证开源。

title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
summary: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑图像反事实探针（Verdict Grounding Score）对多模态模型评判者的视觉接地评估，指出该分数受编辑可感知性上限约束且存在单侧偏误，会导致误报；作者证明该缺失量可由同一审计协议中的三个量识别，并实测九个评判者验证其预测排序。
AI.motivation: 模型评判者（model judges）已大规模用于监督多模态系统，其可靠性依赖于是否真正利用图像证据。现有做法用图像反事实探针来检验视觉接地（visual grounding），但这种探针本身很少被审视，可能把可用的监督者误判为不接地，造成误报。作者因此系统性地追问：该探针是否真的测量了它声称测量的东西。
AI.method: 形式化定义 Verdict Grounding Score：编辑图像使 ground truth 翻转、固定推理链，观察裁决是否随之改变。分析表明一个裁决只对"到达评判者决策相关读取"的编辑作出响应，故分数被编辑可感知性所封顶；除非编辑使属性更易读取，否则误差是单侧的，只会让评判者显得比实际更不接地。随后在明确假设下证明该缺失量可由同一审计协议已采集的三个量识别（identify）。对九个评判者进行实证审计。
AI.result: 预测的排序在全部主用池中严格成立；典型评判者仅对约一半其本可分辨属性的编辑作出反应。采用保守拒绝阈值可直接判定若干 cell 为误报，最明显者是一个几乎每次都能检测到注入错误的评判者，其分数却显示它完全未使用图像。检测探针（在未编辑图像上）可给反事实分数提供上界。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧反事实分数不应单独报告：应在未编辑图像上运行检测探针，它对反事实分数构成上界、可认证其误报，且不增加额外成本。

title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

AI.tldr: LiteReality-Agent 将室内3D重建建模为编码问题，通过编码智能体迭代编辑 Room.py 生成仿真就绪的数字孪生，性能优于 Astra 和 Fable 等前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 从 RGB-D 扫描重建真实室内环境为带铰接结构、可仿真的 3D 场景具有重要价值，但现有方法在几何精度、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性上仍不足。作者希望构建一个实用、鲁棒的 real-to-sim 系统，并为未来智能体提供可扩展的编排框架。
AI.method: 核心思路是把 3D 重建形式化为编码问题：编码智能体借助专用工具收集证据，迭代编辑可执行的 Python 脚本 Room.py，从而生成房间的数字孪生。系统设计了 observe-edit-verify 闭环框架，涵盖证据收集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真就绪和质检等环节。
AI.result: LiteReality-Agent 生成的 reconstruction 在几何精度、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性上均优于近期前沿模型 Astra 与 Fable，可支持下游具身 AI 任务。源代码与数据采集应用已公开。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为 LiteReality-Agent 是稳健 real-to-sim 系统的重要实用构建模块；随着智能体能力提升，其专用工具、结构化工作流和验证机制仍是未来智能体的强有力编排框架。

title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
summary: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了 RLVR 训练数据中"正确答案为真实语料、干扰项为合成文本"这一来源不对称性是否被策略利用。在 GooseReason-0.7M 上，仅用五个表层统计量的分类器 AUROC 仅 0.562，接近随机；代码域甚至低至 0.416，因干扰项实为单算子变异。进一步的干预实验显示，可检测的伪影并未被利用（0.021 vs 0.027），二者出现分离。
AI.motivation: 近期若干 RLVR 数据构建流程通过遮蔽真实语料片段并要求语言模型围绕其生成看似合理的错误答案，导致正确答案是人类真实文本、干扰项均为合成文本，正确性与来源被纠缠在一起。策略原则上可能学到"来源"而非"正确性"，作者希望检验这种可能性是否真实存在。
AI.method: 以 GooseReason-0.7M 为审计对象。(1) 可见性检验：构建仅读取五个表层统计特征、不看语义的分类器，在 315,499 个选项上评估 AUROC。(2) 人工检查解释代码域反常现象。(3) 干预实验：构造释义匹配的对照语料，固定训练集规模与预算，训练两个策略进行对比。
AI.result: 分类器整体 AUROC 为 0.562，仅略高于随机；代码域为 0.416，低于随机，人工检查表明代码干扰项是金标答案的单算子变异，两类在构造上近乎一致。干预实验中，未被利用的伪影并未给未修改数据臂带来优势：未修改数据臂 0.021，对照臂 0.027。
AI.conclusion: 在给定预算下，可检测的来源伪影并未被策略利用，呈现"可检测"与"被利用"之间的分离；同时给出域特定的构造发现（代码干扰项为单算子变异）。这些发现对同类语料的构建者具有参考价值，并以主要仅需 CPU 的协议形式发布审计方案。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 在503个职业专属AGENTS.md档案与5种提示条件下、覆盖9个科学基准及生物信息学工具任务，加载完整职业档案未带来一致准确率提升，却使输出token增加1.5–2.3倍、单次成功调用成本增加2.2–4.5倍。
AI.motivation: 职业专属系统提示被广泛默认使用，但其token成本与准确率收益之间是否存在正向权衡缺乏系统性证据，作者希望检验"详细职业档案是否值得默认加载"。
AI.method: 发布Scientific Agents开源语料（503个职业专属AGENTS.md档案）；以Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter在Pi agent harness中运行。设置4类对照：最小基线、档案开篇角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域档案。在9个文本类科学基准（抽样4,531题、匹配100个档案）上进行五条件配对实验，经API错误重试后完成4,488项，采用自动化规则评分；另在60个需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上各运行3次。
AI.result: 档案与基线的平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无任一基准呈统计显著提升。档案条件下输出token为1.5–2.3倍，单次成功调用成本为2.2–4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上档案组平均求解率46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主因是档案条件下更频繁触发token与时间限制停止。意外发现：SuperGPQA上频繁的供应商API中断使短基线仅有54.0%的条目首轮答案正确，而档案组为71.6%；通用与错配提示表现相近，说明该优势源于提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。
AI.conclusion: 在所用模型与任务下，默认加载完整职业档案不提升准确率且显著增加成本；档案的部分片段选择性检索、或开放式科学任务能否改变该结论，尚待后续验证。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
summary: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个面向地空无人机检测的雾强度可控基准，在Anti-UAV300数据集RGB模态上合成十级雾，发现YOLOv5m检测性能随雾浓度呈前重式非线性急剧下降，且雾感知训练可提升各级雾下性能但无法避免极端雾下的崩溃。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的反无人机系统需在低能见度下工作，但现有基准多采用晴天数据，且以往鲁棒性研究仅将恶劣天气简化为"有/无"二值条件，导致雾浓度对地空无人机检测的影响认识不足。
AI.method: 在Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态上合成十级雾，形成首个强度可控的雾基准；将仅用清晰图像训练的YOLOv5m基线，与在清晰+雾图像上训练的雾感知模型进行对比评测。
AI.result: 性能下降剧烈且非线性：退化集中出现在轻至中度雾（beta约0.05–0.10）阶段；从清晰到最浓雾，mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%，主因是召回率与置信度损失；在mAP@0.5上，该崩溃超过同类基准中最极端的雨退化；雾感知训练可在各雾级提升检测（最多+0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），清晰场景精度仅降9.1%，提高了可靠检测阈值，但未能阻止极端雾下的崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性在很窄的能见度范围内即丧失，简单的清晰与恶劣天气二分测试会低估实际运行风险，需采用强度可控的连续分级评测。

title: MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk, a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key-value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench, a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MosaiChunk——一种时空记忆机制，通过在固定记忆预算下选择性地组合历史 KV 条目构成"马赛克"，缓解长时程自回归视频生成中物体/场景出帧后细节丢失、重现难以恢复的问题；同时提出 RememBench 基准，实验表明其在 T2V 和 I2V 设置下均优于滑窗推理与整块检索。
AI.motivation: 长时程自回归视频生成受限于有限的上下文窗口。当物体或场景离开上下文后，其细粒度视觉细节会丢失，且再次出现时难以恢复。因此需要一种机制在有限记忆预算下持续保留对历史视觉细节的访问能力。
AI.method: 作者基于"冻结的视频生成器可直接消费非连续历史 KV 并恢复对应视觉内容"这一观察，设计 MosaiChunk：在空间与时间维度上对选定的历史 KV 条目进行马赛克式组合。生成器保持固定，仅学习一个轻量级路由器，在固定活跃记忆预算下决定将哪些历史片段纳入马赛克。此外构建了 RememBench 基准，包含提示驱动的 T2V 与相机驱动的 I2V 两个重逢（revisit）评测分支。
AI.result: 实验显示，在记忆预算相匹配的条件下，MosaiChunk 在 T2V 与 I2V 两种设置下，重现一致性（revisit consistency）均持续优于滑窗推理（sliding-window inference）和整块检索（whole-chunk retrieval）。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结生成器、仅学习轻量路由来选择非连续历史 KV 构成时空马赛克，可在固定记忆预算下有效提升长时程视频生成的重现一致性，为长时程自回归视频生成提供了一种可行且高效的记忆方案。

title: A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Proceedings of BigScience Episode #5 -- Workshop on Challenges & Perspectives in Creating Large Language Models (ACL 2022)
summary: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

AI.tldr: 本文对极端规模阿拉伯语语言模型 Noor（最高 13B 参数）进行了全生命周期碳足迹的 holistic 评估，涵盖数据收集与存储、研发、预训练、未来推理服务及跨国合作的外生成本，发现推理成本与外生因素对总碳预算影响显著，并提出了减排路径。
AI.motivation: 随着超大语言模型日益普及，其环境代价不容忽视。现有机器学习论文的碳排放报告通常仅局限于训练阶段所用的算力资源，忽略了数据采集存储、研发、推理服务以及跨国合作等环节，导致对模型真实碳足迹的低估。因此需要一个覆盖全项目的整体性碳评估框架。
AI.method: 以极端规模多任务阿拉伯语模型 Noor（参数规模最高 13B，借助零样本泛化与自然语言指令支持下游任务）为对象，构建全生命周期碳核算框架：从数据收集与存储成本入手，纳入研发预算、预训练开销、未来服务（推理）估算以及国际协作所需的外生成本，对项目整体碳账单进行 holistic 评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，推理成本与外生因素对模型总碳预算具有显著影响，其占比不可忽略；仅统计训练算力的传统做法会明显低估实际碳足迹。
AI.conclusion: 对极端规模语言模型的碳评估应采用全项目、全生命周期的视角，而非仅聚焦训练算力；论文进一步讨论了降低此类模型碳足迹的可能路径。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨对话幽默中语言模型训练的自动奖励机制，揭示两类奖励（惊喜嵌入奖励与观众笑点预测）均存在被利用的捷径，并测试相应防御措施与三轮强化学习训练的最终效果。
AI.motivation: 自动奖励设计在对话幽默训练中易被模型钻空子（reward exploits）。作者希望识别这些可利用的捷径（如词序打乱、笑声线索），并探索在不牺牲目标行为（真正的幽默）的前提下加以阻断的对策。
AI.method: 研究两类奖励：一是旨在捕捉可理解惊喜的嵌入式惊喜奖励，二是预测观众娱乐度的观众模型。通过受控测试检验其脆弱性，并引入防御手段——对惊喜奖励加入流畅性过滤器，对观众模型进行跨说话人归一化，以屏蔽笑声线索；随后进行三轮强化学习训练，采用逐步修订的奖励。
AI.result: 嵌入式惊喜奖励会把词序打乱的回复与机智回复等同接受；流畅性过滤器虽能检测打乱，但组合奖励会误拒部分机智回复且未能通过进一步验证。观众模型则易受任一说话人消息中的笑声线索影响；跨说话人归一化可阻断已覆盖的攻击，但未被匹配的表达仍可被利用。最终一轮训练使综合评估分提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升仍低于预注册目标。
AI.conclusion: 自动奖励设计面临一个普遍挑战：对策必须在阻断可利用捷径的同时，保留奖励原本意图鼓励的行为，二者难以兼顾。

title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出GPEC（高斯过程嵌入校正），一种模块化、低开销的预LLM误差校正方法，插入视觉投影层与语言模型之间，以提升VideoChat2在超声心动图视频描述生成中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解与描述生成上表现优异，但在超声心动图等专业医学影像领域性能下降。现有改进通常依赖端到端微调预训练多模态骨干，代价高。因此需要一种无需微调骨干即可改善视觉表征的轻量校正方案。
AI.method: GPEC位于视觉投影层与语言模型之间，学习一个残差校正，将投影后的视觉表征推向"标注引导"的目标。目标构建流程：将结构化视频标注转为定性属性→生成固定格式参考描述→映射到语言模型嵌入空间。校正模型采用带诱导点的稀疏变分高斯过程，结合自然参数变分更新与块状线性核；原VideoChat2各组件保持冻结。
AI.result: 在与原VideoChat2完全相同的输入与参考条件下，从表征级、描述级、内容导向和执行时间四类指标进行对比评估。结果显示，加入GPEC后描述相似度与内容对齐度均有提升，且每段视频的推理时间开销增加不足0.05秒。
AI.conclusion: GPEC能够在无需端到端微调预训练多模态骨干的前提下，以极低计算成本改善专业医学视频领域的描述生成质量，为医学影像领域的MLLM适配提供了一种模块化、高效的误差校正思路。

title: CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search
summary: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CAVE-Mem，将经验表示为带适用、边界与效用条件的类型化干预算子，仅在算子与当前基底、答案契约、证据边界匹配且交叉拟合效用达标时才修改基础答案，否则弃权。
AI.motivation: 现有经验记忆系统主要以相关性为标准，检索与当前状态相似的过往检索经验并注入提示，但忽略记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界的变化，导致相关经验仍可能有害。
AI.method: CAVE-Mem先获取基础记忆检索答案，再将经验表征为类型化干预算子，附带适用条件、边界条件和效用条件；仅当算子与当前基底、答案契约、证据边界匹配，且通过交叉拟合效用评估时，才允许其修改基础答案，否则系统弃权。
AI.result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答和长文档叙事推理任务上，相比仅依赖相关性的经验复用方法取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 经验复用应从相关性驱动转向条件化干预：通过适用性、边界与效用约束的算子式经验表示与弃权机制，可有效避免有害经验注入，提升长期记忆智能体的稳健性与准确性。

title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
summary: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

AI.tldr: EviGraph区分"关键决策需求"与"可搁置信息"，通过语言智能体在时序知识图谱中链接证据、确定性检查器判定推荐是否成立，从而减少公共服务推荐中的不必要弃答。
AI.motivation: 公共服务推荐需与服务、范围、日期匹配的证据，但把每个缺失细节都视为决定性条件会导致过度弃答，牺牲可用推荐。
AI.method: EviGraph：语言智能体将关键决策需求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，确定性检查器判定推荐是否有证据支持。
AI.result: 在带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上，该区分降低了不必要弃答；但额外验证会撤回本已受支持的推荐，且未提升决策质量。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的循证导航依赖明确"决策必须确立什么"，而非单纯增加验证步骤。

title: Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding
summary: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将视觉token压缩从"选择保留/丢弃"问题重新定义为"速率分配"问题，采用变换编码思路，通过整数速率-失真优化在固定比特预算下为每个token分配不同码率，生成与查询无关的压缩表示。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法几乎完全把问题当作选择问题（保留哪些token、丢弃其余），最优准则依赖语言模型对token的注意力，因此排序是所提问题的函数。这在单轮基准中不可见，但在压缩表示被写入一次、多次读取时（如跨对话轮次缓存、设备-服务器传输）就成为决定性问题。作者希望摆脱这种查询依赖性。
AI.method: 采用变换编码工具包的另一半：保留所有token，只改变其码率（rate）。变换编码为每个token暴露测得的失真-码率（distortion-rate）曲线，然后在固定比特预算下，通过在这些曲线上进行精确的整数速率-失真优化来分配比特。整个流程不引入任何文本，因此一个压缩表示可服务任意查询。
AI.result: 在相同比特预算下，于两个数据集和两种模型容量上，该方法在保持模型输出分布和答案方面均优于均匀码率编码、闭式注水（water-fill）以及按失真排序的剪枝。在与剪枝所针对的同一问题上，其表现与注意力排序剪枝相当；而当压缩图像需要回答关于同一图像的另一个问题时，则超越注意力排序剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉token压缩视为速率分配而非token选择，可得到查询无关的压缩表示，在跨查询复用场景下优于依赖问题的注意力排序方法，验证了变换编码思路在视觉-语言模型token压缩中的有效性。

title: Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing
summary: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带符号词汇门控（signed lexical gate）评分，将句分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持/反对证据结合，用于选择性意图路由，在三个意图数据集上降低风险-覆盖率曲线面积并提升可接受覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 选择性意图路由需要在可靠预测时执行、对不确定请求延迟处理，而标准置信度主要反映基座模型表示，未能利用互补证据。
AI.method: 带符号词汇门控：将句分类器logit margin与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持结合，正向证据来自词汇一致、负向证据来自词汇偏好的竞争意图；再由独立二项校准阶段按指定风险目标选取操作阈值。
AI.result: 在BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64各十次运行中，风险-覆盖率曲线AUC相对仅语义门控分别降低15.8%、15.1%、11.8%；5%误差目标下BANKING77与HWU64可接受覆盖率提升1.83与5.14个百分点；2%目标下30种组合均得到非空策略；匹配对照显示该特征优于无符号词汇置信度特征。
AI.conclusion: 该双特征门控为风险校准的意图路由提供紧凑、可解释的置信度增强，同时保持基分类器预测不变。

title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Data paper. Dataset openly available at https://zenodo.org/records/20451474. Under review at the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
summary: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模自然语言-SPARQL 基准，通过图谱遍历代码生成并验证 SPARQL、由大模型仅生成自然语言问题，覆盖 201 个建筑 KG，产出 6,136 条可执行查询与 30,680 个问题。
AI.motivation: 建筑自动化系统日益以语义知识图谱（如 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 本体）表示，文本到 SPARQL（text-to-SPARQL）可让运营者用自然语言查询图谱，但缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL 基准，制约了该方向的研究进展。
AI.method: 采用基于知识图谱的流水线构建基准：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性独立于模型行为。流水线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并对每个查询以五种词汇语域进行表述。应用于 201 个建筑 KG（180 个 Brick、21 个 ASHRAE 223P）。
AI.result: 共产出 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询与 30,680 个问题。对 300 个问题开展双标注者人工验证，语义保真度 98.8%、自然度 98.8%、操作合理性 84.0%。在三个开放权重语言模型上的检索增强评测中，精确匹配准确率由零样本的 0.2-20% 提升至三样本检索的 56-65%。
AI.conclusion: Build2SPARQL 以图谱驱动的生成方式规避了 LLM 生成查询带来的正确性风险，提供了大规模、可执行、经人工验证的建筑 KG 文本到 SPARQL 基准，并表明检索增强能显著提升开放权重模型在该任务上的表现。

title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MRFFU-Net，一种集成多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）模块的新型深度学习架构，用于MRI中不同解剖结构的分割，并在脑脊液和左心房两个公开数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: MRI数据中解剖结构具有不规则边界及形状、对比度和尺度上的变化，而U-Net等现有深度学习架构在分割时难以同时保留细粒度细节和全局上下文信息，因此需要一种能兼顾两者的架构。
AI.method: 提出MRFFU-Net架构，其核心是可便捷集成到任意U-Net类架构中的多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）模块。MRFF被嵌入编码器-解码器结构的每一层，并结合注意力机制与跳跃连接，以提取多分辨率特征，从而捕获细粒度细节和全局上下文信息。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准MRI数据集上进行评估：脊柱MR扫描中的脑脊液（CSF）分割，以及医学分割十项全能（MSD）挑战赛中的左心房心脏分割。实验结果表明，MRFFU-Net在多项评价指标上均优于当前最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: MRFFU-Net在不同解剖结构的MRI分割任务中均表现出优越性能，验证了多分辨率特征融合模块在MRI分割中的有效性。

title: Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning
summary: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控实验评估LLM中token级certainty的预测能力，区分“预测模型能否答对问题”与“区分同题回答对错”两类目标，并据此设计test-time compute策略提升精度、降低成本。
AI.motivation: certainty常被当作correctness的代理指标，但其效果既取决于certainty分数所含信息，也取决于使用方式；现有研究缺乏对certainty预测能力的直接、受控评估。
AI.method: 跨模型、跨任务进行受控实证评估，区分两类预测目标：识别模型更可能答对的问题、区分同一问题的正确与错误回答；同时分析certainty在token类型、词内位置、生成阶段上的系统性变化。
AI.result: certainty在识别“模型可能答对的问题”上普遍优于区分“同题回答对错”；question difficulty信息在生成早期出现，answer correctness信息较弱且集中在末期；据此设计策略：早期用certainty分配回答数量，末期用certainty加权投票。
AI.conclusion: certainty提供的信息价值取决于预测目标、模型、certainty指标及聚合时纳入的token位置；基于该发现的test-time compute策略将整体准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%，同时减少82.4%的生成token成本。

title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
summary: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

AI.tldr: 在受约束信号传递博弈中加入知情对手后，最优信号恰好与既有研究中的"显著性极"重合；二者仅在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义的条目上分歧，这构成实证评估的结构性限制。
AI.motivation: 既有研究以贝叶斯后验最大化刻画受约束信号传递中的最优信号，但未考虑知情对手共享受众的情形。作者希望探究：当对手能够观察信号并利用说服预算β为主张错误答案辩护时，最优信号是否仍为后验最大化选项。
AI.method: 将对手引入一个源自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》的强迫选择任务。对手知晓目标、观察信号，并以预算β为最强的错误答案进行说服。通过在不同β下求解最优信号，考察最优解从后验最大化向边际最大化的转移，并与既有"显著性极"目标进行对照。同时用两种对手框架测试七个语言模型在108个确认性条目上的选项变化。
AI.result: 在108个确认性条目上，对手稳健最优与既有显著性极完全一致。在200,000条目池中，二者仅在2,748个条目上不同，且恰好位于显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处。当坐标有定义时，稳健性通过完全从贝叶斯判别转向显著性实现。β=0时复现原始oracle模型（听众温度τ=1）；18.2%的条目池在有限预算下最优解发生转移，且每个条目的临界预算可精确计算。两种对手框架使七个语言模型在108个条目中的30至77个上改变选项，超过精确的无效应率。
AI.conclusion: 对手稳健最优与显著性启发式目标在评估条目上重合，导致无法判定模型选项变化究竟指向对手意识还是显著性，这是结构性限制而非零结果。建议在评估对手意识前，先检验稳健目标是否与启发式目标重合。

title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
comment: Submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (Elsevier)
summary: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

AI.tldr: 提出LENS-GRF可解释多阶段痤疮分级框架，融合全局ViT先验与置换不变的病灶集合Transformer及门控残差融合；ACNE04上全自动80.82%、真值病灶95.89%（QWK 0.9753），但在PLSBRACNE01零样本仅35.00%，低于全局基线42.50%，揭示域偏移与标注不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 自动痤疮严重度分级既需要全脸上下文信息，也需要细粒度病灶证据，单一全局模型难以兼顾；同时现有评测可能受数据泄漏、跨数据集域偏移与标注标准不一致影响，需在更严格协议下验证真实泛化能力。
AI.method: LENS-GRF为可解释多阶段四分类框架：结合自适应面部皮肤分割与全局Vision Transformer先验，以及置换不变的Lesion Set Transformer编码局部病灶图块与空间几何；采用Gated Residual Fusion自适应控制局部残差贡献，门控为零时退化为全局预测。实验使用ACNE04与PLSBRACNE01队列，并开展数据完整性审计与三名皮肤科医生的oracle分析。
AI.result: ACNE04上，YOLOv11s全自动LENS-GRF达80.82%准确率；使用真值病灶标注达95.89%±0.59%，QWK 0.9753。数据完整性审计发现15对跨划分重复图像，其中5对严重度标签冲突。PLSBRACNE01全队列（200人、600视图）锁定零样本评估中，自动LENS-GRF为35.00%，低于全局基线42.50%。148人共同队列的oracle分析中，真值病灶输入使最佳oracle准确率升至47.97%，最高oracle QWK为0.5799，医生两两一致率49.32%–66.22%。
AI.conclusion: 方法在标注完备时表现优异，但全自动与跨数据集零样本性能显著下降，甚至低于全局基线；性能瓶颈主要来自检测器域偏移、标注变异性与跨标注标准不匹配，且数据集中存在跨划分重复与标签冲突，提示需更严格的评测协议与更鲁棒的病灶检测及标注对齐。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DSB-DG基准，用于评估语音智能体在外部文档上的落地（grounding）能力，覆盖五大专业领域与三类失效模式，并对级联、专有全双工及开源语音到语音系统进行了系统性评测。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体虽能实现低延迟自然交互，但能否忠实依据外部文档生成回答尚缺乏系统研究，且缺少针对文档落地的评测基准，因此需要构建专门基准以揭示其可靠性瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建DSB-DG基准，覆盖五个专业领域，聚焦三类失效模式：上下文饱和（文档长度增加下的落地表现）、落地衰减（多轮对话中文档事实的保持）与主动落地（上下文重注入是否缓解对话漂移）。基准含来自50份文档的1,636条经对抗性验证的问答对，支持对落地准确率、幻觉与响应延迟的全自动评测，并对比级联、专有全双工/实时及开源speech2speech架构。
AI.result: 不同系统有效落地能力差异显著：级联流水线（ASR-LLM-TTS）落地准确率最高，Gemini-Live与GPT-Realtime紧随其后；开源系统表现出独特失效模式，尤其是上下文容量骤降与多轮落地衰减。总体上，落地保真度随上下文与对话负载增加而下降，且失效多表现为无依据生成而非拒答。
AI.conclusion: 上下文落地是可靠全双工语音智能体的关键未解挑战，DSB-DG为相关评测提供了标准化工具并揭示了现有架构的系统性局限。

title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
summary: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

AI.tldr: 论文研究训练数据中两种"互不兼容但都正确"的标注约定顺序对参数的影响，证明学习率调度是决定顺序效应的平均算子，并将其分解为"排列（块周期）× 调度（端点权重）"两个独立相乘因子。
AI.motivation: 此前预训练中已报告"衰减调度会缓和顺序效应"，但缺乏机制解释、因子分离与受控测量。作者希望回答：数据顺序究竟向参数写入了什么，以及为何精确匹配类基准无法观测到这一效应。
AI.method: 将同一语料以10种顺序、固定预算、除优化路径外全部固定的方式训练；在仅lr_scheduler_type不同的两个调度族（常数与单余弦）下各跑两次；提出一个界，其中排列只作为块周期出现、调度只作为端点对任一时刻可施加的权重出现；并用acc_A+acc_B守恒量与分配份额进行对照测量。
AI.result: 常数速率下内部跨度达分配0.2221、对比下限11.63，且随排列的分块程度单调；单余弦下10条臂仅落入两个可区分状态（其分辨率本可容纳约10个）。跨12条臂acc_A+acc_B在9.7%内保持恒定，而分配份额从0.04变动到0.87，即12.29-sigma的排列切换在约定无关指标下恰为零。在提示中标注约定可消除该切换，并达到并集上限的87.5%。
AI.conclusion: "顺序重要"与"顺序不重要"是同一旋钮的两端；路径所写入的是模型承诺采用哪种约定，而任何精确匹配基准都看不到它。衰减调度的守恒关系比常数速率更易读取。

title: Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping
summary: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRDisaster——一个多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架，探究视觉语言模型（VLM）在众源灾害影像理解、地理定位与推理中的潜力，并构建了融合VGI、SVI与RSI的跨视角基准数据集与统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 众源影像可提供及时、细粒度、街景级的灾害观测，弥补应急响应中传统遥感影像（RSI）的不足；但此类影像结构松散、空间语义模糊、缺乏可靠地理元数据，人工地理定位与解译成本高、难以扩展。因此需探索VLM在众源灾害影像理解、定位与推理中的潜力。
AI.method: 提出多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架GRDisaster。基于PhotoMappers新构建基准数据集，含26,340张图像，组织为经人工验证的VGI、街景影像（SVI）与RSI跨视角三元组，覆盖2018—2024年多起灾害事件。框架结合确定性与概率性跨视角地理定位及多视角融合，将VGI影像与带地理参考的SVI、RSI关联；并引入两组空间推理指标，分别用于跨视角地理定位验证与灾害损毁评估，利用结构、环境与全局场景线索验证跨视角对应关系，并结合专家核验标注评估灾害严重程度，提升VLM输出的可解释性。
AI.result: 构建了首个面向VLM空间推理的统一评估框架与跨视角基准数据集，实现跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损毁感知的严重程度评估，验证了VLM可将众源灾害影像转化为可操作的地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，该研究首次系统性地探究并统一评估了基于VLM的空间推理如何通过跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损毁感知严重程度评估，将众源灾害影像转化为可操作的GeoAI。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
summary: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试"安全行为可定位性+恢复"能否构成对自适应微调攻击的稳健防御，发现在约百条有害样本的无意微调下局部冻结可保留拒答能力，但攻击者可通过扩散更新绕过，并提出五项防御检查。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将LLM安全对齐行为定位到特定层、方向与token，暗示可对其进行保护；但作者质疑：成功的定位与恢复是否能支撑在面对攻击变化时仍然有效的防御。
AI.method: 在4个模型家族、6个checkpoint上，先用线性可分性检验与全干净隐状态patch定位拒答恢复的过渡深度；再在该深度以下冻结全部层后重复攻击。第二项研究针对仅注意力微调，去除更新矩阵的前两个奇异方向进行修复；并在Llama-3.1-8B上测试常规训练改变、扩散式攻击与基于良性微调校准的谱检测器。
AI.result: 攻击后有害与良性提示仍线性可分，干净隐状态patch可在可复现的过渡深度恢复拒答。但在一百条有害样本下，6个checkpoint的拒答率均接近零，恢复过渡位于冻结边界之上。去除前两个奇异方向可在4个checkpoint的短时注意力微调后恢复拒答，但在Llama-3.1-8B上被常规训练改变削弱并被扩散更新击败；谱检测器漏检多数修复失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 局部冻结能在少量有害样本无意进入训练数据时帮助保留拒答；但攻击者可绕过由恢复定位出的区域并击败跨checkpoint有效的修复，说明需要针对自适应微调的防御评估，作者据此提出五项检查。

title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
summary: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

AI.tldr: 提出"grounded correction arbitration"问题框架，在多选项中引入接受/拒绝/检查环境/询问说话者四种决策，并用GAVA方法实现基于观测有界证据与一步期望损失的选择策略，在ALFWorld文本环境中验证其成本与准确性权衡。
AI.motivation: 当人类对具身智能体的纠正可能错误时，智能体应如何响应仍缺乏形式化框架。现有工作多默认纠正正确或仅做简单接受/拒绝，未系统处理"验证环境证据"与"向说话者澄清"之间的选择问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为四选一决策（接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者）；GAVA基于"观测有界证据"、合法探针与一步期望损失规则实现决策。在纯文本ALFWorld中生成162个检查点、972个成对真/假干预；采用完美说话者下的成本阈值比较、仅训练用的物体位置先验，并进行冻结策略后的非重叠复现实验与检查点自助法置信区间分析。
AI.result: 完全局部检查下GAVA与always verify均达100%纠正准确率；同回合执行中GAVA较always verify降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与成本阈值持平。引入训练先验后，340个未见场景的交互与声明联合成本较均匀GAVA下降0.490与0.420；冻结后在77个非重叠已见检查点（308场景）复现为0.595与0.517，两者95%检查点自助置信区间均不含零。联合成本优于相同先验的固定策略，但匹配校准的无VOI比较仍不确定。语义GAVA在两个队列各出现4次事实错误，准确率为98.8%与98.7%，所有方法均完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未证实环境信息价值相对澄清具有普遍优势。研究限于规范化声明、完全符号观测与受控说话者，未涉及真人被试、视觉输入或物理机器人。

title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
summary: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

AI.tldr: 提出检索引导的字形感知满文历史文档修复框架，通过引入字形级结构知识提升低资源条件下退化字符的结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 满文历史文档具有重要语言文化价值，但其数字化受严重退化和配对训练数据稀缺的双重制约。现有文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，虽能产生视觉上合理的结果，却无法保持满文字形的结构身份，导致字形失真。
AI.method: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架：超越像素重建，显式引入字形级结构知识。方法检索相关字形样本作为结构引导，并将该信息整合进重建过程，从而在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复。
AI.result: 在满文历史文档上的大量实验表明，与现有修复方法相比，所提方法同时提升了图像修复质量和字形级保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了引入字符感知结构先验对于低资源历史文档可靠修复的重要性。

title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST 将块草稿器产生的多个候选打包成树，在单次目标模型前向中验证，按预期收益与验证开销自适应选择树宽，实验中最快较标准链式解码提升 43%，且不改变输出分布。
AI.motivation: 块草稿器一次前向即可对整块未来 token 打分，但标准推测解码只验证得分最高的链，丢弃其余已打分的候选，造成草稿信息浪费；同时最优验证宽度随部署环境变化，人工调参成本高。
AI.method: CAST 把块草稿器的候选 token 组织为树，在单次目标模型前向中并行验证，不改动目标模型、草稿器权重与解码规则；通过延迟测量，在"下一个候选带来的期望收益大于其增加的验证时间"时继续加宽树，从而自发得到部署相关的宽度。
AI.result: 在三个 GPU 代次、两个模型族、五个领域共八种设置下，CAST 在预测宽度处均快于标准链式解码，最高提升 43%；验证开销在 kernel 边界跳变时，固定 128 token 树仅快 2%，而预测宽度树快 20%。
AI.conclusion: CAST 以零额外草稿成本复用已打分候选，凭代价感知的树宽自适应提升推测解码速度，并在贪心与采样解码下证明目标输出分布保持不变，代码已开源。

title: Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing
summary: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

AI.tldr: 规则转工具（R2T）将公开科学需求转为可调用执行检查，在SciCode修复任务中实现29/30完成率，优于纯文本的26/30，并降低报告的模型输出量31.2%。
AI.motivation: 科学编码智能体需依据书面方程、边界条件与输出要求评估并修订程序，书面检查存在偏差与不可执行问题，需提供可执行的需求检查以提升修复可靠性并量化其成本收益。
AI.method: 构建Rules to Tools（R2T）机制，将公开科学需求准备为可调用实现；采用匹配修复组设计（相同书面检查、起始程序、模型与预算），对比工具组与文本组；跨两个任务ID队列（8个与30个任务）评估，并进行任务簇bootstrap、共享定义SciCode队列、5个开发暴露任务、全新源码至Python臂以及匹配PDE对比。
AI.result: 完整修复：文本26/30，工具29/30；3个任务偏好工具，1个偏好文本，11个持平。8-ID队列13/16对15/16，差异任务簇bootstrap 95%区间[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点；较大共享定义队列均13/24。5个开发暴露任务3/10对7/10。任务17、77、11偏好工具，初始检查标记任务17且对77、11报告无违规；任务37偏好文本且初始无报告违规。源码至Python臂达15/16，与专用命令聚合一致。匹配PDE对比中详细文本23/24、检查24/24，检查的报告模型输出低31.2%。公共CPU使用在两个任务ID队列均上升。
AI.conclusion: 准备的执行检查可在部分任务上提升修复完成率并减少智能体侧报告输出，但效果具任务依赖性，且伴随公共CPU开销上升；需在任务层面权衡收益与成本。

title: EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine
summary: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoRefine框架，用自车参考的预测对齐与可靠性感知融合解决异步协同感知的特征错位问题，在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq上优于TraF-Align。
AI.motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时间延迟，现有基于预测的方法主要依赖发送方自身历史进行补偿，与自车当前观测仍存在残余错位；后续融合也常忽略对齐质量的空间差异。
AI.method: EgoRefine包含两个模块：（1）Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment：以当前自车特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考的轨迹方向细化采样偏移；（2）Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion：以自车与协同流之间的轨迹差异及方向细化幅度作为对齐线索，用于调节对齐特征间的关系，并在卷积融合前自适应重加权两路特征。
AI.result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine在AP@0.5和AP@0.7上平均分别比TraF-Align高出1.6和2.9个点。
AI.conclusion: EgoRefine通过自车参考的预测对齐和轨迹条件可靠性感知融合，有效缓解异步协同感知中的特征错位并提升3D目标检测性能，源代码将公开。

title: Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot
summary: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

AI.tldr: 本文对意大利语与罗马尼亚语"brain rot"梗图视频进行多模态对比分析，构建了含240个TikTok视频的CRIB数据集，发现热度主要与视频节奏（尤其罗马尼亚语的快剪辑）相关，而非文本或声学情感特征。
AI.motivation: 探究"brain rot"类内容为何具有吸引力，并厘清意大利语与罗马尼亚语两个版本在语言与文化层面的差异，弥补该新兴现象缺乏系统性多模态研究的空白。
AI.method: 构建CRIB数据集（Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot）：人工筛选240个TikTok视频，按语言（意大利语、罗马尼亚语）与热度分层，提取并分析文本、声学与视觉三类特征，并结合流行度相关性与跨语言对比分析。
AI.result: 流行度与文本元素（情感、荒诞性、押韵）及声学元素（人声特征、声音情感）均无显著相关；罗马尼亚语中视频级动态特征（更快的剪辑速度与整体节奏）是成功的强预测因子。跨语言对比显示：意大利语文本更负面、困惑度更高、押韵更多，声音旋律范围与响度更高；罗马尼亚语音频频谱更明亮、音高波动更紊乱。
AI.conclusion: "brain rot"视频的成功更多由视频级节奏动态驱动而非文本或声学情感内容，且两种语言版本在文本与声学层面存在系统性差异，体现了语言与文化对多模态网络内容形态的塑造作用。

title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
summary: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用配对预测协议度量研究智能体的"预测信用"，在336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21端点与24个OpenML任务上检验，但v5冻结信用判定为不确定：Tox21预注册ROC AUC危害检验与OpenML联合规则均未满足，匹配点精度增益未被证实，自然解释信用在测试的捐赠分辨率下仍未获确认。
AI.motivation: 研究智能体需要为其规划的实验方案给出解释，但既有评测难以判定这些解释是否真正带来预测性收益。本文希望建立可操作的"预测信用"度量，以区分解释文本本身、匹配解释与捐赠者上下文对预测结果的独立贡献，从而为研究智能体基准与科学预测提供更严格的评价基础。
AI.method: 采用配对预测设计：共享同一干预、预测者与结果，仅改变描述、匹配解释与捐赠者上下文。设置五项检查，分别追踪承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐与已知信号摄取。在336个受控学习前瞻状态、12个Tox21端点与24个OpenML任务上评估；包含DeepSeek V4 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Flash回放、OpenML全卡片分配与直接文本Flash等条件，并以作者自建机制作为阳性对照。
AI.result: v5冻结信用判定不确定。Tox21预注册ROC AUC区间分数危害检验未满足（D-M=-.0026，95%区间[-.0174,.0104]）；OpenML联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则未满足。匹配点精度相对描述的增益未获确认，Tox21/OpenML种子-捐赠者区间跨零。DeepSeek V4 Pro下，匹配卡与捐赠者卡分别使Tox21二次漂移降低64.5%与59.1%。DeepSeek V4 Flash回放使匹配点MAE从.01823升至.02020，且未达匹配-捐赠者区间分数等价。OpenML全卡片分配使名义80%区间扩大21%，覆盖率为49.3%，而描述与内容为51.4%（66/144张卡）。直接文本Flash交付全部144条记录但无可检测的匹配点精度增益。作者自建机制阳性对照使点MAE相对描述降低2.60个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该协议为研究智能体基准与科学预测提供了可操作的预测信用度量框架，但在所测试的捐赠分辨率下，自然解释的预测信用仍未获确认；阳性对照表明协议具备检测真实效应的能力。

title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

AI.tldr: LEGO-OPD 通过把语言专家与定位专家的因子分解组合成一个教师分布，并采用自适应校准控制视觉似然对语言先验的更新强度，在提升多模态定位能力的同时保持语言推理能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态 on-policy distillation（OPD）需在提升视觉定位的同时保留语言模型推理能力。现有多教师方法虽结合 LLM 与 VLM 教师提供互补监督，但直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会把定位信号与其自身语言先验纠缠，无法独立迁移定位信息；而单纯增强视觉监督又会过度强调视觉证据、损害语言推理，形成两难。
AI.method: 提出 LEGO-OPD：在广义贝叶斯框架下，将 Language Expert 与 Grounding Expert 的因子选择性地组合为一个教师分布。语言专家提供候选 token 上的先验，定位专家仅贡献视觉似然以更新该先验，而非迁移其完整预测分布，从而实现语言推理与视觉定位的独立控制。并引入自适应校准，以定位专家的图像诱导预测偏移作为前缀相关参考，决定每个解码前缀处视觉似然更新的强度，避免视觉监督不足或过度。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3 模型的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线；同时提升了初始学生的视觉感知能力，并保持了纯文本推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 因子分解式的教师分布组合与自适应校准能够解耦语言推理与视觉定位的监督信号，在统一的多模态 OPD 框架中实现可控且均衡的蒸馏效果。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian
summary: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言（罗马尼亚语）RAG系统评估难题，构建AdminRo-Eval数据集，并基于Ragas框架对比三种LLM评判方法，发现评估策略需因指标而异。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）的RAG系统评估缺乏可靠的参考基准，传统基于参考答案的度量方法效果不佳，因此需要探索"LLM-as-a-Judge"范式在罗马尼亚语场景下的可行性。
AI.method: 构建AdminRo-Eval——由母语者标注的罗马尼亚语行政文档数据集，作为自动评估器的基准真值；基于Ragas框架，采用新一代模型（Gemini 2.5与Gemini 3），对比直接评分、比较排序和细粒度分解三种评估方法，覆盖Faithfulness、Answer Relevance和Context Relevance三类指标。
AI.result: 评估策略须与指标匹配：细粒度分解在Faithfulness上达到最高人类一致性（Gemini 2.5 Pro下96%），比较排序在Answer Relevance上表现最优（90%）；轻量级模型在LRLs复杂推理任务上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: Gemini 2.5 Pro架构为罗马尼亚语RAG自动评估建立了稳健且可迁移的基线，表明指标特定的评估策略对低资源语言RAG评估至关重要。

title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

AI.tldr: 提出ContractRL，将验证器引导的JSON修复建模为受合同约束的有界决策过程，在相同验证信息下以更少token实现更高语义成功率。
AI.motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反schema或执行契约而失败；重新生成完整对象会扩大动作空间，且使反复修复难以审计。
AI.method: ContractRL采用契约约束的序列修复协议：每步策略观测候选对象、类型化验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；由契约导出的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行状态转移前过滤非法或禁止的RFC-6902操作；并定义面向patch、retry与abstention决策的契约约束组相对目标，同时将规范目标与语义标签排除在在线状态之外直至轨迹冻结。
AI.result: 相同验证器信息下，ContractRL语义成功率为0.9362、生成34.4个token；Patch-SFT为0.9076/44.9 token，完整重生成0.9148/137.2 token（每种子192例、5个种子）。策略优化使语义成功率从监督版0.9186提升至0.9375；独立三种子配对评估相对Patch-SFT的语义差为+0.0396（95% CI [+0.0137,+0.0662]，p=0.0039）。反馈、动作掩码、预算与schema漂移分析将收益归因于局部化修正；对抗与多轮评估刻画了残余失败模式。
AI.conclusion: ContractRL通过局部化、受合同约束的顺序修复，在提升结构化工具调用语义成功率的同时显著降低生成开销，并具备可审计性与可解释的增益来源。

title: Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用SNN内部亚阈值膜电位统计量进行OOD检测，并构建Gen1-C事件相机损坏基准，提出的MDD方法在多数损坏下AUROC超0.88。
AI.motivation: SNN适用于事件相机数据的节能处理，但该场景下OOD检测仍具挑战：现有方法依赖目标检测SNN中不可得的模型输出或计算组件，且不适合低算力部署。
AI.method: 1) 发现亚阈值膜电位V_mem(t)可作为检测分布漂移的内部信号，基于膜电位动态计算简单的逐通道统计量；2) 构建Gen1-C基准，基于Prophesee Gen1车载检测数据集，包含6种传感器级直方图压力测试，各5个严重程度；3) 提出Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)，一种与损坏类型无关、基于膜电位统计量的方法。
AI.result: 在最高损坏严重程度下，MDD仅使用有界64帧观测窗口，在6种损坏中的5种上AUROC超过0.88；剩余那种损坏对底层检测器影响最小。
AI.conclusion: 膜电位的时间动态可为SNN事件感知中的OOD检测提供有效且低成本的信号。

title: UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI
summary: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

AI.tldr: UniBuc 团队在 SemEval 2024 Task 2 中，使用未经微调的 SOLAR Instruct 模型，通过输入操控与定制化提示，在临床试验生物医学 NLI 任务上取得了一致性得分 0.72，排名第 14。
AI.motivation: 该研究面向临床试验领域的生物医学自然语言推理（NLI），旨在探索在不进行模型微调的情况下，如何通过提示工程提升模型在安全相关推理任务中的表现，尤其是对语义保持变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用未经微调的 SOLAR Instruct 模型，重点进行输入操控与定制化提示设计；针对不同临床试验报告（CTR）章节分别定制提示，并在零样本与少样本两种设置下开展推理。
AI.result: 一致性得分达到 0.72，在排行榜中位列第 14 名。
AI.conclusion: 详尽的错误分析表明，模型倾向于走捷径并依赖简单启发式规则，尤其在处理语义保持变化时表现明显，说明提示工程虽有效但模型的推理鲁棒性仍存在不足。

title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
summary: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. Every source appears once in each role, so additive source-quality effects cancel from the equally weighted aggregate contrast. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA outperforms ST in all 40 seed-pooled model--target comparisons. Model-level advantages range from 8.2 to 16.2 percentage points in the primary design (mean: 10.8) and from 12.0 to 16.0 in the second design (mean: 14.3); all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. In both designs, ST sources are more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to the measured ordering of statement-level resemblance. These findings identify reasoning approach as a more effective matching criterion than topic for mathematical transfer across the evaluated topic--approach combinations.

AI.tldr: 在数学训练数据的筛选中，按"推理方法"匹配比按"主题"匹配更能促进大模型微调后的迁移，且优势与文本表面相似度呈反向关系。
AI.motivation: 数学训练数据通常按主题组织（例如用概率题训练概率能力）。作者质疑这一直觉，提出另一种组织原则：按解题推理方法匹配，即用与目标题共享解法但主题不同的例题作为训练源，并检验哪种关系带来更强的迁移。
AI.method: 设计两个平衡的2×2实验：概率×组合数学与不变量推理×双重计数（2000题）；数论×几何与补集法×鸽巢原理（800题）。每个格子轮流作为留出目标：同方法源（SA）共享解法但换主题，同主题源（ST）共享主题但换解法。每个源在各角色中各出现一次，使源质量的加性效应在等权聚合对比中抵消。跨5个基础模型、每个设计3个训练种子评估。
AI.result: 在全部40个种子池化的模型—目标对比中，SA均优于ST。主要设计中模型层面优势为8.2–16.2个百分点（均值10.8），第二设计中为12.0–16.0（均值14.3）；十个模型层面的95%置信区间均不含零。两个设计中ST源在嵌入与词汇指标上更接近目标，说明SA优势与题干表面相似度的排序相反。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的主题—方法组合范围内，推理方法比主题是更有效的数学迁移匹配标准。

title: From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model
comment: Accepted at the excv, ECCV 2026 Workshops. 17 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
