summary: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，无需微调即可解释预训练基础模型内层patch级特征，在多种医学影像任务上达到与黑盒分类器相当的精度，并将规则用于分析合成医学图像。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在医学影像任务上迁移能力强，但其潜表征如何编码临床相关信息尚不清楚，这在安全攸关领域是待解难题。
AI.method: 在冻结特征空间中对类特定原型进行聚类学习，将patch特征表示为与原型的相似度，并用具有人类可读IF-THEN语言条件的模糊规则分类；在ImageNet-1K与GastroNet-5M预训练的ViT-S/16最后两个block上应用，与k近邻、核SVM、线性探测对比。
AI.result: 在无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类和结肠息肉分割上，所提方法无需骨干微调即可达到与黑盒分类器相当的准确率；领域特定预训练产生的特征兼具判别性与符号可压缩性；规则可用于定位合成图像偏离真实组织的位置。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种透明、按深度解析基础模型如何组织临床相关结构的视角，并给出提取规则的实际下游应用。

title: EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights
summary: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

AI.tldr: 提出EurekaBench跨域基准，测试AI智能体进行长周期实验并发现解释观测的机制的能力，用可衍生的科学洞见来评估机制。包含6领域26个专家验证任务和306条洞见，从约束遵循、预测精度、洞见产出三维度评估。结果显示智能体过度专注预测精度优化（可超人类科学家），但在得出科学洞见方面明显不足。
AI.motivation: 以牛顿发现万有引力为隐喻，探讨AI智能体能否进行类似机制发现，并填补缺少衡量该能力的基准与评估框架的空白。
AI.method: 构建EurekaBench：涵盖神经科学、计算机科学、化学、天体物理、地球物理与等离子体物理的26个长周期任务集合，含306条专家验证的科学洞见；评估框架从三轴检验发现能力——遵循已知科学约束、发现机制的预测精度、机制能否产生科学洞见或指导后续研究。
AI.result: 当前AI智能体常过度聚焦预测精度优化，在此方面甚至超越人类科学家，但在推导科学洞见方面差距显著。
AI.conclusion: 科学发现能力的评估不应止于预测精度；现有智能体在洞见驱动型机制发现上仍需大幅改进，EurekaBench为跨域长周期机制发现评测提供了标准化框架。

title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
summary: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对并发且易故障的多智能体委派场景，形式化了容错预算守恒机制：以独占托管信用（escrow credit）在委派DAG中传递，通过绑定谱系、纪元、规范化效应、最大费用、接收者与幂等键的“操作预留”和签名调度许可实现预算不超支，并在明确假设下证明安全性。
AI.motivation: 资源限制正成为AI智能体跨并发、易故障工作进程委派工作的授权边界。但父子分配约束、仿射对象、分布式托管本身无法防止以下情形导致的超支：回复丢失、超时后效应完成、消息重复、分支分区、DAG汇合混叠同一谱系。因此需要为分布式多智能体委派建立容错预算守恒的形式化基础。
AI.method: 将预算建模为量化资源向量，以独占托管信用在委派DAG中流动。派发前，分支将信用转换为绑定谱系、纪元、规范化效应、最大费用、接收者与幂等键的操作预留，并持久化带隔离（quarantine）的签名调度许可；网关在首次接受前验证该许可。不确定效应在被认证结算、有围栏的权威“无效应证明”或永久退役之前保持计费。采用TLA+有界模型检验、独立JavaScript探索器与崩溃注入的双进程SQLite实验进行验证，并检测超时退款与历史证书校验两个变异体。
AI.result: 在显式中介、持久性、认证、规范化与网关假设下，证明了所有权分区、账本与效应守恒、后代非放大、至多一次结算、延迟完成安全性与分区隔离。不可区分性结果表明，分区本地可用性需要独占预分配。TLA+有界检查、独立JavaScript探索器与崩溃注入实验覆盖了声明范围，并检测出超时退款与历史证书校验变异体。在评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、汇合与延迟完成调度下，机制保持了已发放预算的上界。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在故障与并发条件下维持了预算守恒的授权边界，验证了容错预算守恒设计的可行性与必要性，其中分区本地可用性依赖独占预分配。

title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
summary: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三层数据污染框架（重复、患者、来源标签泄漏），审计三个最广泛使用的脑肿瘤MRI公共数据集，发现各层污染均严重，但去除全部泄漏测试图像后平衡准确率几乎不变，说明排行榜稳定无法证明基准完整性。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤MRI自动分类文献普遍报告超过98%的准确率，但准确率无法反映基准质量的关键维度——数据集完整性（测试数据在图像、患者、采集来源层面独立于训练数据）。作者希望揭示公共语料库中的污染问题，并建立数据集完整性作为可测量的独立基准质量维度。
AI.method: 提出三层污染框架：重复泄漏、患者泄漏、来源标签泄漏。以胸部X线片作为阴性对照，审计三个最广泛使用的语料库，在九种架构和三种评估条件下量化每层污染对性能测量的影响，并识别可追踪测试图像的患者标识。
AI.result: 污染在每一层都严重：主语料库官方测试集28.8%有近重复训练样本；第二语料库22.3%测试图像字节完全相同；95.5%可追踪测试图像与训练共享患者；不含解剖信息的文件头特征以0.959平衡准确率区分肿瘤与无肿瘤，与微调ResNet主干持平。关键意外结果是：去除全部已识别泄漏测试图像后平衡准确率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 数据集完整性是基准质量的独立可测量维度，稳定的排行榜无法认证它。仅凭这些语料库的报告准确率不能证明模型学会了识别肿瘤，而非利用数据集特异性线索。作者公开了污染文件清单、恢复的患者标识符及去重后的划分。

title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). 5 pages
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

AI.tldr: 该论文将上下文学习(ICL)摊销为一个读取少样本支撑集几何结构(质心、主子空间、谱)的小型网络,在冻结的GPT-2-large/XL中层对query残差流施加输入条件化的加性更新,从而在零样本推理成本下复现甚至超越ICL行为。
AI.motivation: 近期理论表明静态向量等价于单条合成示例,在高秩映射(如词级双射)上必然失败。作者由此提出语言学版本的问题:哪些语言操作可以从提示中摊销出来?
AI.method: 训练一个2.6M参数网络,读取少样本支撑集的几何(质心、主子空间、谱,一次计算并缓存),在冻结GPT-2-large/XL的中层为query残差流生成输入条件化的加性更新;在8个屈折方向和1个词汇关系上测试,采用禁止方向间倒对泄漏的规范划分。
AI.result: 出现三种情形:前向屈折上10-shot ICL较强(0.67-0.89)而提取的任务向量崩溃(≤0.06),变换在严格零样本下与ICL相当;在词形还原方向上变换不受ICL上限约束,达到0.78-0.92,最高超过ICL +72点(past→present:0.85 vs 0.13);在任意配对(反义)上所有摊销器在各规模、容量、种子下均稳定在ICL的一半左右。对照实验表明支撑流形是因果必要的任务指纹:错误任务流形使准确率崩溃至≤0.06,仅query变体无法区分共享输入空间的任务,留一任务迁移为零。
AI.conclusion: 可产出的规则能够摊销为潜在任务表示,有时甚至优于提示所能传达的效果;而记忆化的配对不能摊销。

title: JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion
summary: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. Skills are distilled from execution trajectories and admitted only under Bayesian credible bounds. Experiments show that failure turns direction with scale: open-weight backbones drift to unsupported grounds, frontier models to the statutory default. We further verify that JusticeAgent, as a simple yet effective plugin, carries a frozen open-weight backbone to commercial level. Project resources are available at https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis.

AI.tldr: 该论文将法律裁判形式化为"基准锚定"任务，提出JusticeAxis数据集（18国256个真实刑事案件，含音视频文本证据及律师撰写的三种判决）与JusticeAgent系统（元素智能体认定事实、法官智能体在经验技能下适用法律，技能经贝叶斯可信界筛选）。实验发现判决失败随模型规模呈方向性反转，且JusticeAgent作为插件可将冻结的开源模型提升至商业级水平。
AI.motivation: 现有法律裁判方法在僵化的法条匹配与缺乏依据的自由裁量之间摇摆，评测基准仅评判单一标签或评分表，而真正能提供平衡的"情境经验"始终未被验证。
AI.method: 将法律裁判形式化为"基准锚定"任务，要求单一判决同时锚定法条与情境。构建JusticeAxis数据集：18个国家256个真实刑事案件，含音频、图像、文本证据，每案附三份律师撰写判决（实际判决及两种失败情形）。提出JusticeAgent框架：元素智能体负责事实认定，法官智能体在携带情境经验的技能下适用法律；技能从执行轨迹中蒸馏，仅在贝叶斯可信界下被采纳。
AI.result: 实验表明失败会随规模发生方向性反转：开源权重骨干偏向无依据的理由，前沿模型偏向法条默认值。JusticeAgent作为简单而有效的插件，可将冻结的开源权重骨干提升至商业级水平。
AI.conclusion: 法律裁判需要在法条与情境间取得平衡，本文提供的基准锚定任务、JusticeAxis数据集和JusticeAgent方法验证了情境经验的重要性，并证明轻量插件可显著提升开源模型的法律裁判能力。项目资源见 https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis。

title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
summary: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

AI.tldr: PACT是一个端到端模型，从单目视频联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力，并通过物理监督和数据标注流程及新基准ForceWall取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将视觉姿态重建与接触、力估计分离，这种分阶段处理限制了联合推理能力，并会在各阶段间传播误差。同时，接触力标注稀缺也是制约该任务的关键问题。
AI.method: 在人体重建基础模型上引入可学习的接触力token，以及融合视觉特征与世界空间运动的时间Transformer；通过联合预测头细化姿态并估计接触与力；采用基于物理的监督保证重建运动与交互力的一致性。为缓解力标注不足，设计数据标注流程，将接触标注与基于物理的运动和力优化结合，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督；并构建真实攀岩基准ForceWall，提供视频与力传感器采集的真值接触力。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在接触与力估计上达到最优，优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互场景。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持端到端联合学习是从视频中恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效途径。

title: Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models
summary: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性三者对多语模型语法能力的交互影响，在MultiBLiMP（101种语言）上以四种方法评测六个模型族，发现后训练损害语法能力且低资源语言代价最高，隐藏知识仅在高资源语言可测，母语提示可恢复低资源语言能力。
AI.motivation: 多语语言模型的语法能力结论随测量方式剧烈变化，但"评估范式×后训练×语言资源可得性"的交互作用此前未被系统研究，可能导致对低资源语言能力的系统性低估。
AI.method: 在覆盖101种语言的句法最小对基准MultiBLiMP上，对来自六个模型族的基座模型与后训练模型，采用四种评估方法进行评测，并分层比较不同模型规模与语言资源水平下的表现。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：（1）后训练降低语法能力，其幅度随模型规模增大而被不均匀地削弱，低资源语言承担最高损失；（2）后训练模型保留无法通过显式提示表达出来的语法知识，但仅在高资源语言中可测，因为低资源场景的接近随机基线几乎没有可隐藏的知识；（3）母语提示可恢复低资源语言上原本隐藏的能力，说明只有高资源语言才能从不加提示的概率中直接探测。
AI.conclusion: 多语语法评估必须采用语言知情、多范式组合的协议，以避免系统性低估低资源语言的能力。

title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository
summary: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.

AI.tldr: 本文构建流式召回基准，交叉保留与选择规则并在相同300个episode上评估，证明记忆评测应固定访问条件、分别报告保留与选择效果。
AI.motivation: 持久智能体需同时决定到达时保留什么、查询时呈现什么，但现有记忆评测常混淆保留与选择两种决策，因比较的方法在两方面均有差异，导致结论难以归因。
AI.method: 构建流式召回（streaming-recall）基准，交叉组合保留规则与选择规则，在相同300个带随机种子的episode上评估每种条件；在固定访问条件下分析查询感知选择的效果，并分解混合比较中的访问收益；在有限保留条件下考察查询感知、dense与oracle选择的表现及失败成因；最后在SQuAD上重复评测。
AI.result: 固定访问时，查询感知选择将必需事实召回提升15.5个百分点（95% CI：12.8–18.2）；而同时改变历史访问的混合比较报告68.7个百分点优势，其中53.2个百分点归因于访问。有限保留下，查询感知、dense与oracle选择均达到保留上限；有限近期（bounded recency）条件下319个失败全部由驱逐（eviction）而非排序错误引起。目标回溯足够久远时召回降至0%。在SQuAD上保留上限依然成立，且dense检索在自然文本上可优于词法检索。
AI.conclusion: 有限记忆评测应固定访问条件，并分别报告保留与选择两个环节的表现，以避免混淆归因、得出误导性结论。

title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelDense，将语义编码器与几何密集预测模型分为两个独立投影流并加正交惩罚，在像素扩散训练中提升生成质量与训练效率。
AI.motivation: REPA虽能加速扩散Transformer训练，但其对齐目标几乎只用语义编码器（如DINOv2、CLIP）；近期研究表明对齐效果主要来自空间结构而非全局语义，然而用密集预测基础模型（分割/深度/法线等）作为对齐目标仍被忽视。此外，不同类型教师的梯度可能存在冲突。
AI.method: 先用像素空间扩散实验比较SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2与仅DINOv2的GenEval表现；随后提出PixelDense：将DINOv2与SAM2走语义投影流，Depth Anything v2与Metric3D v2走几何投影流，并加入权重空间正交性惩罚使两流子空间互不相交。四个教师均冻结，推理时丢弃。
AI.result: 单个几何教师优于分割教师，且二者均优于仅DINOv2基线；但四教师简单求和的平面融合反而低于最佳单几何教师。PixelDense采用单一配方应用于PixelGen与DeCo，在GenEval、DPG-Bench、HPS v2.1上均提升，PixelGen-XXL的GenEval Overall由0.7927升至0.8093，并优于所有单教师及未分解多教师变体。部分噪声重建中，独立全景/深度/法线探针在τ=0.5时PQ最高提升53.1%，深度AbsRel降低36.0%（COCO与Flickr30K）。从随机初始化达到基线峰值GenEval快1.23倍；SDEdit编辑中在PIE-Bench各编辑强度下更好保留背景与版式，背景PSNR最多提升2.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 密集预测基础模型是有效的REPA对齐目标，但语义与几何梯度需分开投影。PixelDense通过双流分解与正交惩罚，在生成质量、结构保持、编辑保真与收敛速度上全面优于现有对齐方案。

title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较五种上下文策略在四个开源LLM上的纵向临床推理表现，发现情节式与混合式策略整体最优，且对远距离证据的鲁棒性最强；可回答问题上的高准确率并不能保证对无依据前提问题的正确弃答。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床推理需要LLM在跨度很长的患者病史中识别并整合相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能处理更多信息，但提供更多病史并不必然使相关证据更易获取或提升推理质量。因此需要探究病史证据的"选择与呈现方式"（而非单纯的数量）对推理可靠性的影响。
AI.method: 在MedLoCoMo基准上，对四个开源权重LLM比较五种上下文策略：完整上下文（Full）、近期上下文（Recent）、情节式（Episodic）、语义式（Semantic）与混合式（Hybrid）。评估维度包括：答案正确性、对查询—证据距离的鲁棒性，以及面对无支撑前提问题时的弃答（abstention）表现。
AI.result: 情节式与混合式策略整体准确率最强；近期上下文策略在支持证据距离变远时性能下降最明显，而情节式与混合式在长距离下仍保持最高准确率。对对抗性问题的分析进一步表明，在可回答问题上的强劲表现未必能转化为对病史不支持结论的成功弃答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的纵向推理不仅取决于LLM可访问的病史数量，更关键地取决于相关证据如何被选择与呈现以供推理使用。

title: When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的"恢复"重新定义为因果决策问题，提出轻量级策略CIR，仅凭恢复前可用信息判断何时值得干预，在ALFWorld长程任务上将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅以平均任务成功率衡量恢复效果，掩盖了一个关键矛盾：同一恢复操作既可能挽救失败轨迹，也可能破坏本可成功的轨迹。因此需要区分"挽救"与"伤害"，并研究恢复价值随时间的变化。
AI.method: 将恢复形式化为因果决策问题：从相同执行状态出发，对比有/无恢复两种情形，分离挽救与伤害效应，并刻画恢复价值随时间的演变；进而提出因果干预路由器（CIR），一种利用恢复前可获得信息决定是否干预的轻量级策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B执行的长程ALFWorld任务上，CIR将成功率由70.33%提升至73.33%（+3.00个百分点），且对观测正确的轨迹不做任何改动；额外对照实验表明，恢复带来的收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了评估恢复并选择性施加恢复的实用方法，表明基于因果视角的选择性干预优于无条件恢复。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.tldr: Memorizon 解耦了流式世界模型中"长跨度监督"与"注意力计算量"的耦合：训练样本可覆盖任意长度跨度，但仅在最后 k 个 chunk 上计算损失，每个被评分 chunk 通过相机共视性检索 top-K 隐变量组成共享 bank，使序列长度受 kK 约束。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型需在重复访问同一地点时保持渲染一致，但直接监督这类"重访"需要同时包含两次访问、常跨越数分钟的训练样本。对完整跨度做稠密注意力会带来二次方开销，导致长跨度监督代价高昂。核心矛盾在于：一致性监督需要长跨度，而训练代价不希望随跨度增长。
AI.method: Memorizon 将长跨度与注意力解耦：样本覆盖任意长度的跨度，但只在最后 k 个 chunk 上评分。被评分 chunk 不再对之前的历史做 tokenization，而是各自按相机共视性检索 top-K 隐变量，所有请求的并集构成一个共享 bank。bank 规模上界为 kK，因此序列长度有界，与跨度无关；在最短跨度时该方案退化为常规训练。检索解决了"几百秒前的观测如何被当前 chunk 取用"的问题，而无需把中间所有帧纳入注意力。
AI.result: 加入 bank 使每步开销一次性增加；此后跨度变长成本增长很小，从 100 s 到 400 s 仅增加 12% 的步时间。相比滑动窗口基线，检索在全部数据划分上提升重访一致性；当跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时，一致性再提升 24%–30%，代价是图像质量有所下降；超过该跨度后，继续加长不再有收益。将 bank 换成来自另一 episode 的隐变量会使重访相关性下降 83%，说明模型确实在利用检索到的内容而非忽略它。
AI.conclusion: 长跨度是监督所必需的，但对注意力并非必需：通过 camera co-visibility 的检索式共享 bank，可在有界序列长度与近常数级步时间下实现长跨度重访监督，显著提升流式世界模型的地点一致性。bank 来源的消融证明了检索机制的有效性。

title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
summary: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了LLM中一个被忽视的"对齐-忠实性冲突"：对齐后的模型在面对不安全或敏感内容时会系统性地偏离输入且不披露修改，作者称之为"对齐诱导的不忠实"（AIU），并发现其随规模加剧、在后训练（尤其DPO）阶段被放大，最终提出能力-对齐-忠实性三难困境。
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别探讨了"能力-对齐"和"能力-忠实性"之间的权衡，但第三种张力——"对齐-忠实性冲突"尚未被充分研究。作者希望填补这一空白，说明对齐机制本身可能损害模型对输入的忠实性。
AI.method: 作者提出"对齐诱导的不忠实"（AIU）这一失效模式，构建了 FaithConflict 受控数据集以隔离两类冲突（能力驱动与对齐驱动），并设计了两套互补分类法：行为层（B1-B8）与思维链推理层（C0-C6）。随后跨模型、跨规模、跨训练阶段（含中间检查点）进行评估，并测试基于提示的缓解手段。
AI.result: AIU 随模型规模增大而上升，且比能力驱动的不忠实上升更陡峭，呈现"反向缩放律"；中间检查点显示 AIU 在后训练阶段被放大，其中 DPO 阶段差距增长最大且最不易被察觉；基于提示的缓解方法无法解决该问题。
AI.conclusion: 对齐与忠实性之间的冲突是真实且系统性的，不能靠简单提示缓解，由此揭示出LLM设计与评估中存在"能力-对齐-忠实性"三难困境。

title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
summary: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于1,118个Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结LLM上的自动提示优化（APO），具备可廉价确定性评分、难度可调、可再生等特性。
AI.motivation: 大模型能力提升使评测日益困难：基准饱和、公开测试集污染、困难任务需昂贵评分或执行设施；而这些挑战在APO中因搜索过程反复评测而被放大，因此需要一个廉价、确定性、难度充足且可随模型演进而更新的基准。
AI.method: 构建国际象棋基准：1,118个Lichess谜题，对冻结LLM优化提示而不更新权重；采用精确匹配评分与引擎评估替代走法，并提供难度可调的谜题供给；将解题增益与同领域短对局rollout关联；在8个目标模型上评估6种APO算法，衡量基线强度、对优化的响应程度及优化提示的跨模型与跨玩法迁移。
AI.result: 即使最强评估模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（作为元模型）也仅解出约55%的谜题；基准具有区分度，揭示不同方法与模型间的增益、持平与退化；可再生，新谜题降低污染风险并以可调难度保持提升空间；成本低廉，完整研究约800美元。
AI.conclusion: 国际象棋是适合APO的基准：具有挑战性、有区分度、可再生且经济可负担；作者开源谜题、优化与评估代码及数据集更新脚本。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysVista基准，基于"感知-推理-判断"闭环认知框架评估视觉语言模型的物理智能，揭示其在物理推理与合理性判断上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准评估碎片化，仅关注孤立的认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断VLM能否可靠评估新兴生成模型的物理真实性。
AI.method: 构建PhysVista基准，采用受人类"看-推理-评估"过程启发的闭环认知框架，联合评估物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性判断；区分事件级与尺度级推理以实现细粒度分析；同时纳入真实世界与AI生成视频，覆盖多领域及新兴生成场景。
AI.result: 在多样化VLM上的大量实验显示，模型在物理推理与合理性判断方面存在明显局限，视觉识别与真正的物理理解之间存在持续差距。
AI.conclusion: PhysVista揭示了VLM物理理解的不足，指向更具原则性的、物理落地的多模态智能设计方向。

title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
summary: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多语言QA基准Waldo，揭示在跨语言知识缺失与知识冲突情境下，大模型存在显著的"查询语言偏好"，尤其在知识冲突时会导致语义等价查询因用户语言不同而得到不同答案；作者进一步用注意力头消融与LoRA训练缓解该偏好，后者将偏好差距最多降低61.5%。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益成为多语言知识检索接口，需综合多语言证据。已有研究指出模型存在查询语言偏好（偏向使用查询语言所写来源），但多在"各语言均有等价知识"的设定下考察。当不同语言来源对同一事实提供不完整或相互矛盾的信息时，该偏好会产生实质后果：用户获得的信息取决于模型选择使用的来源。因此需要在跨语言知识差异情境下系统刻画这一偏好。
AI.method: 构建Waldo——基于Wikipedia的多语言问答基准，含12K问答对，覆盖两类知识差异：(1)知识缺口，即某事实仅存在于一种语言而缺失于另一语言；(2)知识冲突，即不同语言版本对同一事实给出相互矛盾的表述。在五种语言上评估八个模型，并探索两种缓解知识冲突下偏好的方法：一是机制性干预，消融与查询语言偏好相关的注意力头；二是基于LoRA的训练。
AI.result: 在知识缺口情形下，当某语言版本仅缺少相关事实时，模型通常不论查询语言如何都会使用另一语言的证据。但在知识冲突情形下，模型回答强烈倾向于与查询语言对应的文档一致，导致语义等价的查询因用户语言不同而引出不同版本的说法。缓解方法中，LoRA训练可将偏好差距最多缩小61.5%。
AI.conclusion: 查询语言偏好在存在跨语言知识冲突时具有实质性影响，会造成同一事实因用户语言不同而答案不一致，威胁多语言信息获取的公平性与一致性。机制性消融与LoRA训练均能一定程度缓解该偏好，其中LoRA效果显著，为构建更均衡的多语言检索与问答系统提供了可行方向。

title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
summary: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 JevSpawn，一种将自然语言任务规范与有限概率探索相连接的组合式策略，通过并行动作生成与反馈驱动的分支选择，在无需额外训练的前提下提升任务性能并加快导航速度。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体逐 token 生成推理与动作，长交互导致速度慢、计算昂贵；Jev 类模型虽能快速进行有限域上的概率预测，但需预先指定有限域，难以适应从自然语言指令推导动作并随交互调整的自主任务求解场景。
AI.method: JevSpawn 通过组合式策略把自然语言任务规范映射到有限概率探索，采用并行动作生成（parallel action spawning），并结合反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订以及保留备选方案的回退机制；利用共享动作结构与模型前缀减少重复生成和上下文计算，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在八个基准任务上，与七个智能体基线及一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体进行比较，JevSpawn 在任务性能上有所提升，并实现了更快的导航速度。
AI.conclusion: JevSpawn 是通向结构化智能体推理的一条有前景的路径，在提升任务表现的同时加快了导航效率。

title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架FORTE，通过两阶段自适应关键帧选择提升长视频问答中MLLM的关键帧选取效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于打分的关键帧选择方法在固定且均匀采样的候选池中搜索，池外证据永远无法被选中；在相关度打分预算有限时，核心挑战是如何自适应地将评估分配给有潜力的帧，同时持续探索代表性不足的时间区域。
AI.method: FORTE为免训练框架，包含两阶段：1）自适应相关度打分：从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效高斯过程相关度预测器估计未打分帧的相关度，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算从立方复杂度降至关于帧数的线性复杂度（固定带宽下）；打分阶段以预测相关度与时间覆盖度为依据选择下一批打分帧，兼顾有潜力区域与欠表示区域。2）全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关度与时间覆盖度的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构推导出精确算法，在给定最终帧预算下以线性于候选池规模的时间找出最优子集。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE在每个测试的打分预算下均取得所比较选择器中观测到的最高平均准确率；进一步评估表明其在不同相关度打分器与下游MLLM上均保持稳定有效性。
AI.conclusion: FORTE通过自适应相关度打分与全局关键帧优化的两阶段设计，突破了固定均匀候选池的限制，在有限打分预算下兼顾相关度与时间覆盖度，并在多基准与多组件配置下验证了其有效性与泛化性。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了用于IEEE BigData 2026 Cup可解释自杀风险评估的系统，基于Qwen2.5-Instruct与QLoRA，针对风险分级、证据短语抽取和多标签因素识别三项任务分别设计训练与聚合策略，官方榜单综合得分0.7738。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅要求模型估计风险严重程度，还需识别帖子中支撑性语言及表达出的风险与保护性因素，因此需要统一的语言模型框架同时完成多任务并可解释输出。
AI.method: 采用QLoRA对Qwen2.5-Instruct进行参数高效微调，使用答案掩码的因果语言建模目标；训练策略按任务定制：任务1a/1b联合训练用于证据抽取，三任务联合训练用于风险分类，任务2单独适配用于因素识别；聚合方式亦因任务而异：对32B与72B模型的风险等级概率取平均，证据短语采用跨折共识合并，因素决策基于折外工作点进行比率匹配校准。
AI.result: 官方榜单综合得分0.7738，任务1为0.8089，任务2为0.6919。三任务联合训练对任务1a最优，任务1a与1b联合训练对任务1b最优，任务特定训练对任务2最优；当组件模型误差互补时，概率平均进一步提升任务1a。
AI.conclusion: 在统一语言模型框架内，针对各任务输出结构定制训练目标与聚合策略具有显著价值。

title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
summary: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出Gestalt——以多模态交互为核心的新型大模型范式，通过"多模态交互金字塔"组织建模流程，实现从模态特异处理到跨模态对齐再到深度多模态融合的递进。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态的独特特性及其相互关系，导致发展遭遇瓶颈。受人类多感官知觉多阶段特性的启发，作者希望通过明确的多阶段交互结构来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出多模态交互金字塔，将多模态建模组织为模态特异处理→跨模态对齐→深度多模态融合的递进过程。基于该金字塔，Gestalt采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，并以可学习的交互token（interplay tokens）作为跨模态交换与整合的中介；金字塔同时用于指导数据组织与训练策略。
AI.result: 在图像生成、多模态理解以及纯文本评测中均取得强劲表现，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留了模态特异信息。
AI.conclusion: Gestalt有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型优势，为通向统一多模态智能提供了有前景的路径。

title: Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation
summary: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将混合建模思想引入序列到序列的对话生成，在CVAE框架下用多个解码器分别学习不同主题，以缓解生成回复多样性低的问题，并在开放域聊天语料上取得定量指标与人工评估的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 序列到序列对话响应生成模型存在生成回复多样性低的问题。作者假设其原因在于序列到序列模型倾向于学习到一个退化的单峰响应分布，因而无法覆盖多模态分布的数据特性。
AI.method: 在序列到序列模型中引入解码器的混合（mixture of decoders），并促使每个解码器学习专门的（specialized）主题；模型构建在条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架之下。
AI.result: 在开放域聊天语料上进行评测，在定量指标和人工评估两方面均优于强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 用混合解码器捕获多模态响应分布、并让各解码器主题专精化，是提升对话回复多样性的有效途径。

title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
comment: Accepted at the Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将认知科学中的"认知行动"概念引入LLM智能体设计，区分获取、转化与探测三种模式，并提出"认知脚手架"概念，认为智能体设计必须关注"决策就绪证据"如何被生产。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究多聚焦于搜索与探索能力，却忽视了更前置的问题：当前证据是否已"就绪"到足以支撑决策。证据可能缺失，也可能虽已存在但其形式掩盖了关键信息，或缺乏用于判断所需的比较基础。作者因此希望把认知科学中关于"认知行动"的讨论引入智能体设计，以弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用概念性/立场性论文（position paper）的论证方式：借鉴认知科学中"认知行动"（epistemic actions）的定义——即为改善后续选择依据而采取的行动，将其迁移至LLM智能体语境，并划分出三种模式：①获取缺失证据；②转化已有证据；③探测系统以产生具有揭示性的响应。同时提出"认知脚手架"（epistemic scaffolding）这一术语，用以指代使这些行动成为可能且可审计的接口、工具与环境。
AI.result: 本文为立场性论述，未报告实验数据或量化结果，其主要产出是概念框架：三种认知行动模式的划分，以及"认知脚手架"这一统一术语，用于描述支撑并审计认知行动的接口、工具与环境。
AI.conclusion: 智能体设计不应止步于搜索与探索能力，而必须正面处理"决策就绪证据是如何被生产出来的"这一问题。通过认知行动与认知脚手架的概念，可将证据准备阶段纳入智能体设计的核心议程。

title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
summary: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

AI.tldr: 该论文将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上多峰、连续且尖锐的连续偏好场（CPF），据此训练基于VLM与GRPO的裁剪模型CPIC，并构建重校准基准CPICD，以解决现有数据集主观性与网格离散化缺陷。
AI.motivation: 美学图像裁剪旨在寻找最优裁剪区域，但现有标注数据集存在两大问题：(1) 人类主观性带来的标注噪声；(2) 受限于固定采样网格的刚性离散性。这些缺陷不仅降低模型精度与泛化能力，也严重扭曲公平评测，导致长期存在的基准评测危机。
AI.method: 提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过(1)峰值聚类、(2)非格点精化、(3)负向塑形、(4)场组装四个步骤，从离散标注中恢复稠密偏好景观，将人类裁剪偏好建模为多峰、连续且尖锐的场。基于CPF奖励，采用GRPO优化训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC，克服模板崩塌。并构建CPICD，利用CPF修正主流基准中受网格约束的伪影，对现有真值框进行全面重校准。
AI.result: CPIC取得最先进性能，并具备出色的域外泛化能力；CPICD为裁剪研究建立了严格可靠的评测基础；大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC与CPICD的优越性。代码、模型与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将裁剪偏好从离散标注重构为连续偏好场，可同时提升模型训练质量与评测可靠性，为后续美学裁剪研究提供了新的建模范式与基准基础。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
summary: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

AI.tldr: 提出 RuleEvolve，一个编码规则的自我演化框架，通过 LLM 变异与评判迭代优化规则池，在多框架、多模型、多基准上优于手工工程与现有提示优化基线。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体的性能高度依赖其底层编码规则，但现有编码规则通常由人工编写且固定不变，导致构建过程耗费大量人力并且往往并非最优。
AI.method: RuleEvolve 维护一个候选编码规则池并进行迭代改进。每次迭代中，先由 LLM 驱动的 mutator 模块基于现有候选规则生成变体，再由 judge 模块评估这些变体，并用表现最佳的规则更新规则池。
AI.result: 在两个编码智能体框架、四个主干 LLM 和三个基准上的广泛评估表明，RuleEvolve 在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（如所用 token 数）方面，均优于手工工程和现有提示优化基线。
AI.conclusion: RuleEvolve 通过自我演化机制自动优化编码规则，验证了规则可被迭代搜索与改进的可行性，为提升编码智能体性能提供了有效替代人工规则设计的方案。

title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
summary: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

AI.tldr: 提出OB-CAIE（基于本体的情境化AI评估）方法，通过领域本体（DSO）与评估过程本体（EPO）明确界定可处理的问题空间，提升AI评估的科学严谨性、人机平衡与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估存在科学严谨性不足的问题，根源在于测试覆盖范围不清晰、人类专业知识与自动化之间缺乏平衡、评估测试环境缺乏可复现性。
AI.method: OB-CAIE方法以两个本体刻画可处理的问题空间：领域特定本体（DSO）界定"测什么"（what），评估过程本体（EPO）界定"怎么测"（how）。同一OB-CAIE问题空间可支持一项或多项AI评估，并在科学可辩护的方式下于特定节点引入人类判断，尤其适用于人类反馈不可约减或机器不可替代的复杂领域。
AI.result: OB-CAIE通过科学方法的第一步——明确界定测试对象——强化了当前AI评估实践；其关键优势在于失效点可在规范的OB-CAIE方法问题空间内被追踪、可视化与分析。
AI.conclusion: OB-CAIE以本体驱动的双本体结构（DSO+EPO）为AI评估提供了规范化的可处理问题空间，兼顾科学严谨性、人机协同与可复现性，并支持失效点的可追溯、可视化与分析。

title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
summary: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

AI.tldr: JAx是一种预测空间监督方法，通过跨噪声水平对齐干净图像预测来加速像素空间扩散模型训练，在ImageNet 256x256上稳定提升FID并加快收敛。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益无法可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测任务。作者发现辅助特征对齐会提升语义特征的可及性，却削弱了干净图像预测所需的图像变化信息，导致辅助目标与去噪任务不匹配。
AI.method: 提出JAx（Just Align x），不施加独立的表征目标，而是直接改进预测目标本身。方法通过保持原始JiT输入分布的马尔可夫退化，将含噪学生观测与更干净的观测耦合；理论上更干净状态的oracle预测与最优JiT目标具有相同条件均值，且条件目标协方差更小。为便于实际应用，JAx结合真值监督与基于预测风险选择邻近教师状态的信度门控耦合带。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，JAx在JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16上一致改善FID并加快收敛，且无需外部编码器或修改架构与采样流程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低，消融实验表明增益不能仅由时间重加权解释。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间监督为像素空间生成模型提供了简单且有原则的表征对齐替代方案，通过降低训练目标方差而非施加独立表征约束来提升生成质量与训练效率。

title: Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23068698)
summary: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的概念遥测层 Lingtai，将每步残差状态投影到无监督构建的概念锚点库上，得到逐 token 概念坐标信号，并系统表征其与预测不确定性的关联及两类结构。
AI.motivation: 在自回归推理中在线观察大语言模型的计算过程、且不依赖训练探针，仍然困难；现有方法多需标注概念样本、结果标签、梯度拟合或激活空间优化。
AI.method: Lingtai 在每个生成步将残差状态投影到领域特定的具名概念锚点库（161 个锚点用于代码实现），锚点构建不使用标注概念样本、结果标签、梯度拟合与激活空间优化，从而产生结构化的逐步概念坐标信号；并在代码生成与小学数学推理任务上做问题身份/位置控制、随机锚点对照、K-means 与 PCA 投影对照、弹性对齐的轨迹检索及匹配审计等实验。
AI.result: 该信号与预测不确定性稳健关联：关联通过问题身份与 token 位置控制，不归因于单一 token 类型，在 GSM8K 上不能由简单对错混合解释，且无法被匹配随机锚点复现；在 K-means 与 PCA 投影中显著更弱或方向不一致。任务条件化的活动熵形态在 HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K 上不同；轨迹身份具强局部惯性但弱重实例化不变性——完成级弹性对齐下，k=32 损坏仍以 62.0% 检索归档 episode，而全新执行仅 11.7–16.0%。审计未发现该标量概念活动信号在测试协议下提供稳定正确性坐标，故正确性视为外部输入。161 锚点代码实现每 token 解码开销增加 0.7–1.6%，生成 token 不变。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的概念遥测可在线提供结构化概念坐标与不确定性关联证据，但不足以给出稳定的正确性坐标，正确性需外部提供；方法开销低、不改变生成结果。

title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
summary: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"科学废话"(scientific slop)的概念与六项度量(结构、论证、人工制品),构建390对AI/人类论文基准SciSlopBench,检测准确率达85.9%(高于Binoculars的68.7%),并揭示slop与低ICLR评分相关;同时提出SciSlopHarness框架,在以实验证据为依据的修改约束下,将AI-人类差距缩小63%。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容(常称AI slop)在学术界日益普遍,但AI生成科学论文的"废话"模式更复杂,现有基于词元的AI检测器难以识别:论文各部分看似合理,但连接各部分的科学推理却断裂,从而误导读者对工作的评估。作者希望刻画这类科学推理层面的失败并探索负责任的对策。
AI.method: 1) 定义"科学废话"并设计跨结构(Structure)、论证(Argument)、人工制品(Artifacts)三方面的六项度量;2) 构建SciSlopBench,含390篇AI生成论文(以计算机科学为主,兼跨生命、社会与自然科学),每篇配以在研究问题与贡献类型上匹配的人类撰写论文;3) 提出SciSlopHarness——一种harness层级框架,引导固定LLM仅在实验记录支持的情况下修改,避免直接优化度量与奖励黑客问题。
AI.result: 六项度量在每对论文中识别AI论文的准确率为85.9%,优于Binoculars的68.7%;更高的科学废话水平伴随更低的ICLR评分,并在2017至2025年每一年中都能以高于随机的水平区分被拒稿与录用论文。标准修改会残留废话,直接slop-aware提示则触发奖励黑客;SciSlopHarness在无需人类参考目标的情况下,将剩余AI-人类差距较最强修改基线缩小63%。
AI.conclusion: AI生成科学论文在其全局推理中留下根本性痕迹,可被结构、论证与人工制品层面的度量所捕捉;缓解此类问题不能靠单纯优化度量或润色文字,而需要严格的证据约束(responseible mitigation requires strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement)。

title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

AI.tldr: HAWK 通过让浅层 drafter 直接利用目标模型的压缩视觉隐状态、选择性融合目标层表征，并建模 drafter 自身提议后目标预测的偏移，缓解 LVLM 推测解码中多模态信息利用不足与多步接受率下降问题，在十个基准上提升接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 推测解码对 LLM 已实现显著无损加速，但在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）上效果有限：轻量 drafter 难以利用丰富的多模态信息；同时标准蒸馏仅在原始训练轨迹上监督 drafter，未建模 drafter 自身提议后目标预测如何变化，导致其偏离轨迹、与目标分歧增大，后续步骤接受率下降。
AI.method: HAWK 包含三部分：1）利用表征相似度选择信息量高的目标层，并学习如何组合这些层的隐状态；2）在视觉信息方面，直接向 drafter 提供来自目标模型的压缩视觉隐状态而非原始视觉 token，使浅层 drafter 更易使用；3）训练 drafter 捕捉其自身提议后目标预测的变化，提升多步起草过程中与目标的一致性。
AI.result: 在 SmolVLM-256M 的十个多模态基准上，贪婪解码下平均接受长度从 EAGLE-3 的 3.32 提升至 4.08，加速比从 2.19x 提升至 2.60x；采样解码下接受长度从 2.89 提升至 3.41，加速比从 1.92x 提升至 2.19x。
AI.conclusion: HAWK 有效提升了 LVLM 推测解码的效率，验证了压缩视觉隐状态、目标层表征融合以及建模 drafter 提议后目标预测偏移对提高接受长度和加速比的作用。

title: PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026)
summary: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysicsMate——基于NCTB孟加拉九至十年级物理教学大纲、融合知识图谱构建的1834问答对基准，并通过LoRA微调0.6B/1.7B/4B模型显著提升闭卷准确率。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉中等教育缺乏与课程对齐的STEM解题基准；通用语言模型在物理问题所需的专业术语、单位约定与推导上表现不佳。
AI.method: 基于NCTB九至十年级物理教学大纲构建1834问答对基准，并以含1760节点、2600条边、十类本体类型的多关系知识图谱为支撑；对0.6B、1.7B、4B参数模型采用统一配方进行低秩适配（LoRA）；另开展节点类型分析，并将4B模型量化适配为小型离线二进制。
AI.result: 各规模闭卷准确率均显著提升，分别提高5.5、15.0和23.3个百分点；节点类型分析显示受适配增益最大的是结构化课程知识（物理量与命名定律），最小的是界定松散的实体级知识。
AI.conclusion: 经适配与量化的4B模型可作为小型离线二进制，在资源受限环境中本地推理，为连接性与硬件受限场景提供课程对齐的物理学习支持路径。

title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
comment: 63 pages, 22 Figures, 10 Tables, Code: https://github.com/safety-research/MAMUBench (will be released after review)
summary: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多用户多智能体（multi-user, multi-agent）协作场景，跨5个前沿模型、4类环境、77个情景，对比"单一协调者智能体"与"各服务一名用户的智能体团队"（有/无通信通道）的群体表现。结果显示团队在所有环境中均劣于协调者，无通信时在两个环境彻底崩溃，有通信时也存在显著协调开销。论文分析了失败行为（随团队扩大停滞、互相覆盖动作、捏造声明），并给出环境特定的缓解措施（团队负责人、显式流程指令、平台级检查强制阅读同伴消息），同时发布MAMUBench（含74个情景）。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多将任务委派给AI智能体，而不同用户的智能体常在共享资源（代码库、日历、预算）上相遇。当各智能体代表目标不同的用户时，协调常失败，群体结果甚至劣于由一个智能体代表所有人。论文旨在系统刻画这种多用户、多智能体协调失败的现象、机制与缓解手段。
AI.method: 在4类环境、77个情景中，跨5个前沿模型进行对照实验：API key环境（共享计算预算）、诊所（共享日历）、个人助理（共享团购或预订）、合并队列（共享发布截止时间）。每个情景比较一个服务所有用户的"协调者"（coordinator）与"每智能体服务一名用户"的团队，并区分有无智能体间通信通道。同时识别失败行为并测试多种缓解措施。
AI.result: 团队在所有环境中群体结果均劣于协调者：无通信通道时在两个环境完全崩溃；即使有通道，协调开销仍造成显著差距。例如在个人助理环境中，协调者完成目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍。识别出与差群体表现相关的行为：随团队规模增大而停滞、互相覆盖动作、捏造声明。找到有效但依赖环境的缓解措施：团队负责人（team lead）、显式流程指令、平台级检查（使智能体在提交前必须阅读同伴消息）。
AI.conclusion: 多用户、多智能体协调存在系统性失败，即便提供通信通道也难以消除协调开销，需借助结构性缓解措施。论文发布MAMUBench，包含API key、诊所、个人助理三类环境的74个情景，用于评估多用户多智能体协调能力。

title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
summary: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VisionQ基准，首次将定性对比图的判断建立在具名视觉标准之上，实现"标准条件下的视觉判别"任务，并发现当前最强VLM裁判准确率仅63.1%。
AI.motivation: 定性对比图是计算机视觉论文的核心证据，视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被用于评判这些图。然而现有基准仅给出标量质量分或整体偏好，导致裁判可能因错误的视觉理由而"蒙对"优选图像，缺乏对判断依据的可解释性与可靠性约束。
AI.method: 提出VisionQ基准，由四部分组成：(1)语料库——来自1,409篇CVPR/ICCV论文的1,800余张经校验对比图与3,911个手工标注数据点，将方法裁剪区域与作者陈述的视觉主张关联；(2)六轴、51叶的定性判断视觉标准分类体系；(3)标准条件下的评测协议，隐藏方法名、图注与论文身份，并按标准报告准确率；(4)VisionQ-Judge——以对称证据对进行DPO微调的Gemma-4-E4B裁判模型。任务定义为"标准条件下的视觉判别"：仅在裁判选中作者在该标准下认定的最优输出时记分。
AI.result: VisionQ-Judge将末位选项预测降低7.0个百分点，在留出测试集上准确率提升2.5个百分点。对20个开源与闭源VLM裁判的评测显示，最强模型准确率仅达63.1%（随机基线32.2%），且可靠性在不同视觉标准间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在定性对比图评判上远未达到可靠水平，且标准间表现不均衡；将判断绑定到具名视觉标准可暴露"理由错误但结论正确"的评测漏洞，为更严谨的定性图像判别评测与裁判模型训练提供了基准与范式。

title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

AI.tldr: 本文为循环语言模型（LoopLM）建立实用训练配方，实现从零训练预算降至310B tokens，并证明循环结构在受控对比下优于同参数稠密模型，同时给出将预训练稠密模型转为循环模型的最小化方案。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层块提升有效深度，但现有大规模训练需多阶段、数万亿token，且循环带来的收益难以与数据和训练差异分离，因此需要更实用、更可控的训练配方。
AI.method: 1) 提出从零训练的高算效流水线：预训练+高质量中期训练，配合学习率预热与更强的退出门正则化；2) 在相同数据与token预算下，将1.4B LoopLM与参数匹配的稠密模型进行受控对比；3) 提出将预训练稠密模型转为循环模型的最小配方，仅用一个可学习的输入混合标量和平滑退出损失，无需步特定参数，并应用于Qwen3-1.7B-Base。
AI.result: 从零训练预算由Ouro的7.7T tokens降至310B tokens且保持强推理性能；1.4B LoopLM在全部12个基准上优于同参数稠密模型，GSM8K +14、MATH +10、DROP +22；在推理算力相当时，以36%参数量接近3.9B稠密模型的数学推理与阅读理解；Looped Qwen在两种数据设置下均优于继续训练的稠密基线，在GSM8K、MATH、MMLU-Pro上有统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环语言模型从零训练显著更廉价，且可实用地引入现有预训练检查点，同时隔离出循环结构本身带来的收益。

title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
summary: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出Legal Research Bench (LRB)基准，含413道美国法律检索开放式问题（含金标准答案、支持权威、二元评分标准），用web/判例/页面解析/检索工具评测13个前沿模型。采用"全通过+来源验证"评分，经专家律师验证LLM评委。最优模型Claude Opus 4.8仅42.9%完全正确；性能随法律领域和任务设定差异大，且更多轮次/工具调用/推理成本并不预示更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 法律检索是核心且耗时的法律工作流程，需要确定控制性权威、验证其有效性、协调法条与判例并综合出有依据的答案。语言模型智能体天然适配此类检索密集型任务，自动化部分流程具有价值，但该价值取决于可靠性：一处遗漏权威、过时引用或错误法律结论即可使貌似合理的答案不可用。因此需要一个能衡量可靠性的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建LRB基准：413道由专家撰写的美国法律研究开放式问题，每题配金标准答案、支持权威和二元评分标准。在配备网页搜索、判例检索、页面解析和检索工具的测试框架中评测13个前沿模型。采用"全通过"评分结合来源验证——只有当所有必需标准均满足且引用权威经核实后，答案才算正确。同时用专家律师验证LLM评委，确保基准分数与律师判断一致。
AI.result: 所测模型中表现最强的Claude Opus 4.8仅在42.9%的问题上完全正确，智能体距可靠仍有明显差距；不同法律领域的全通过率存在显著差异，在需要协调冲突权威的问题上表现更低；跨模型看，更多对话轮次、工具调用和推理成本并不能预测更高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: LRB提供了专家撰写、带来源验证和律师校准的严格评测，揭示了当前前沿模型在法律研究任务上远未达到可靠水平，且传统"更多计算/更多工具调用即更好"的直觉不成立，为后续提升法律检索智能体可靠性提供了方向与衡量标准。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study.
