Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"序数寻址假说"：大语言模型通过事实在上下文中被提及的顺序（而非问题中的名称）来定位事实，每个提及顺序对应一个共享的"事实地址"，问题将该地址作为"序数向量"移动模型隐状态以指向目标事实。
AI.motivation: 人类推理依赖命题中对象之间的关系。作者关注一个核心问题：关系如何组织上下文内容的语言表征？即模型在回答关于多事实列表的问题时，究竟是依据问题中的名称，还是依据事实在上下文中的组织方式来定位答案。
AI.method: 作者向LLM上下文提供一系列事实（如"Alice吃苹果。Bob吃梨。"），测量当问题从"Alice吃什么"切换到"Bob吃什么"时隐藏状态的变化。对大量列表取平均后得到"序数向量"（steering vector）。在线性模型（Qwen、Gemma、Llama）上，跨层、跨参数规模（1.5B–32B）和预训练阶段验证事实地址的排序性、可操控性、低秩性和涌现性。
AI.result: 事实地址具有四个性质：(1) 按提及顺序排序，查询状态按事实顺序组织而非名称顺序，即使某事实有多个主语也成立；(2) 可操控，将序数向量加到关于新列表第一条事实的问题上，模型会以该列表第二条事实作答；(3) 低秩，位于低秩子空间且第一条提及的事实最易到达，与人类回忆相似；(4) 涌现性，共享于中后层，在1.5B至32B参数范围内成立，并在预训练早期形成。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型通过事实被提及的位置而非名称来达到该事实，深化了对LLM推理机制的理解，揭示了序数寻址这一与人类记忆类似的组织原理。

title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
comment: 38 pages, accepted at 2026 40th Advances in Neural Information Processing System (NeurIPS)
summary: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Robust Nash Alignment 框架，将不确定成对偏好下的对齐建模为博弈问题，通过四玩家原对偶代理博弈与单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解，得到带认证的最坏情况性能下界，并证明 O(1/√T) 收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有基于偏好的对齐方法通常只针对单一偏好模型优化，当成对偏好存在不确定性（噪声、异质、部署后漂移）时会变得脆弱。需要一种能对不确定偏好提供最坏情况保证的鲁棒对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出 Robust Nash Alignment 博弈论框架：领导者策略在名义偏好周围的歧义集内，对抗任意竞争者与任意偏好核，最大化最坏情况胜率，从而直接给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。针对优化难题，引入由领导者策略、跟随者策略、对抗核与对偶变量构成的四玩家原对偶代理博弈，并设计单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解。
AI.result: 证明代理博弈始终下界于截断的硬约束目标，量化了代理与硬目标之间的差距，并给出代理可精确恢复鲁棒目标的精确性条件；证明代理博弈对偶间隙的平均迭代收敛率为 O(1/√T)，进而得到原鲁棒目标的近最优鲁棒策略。在可控表格博弈与不确定偏好的 LLM 对齐实验中验证了收敛理论，并优于名义基线。
AI.conclusion: Robust Nash Alignment 为不确定成对偏好下的对齐提供了具有最坏情况认证保证的博弈论解法，代理博弈与乐观镜像下降-上升算法在理论与实验上均有效，可提升对偏好不确定性的鲁棒性。

title: Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

AI.tldr: Lang3DSeg 提出以点变换器（point transformer）为骨干、从零训练（无几何预训练）的户外 LiDAR 开放词汇语义分割方法，无需标注，通过类别优先掩码合成与深度分布首间隙截断来消除 2D-to-3D 投影的深度歧义噪声，在 nuScenes 验证集与 SemanticKITTI 上取得无标注方法中的最高 mIoU，且单帧推理实时、无需运行视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 安全的自主导航需要准确的 3D 语义感知，但监督式 LiDAR 分割受限于封闭类别体系与逐点人工标注的高成本。开放词汇方法通过将 2D 视觉语言模型的输出投影到 LiDAR 并蒸馏进 3D 网络来规避标注成本，但现有方法几乎全部依赖体素化稀疏卷积；点变换器此前仅用于室内场景，因为室内 3D 数据密集且有界，而户外 LiDAR 场景稀疏、无界，且从零训练时投影标签噪声更突出。
AI.method: 1) 首次将点变换器作为户外 3D LiDAR 无标注开放词汇分割的骨干网络，完全从零训练、不使用几何预训练；2) 针对 2D-to-3D 标签投影中的深度歧义（物体后方点被错误赋予该物体语义标签），采用显式类别优先（class-priority）规则合成掩码，并依据深度分布在首个间隙处截断每个投影实例，直接修正投影错误，而非在配准序列上做平均。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 验证集上达到 52.8% mIoU，在 SemanticKITTI 上达到 41.4%，均为两个基准上已发表的免标注方法中最优。每次 3D 语义分割仅基于单帧 LiDAR 扫描，推理实时且无需运行视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 点变换器可有效作为户外开放词汇 LiDAR 分割的骨干，配合显式的投影噪声修正策略，能够在完全无标注、无几何预训练、单帧实时推理的条件下超越现有免标注方法，为低成本开放词汇 3D 语义感知提供可行路径。

title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models: A Survey of Weight-Based, Prompt-Based, and Embedding-Based Adaptations
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了大语言模型任务适配方法，提出按"任务信息编码位置"（模型权重、输入提示、注入式任务嵌入）划分的统一框架，整合参数高效微调、上下文学习与嵌入注入三大范式，分析其优劣、演化逻辑与跨范式关系，并指出未来开放问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在下游任务中广泛部署，高效任务适配成为核心挑战。现有方法（参数高效微调、上下文学习、嵌入注入）各自在独立范式内发展，跨范式关系与权衡尚未被充分探讨，尤其是新兴的基于嵌入的适配方法缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性研究，提出一个统一框架：按任务信息的编码位置与方式将任务适配方法分为三类——模型权重（如参数高效微调）、输入提示（如上下文学习）、注入的任务嵌入。基于该框架构建整合三大范式的全面分类体系，并据此进行分析与比较。
AI.result: 该综述整合了分散于不同范式的任务适配方法，形成统一分类体系；系统分析各范式的核心优势与局限，并借此解释不同适配范式的演化路径、厘清范式间的相互关系。
AI.conclusion: 任务适配方法可统一理解为任务信息编码位置（权重/提示/注入嵌入）的不同选择；该统一视角揭示了各范式的演化逻辑与权衡关系，并明确了未来研究的开放问题。

title: Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI
summary:
Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业表示简化（ERS）与企业表示复杂度（ERC）模型，将复杂性变化与维护成本、AI推理性能关联，为比较表示方案提供可测架构变量。
AI.motivation: 企业信息通过应用、项目、技术、组织边界与局部需求形成的工件来表示，这些结构随时间累积，产生表示复杂性，需要企业维护，也需要信息消费者与AI系统解读。然而缺乏比较不同表示状态复杂度的中性模型，因而难以判断简化的必要性及效果。
AI.method: 提出ERS（在既定范围内减少不必要表示复杂性并保留必要信息）与ERC（表示中性的复杂度模型）。ERC从表示对象、交互、行为、支撑来源四个维度刻画表示范围，前三维构成依赖类别，支撑来源刻画表示暴露；ERC在表示层与任务层定义，从而区分架构简化与检索优化。构建经济模型区分反复出现的全局表示成本、任务级成本与一次性转换成本，并按时间范围评估；同时分析任务级ERC降低对AI系统识别、关联与解读负担的影响。
AI.result: ERC可用于比较表示替代方案、转换效果、经济结果和AI推理性能。经济模型使表示结构的维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强与运营等生命周期义务可被成本化。Text-to-SQL研究证据表明，降低模式与推理复杂度可提升推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: ERC并非通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标，而是提供可度量的架构变量，用于比较表示方案及其转换，并评估经济结果与AI推理表现。ERS可作为减少不必要表示复杂性、同时保留必要信息的架构方向。

title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 CtrlWAM：用模拟器执行受扰动作并配对其噪声视觉后果进行联合世界动作模型训练，缓解标准加噪训练中动作与视频不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 标准 WAM 训练对动作与视频同时加噪，但受扰动作意味着反事实的未来视觉，而加噪视频仍绑定于真实录制，导致动作与预测未来不一致；低噪声下场景几何与动态仍清晰可见。
AI.method: 在模拟器中执行受扰动作，生成其对应的噪声视觉后果用于联合学习；设计扭曲的视频—动作噪声调度，使视觉布局随动作预测演化保持响应；将动作接口从单自我控制扩展为可变数量的智能体流，支持多智能体预测或指令未来。
AI.result: 驾驶实验中动作预测更准确、生成视频与动作更一致、更符合给定指令；机器人实验中运动保真度与可控性更强；匹配对照实验证实离路径渲染对指令跟随与操作保真度的收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扰动动作与其反事实视觉后果配对训练并采用适配的噪声调度，可获得更可控的世界动作模型。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

AI.tldr: ReHoPER是一种仅推理、零样本的方法，通过沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题来提升大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 提升大语言模型的推理能力，且无需标注数据或针对特定任务的提示设计。
AI.method: 迭代地规划一组候选中间问题，选择其一进行回答，并基于更新后的历史重新规划，沿多条路径推进，最终给出答案；方法任务无关，跨数据集和模型使用同一通用指令。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上（包括新提出的组合推理受控基准iLLC）优于强基线，在组合性最强的设置中提升最大。
AI.conclusion: ReHoPER是一种通用、零样本且任务无关的推理增强方法，并公开了实现与iLLC生成器以支持后续研究。

title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

AI.tldr: 提出 Sapien——一种多步任务中执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，用扩展正则表达式描述工具调用序列，在几乎不损失智能体效用的前提下，可拦截 93-95%（AgentDojo）与 62-85%（Toolathlon）的攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文安全防御通过合成任务特定策略并在工具调用上强制执行来阻止 AI 智能体的越权行为，但在多步任务中，哪些动作有效往往取决于智能体此前的行为与已获得的信息，静态、无状态的策略无法刻画这种依赖关系。
AI.method: 设计 Sapien 策略引擎，用带状态谓词的正则表达式规定允许的工具调用序列，并引入延迟策略生成（deferred policy generation）与作用域化语义检查（scoped semantic checks），以支持有状态、依赖历史的多步策略执行。
AI.result: Sapien 的效用与无约束智能体相差仅几个百分点；即使智能体被完全劫持，其策略可排除 AgentDojo 上 93-95% 的攻击、Toolathlon 上 62-85% 的攻击，在长程任务中拦截数量约为工具白名单的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 有状态上下文策略是多步智能体安全防御的有效途径，Sapien 在保持高实用性的同时显著提升了对工具调用攻击的防御覆盖率。

title: Machine Translation for Sign Languages
comment: Accepted for publication in the Annual Review of Linguistics, Volume 13
summary: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

AI.tldr: 该综述梳理手语机器翻译从孤立手语识别到端到端翻译的演进，分析技术瓶颈与伦理议题，强调需跨学科并与聋人社群持续协作。
AI.motivation: 手语机器翻译虽受益于姿态估计、Transformer 架构和大规模数据集而快速进步，但仍面临数据资源匮乏、评价指标难以刻画输出语言质量，以及手语同步性、多层性、三维性建模困难等问题，同时缺乏对数据治理与社群参与的平衡视角。
AI.method: 采用综合性文献综述方法，剖析手语的计算独特性，追溯识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络，分析技术挑战，并结合计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等跨学科视角讨论伦理问题（数据治理、社群参与与合理使用）。
AI.result: 综述识别出三类核心问题：数据集规模远小于口语资源、评价指标无法充分反映语言质量、模型难以捕捉手语的同步多层三维结构；同时指出伦理层面涉及数据治理、聋人社群参与及技术适用性。
AI.conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进展依赖计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等领域的长期跨学科协作，并需与聋人社群共同推进。

title: Beyond Leaderboards: Tokenomics of Agentic Small Language Model Ensembles
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, Presented at ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop RLEval: Methods and Reinforcement Learning Environments for Evaluating AI Agents. Resubmission of permitted appeal, Ticket #MOD-104177
summary: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency. We use an agentic ensemble of small language models (SLMs) with an SLM-judge-mediated feedback loop as a case study for such beyond-leaderboard evaluation. On the 541-prompt IFEval benchmark, the best ensemble achieves 97.34% strict prompt accuracy, exceeding the strongest standalone LLM baseline, gpt-5.4, by 5.81 percentage points while operating in a lower-cost regime. We then analyze the tokenomics and operational behavior behind this gain, including cost per sample, token composition, useful-output goodput, feedback-loop recovery, latency decomposition, and performance across instruction categories and constraint counts. Our results show that agentic SLM ensembles can trade additional test-time tokens and orchestration overhead for improved instruction-following fidelity, motivating multi-dimensional evaluation protocols for future agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文以小型语言模型(SLM)组成的智能体集成系统为案例，提出超越排行榜准确率的多维评测框架，在IFEval上取得97.34%严格准确率，并以token经济学与运行行为分析解释其增益来源。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型(LLM)从独立助手演变为智能体工作流，单一标量排行榜准确率已不足以刻画系统的实际表现，需纳入运行可靠性、成本、延迟与token效率等维度。作者希望以SLM智能体集成为具体案例，论证并示范这种"超越排行榜"的评测范式。
AI.method: 采用由小型语言模型(SLM)构成的智能体集成(agentic ensemble)，并引入SLM-judge中介的反馈回路(feedback loop)，在541条提示的IFEval基准上进行评测。除严格提示准确率外，还系统分析token经济学与运行行为，包括单样本成本、token构成、有效输出goodput、反馈回路恢复能力、延迟分解，以及不同指令类别与约束数量下的性能表现。
AI.result: 最佳集成达到97.34%的严格提示准确率，较最强独立LLM基线gpt-5.4高出5.81个百分点，且运行于更低成本区间。进一步分析揭示了该增益背后的token开销结构与运行特征（成本、goodput、反馈恢复、延迟分解及分类别/约束数表现）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体SLM集成能够以额外的测试时token消耗与编排开销，换取更高的指令遵循保真度，说明单一准确率指标不足以评价此类系统，未来智能体AI系统应采用多维评测协议。

title: Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3
comment: 17 pages. Accepted to the non-archival Interpreting Agent Behavior workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project: https://kepler-harness.vercel.app/ . Code and public traces available
summary: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

AI.tldr: Kepler：将假设表示为可执行世界模型，通过回溯转移检查与条件预测检查验证；冻结配置下25个公开游戏全部服务器验证100.00 RHAE。
AI.motivation: ARC-AGI-3 要求智能体在交互环境中从观测推断规则与目标，公开集得分趋于饱和（50个游戏-模型单元中48个达100），故单纯公开分数缺乏区分度，需要更严格的评测与报告方式。
AI.method: 开源 harness（Kepler）：以可执行世界模型表达假设，通过回顾性转移检查（retrospective transition checks）与条件预测检查（conditional prediction checks）进行验证；冻结单一 Claude Opus 5 配置，无按游戏模型选择、无分数条件重跑。
AI.result: 25 个公开游戏全部服务器验证 100.00 RHAE；183 个完成关卡中 181 个的最终 Opus 尝试动作数不超过人类中位数基线；保留板使用 8,256 环境动作（其中 7,292 在计分关卡）；供应商会话记录 8.58 亿 tokens、97.37% 缓存读取、按 2026-09-01 等价费率成本 \$777.72；报告 3 类评测失效（源码泄露导致的无效完美运行、对照条件下智能体重建被移除的 harness、自主修复掩盖规划器损坏）；单游戏观察显示动画帧含任务相关信息；Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 最终板合计 48/50 达 100。
AI.conclusion: 公开集分数本身区分度有限，应推行首次尝试（first-attempt）、成本条件化（cost-conditioned）与验证感知（verification-aware）的报告规范。

title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
summary: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

AI.tldr: 提出EyeTAG，一种因果多帧注视估计框架，引入显式一阶注视先验（对历史预测差分得到运动token），在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°，在EVE上与最强基线持平（2.56° vs 2.58°）。
AI.motivation: 自然头眼运动下的注视估计对驾驶员监控、人机交互等应用至关重要。单帧方法逐帧独立预测，输出存在抖动；多帧方法虽能缓解抖动，但运动信息被隐式编码在表观特征中，注视轨迹从未作为显式变量建模。
AI.method: EyeTAG为因果多帧框架，核心是显式的一阶注视先验：每一步对自己的近期预测做差分，将得到的轨迹作为紧凑的运动学token回馈。由于差分在注视空间中具有平移不变性，该token携带受试者无关的运动信息而非个人注视偏移。人脸与眼部两路视觉证据经交叉注意力融合，并由因果Transformer解码器处理。
AI.result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线性能相当（2.56° vs 2.58°）。模型内消融实验（固定编码器与其余结构，仅改变注视历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯的时序上下文消除了即使使用绝对注视历史先验也仍存在的系统性扫视偏差。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模注视轨迹（差分量）能有效提升注视估计精度并消除扫视偏差，优于仅依赖隐式时序上下文的方法。代码已开源。

title: Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs
summary: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA (Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91$\times$. Additional evaluations show aggregate gains on three backbones spanning 1.7B-7B parameters and on Chinese and English role-playing tasks. These results support role-aware context management as a practical approach to maintaining conversational continuity and instruction adherence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出REA框架，通过角色感知的启发式情景注意力机制缓解多轮对话中的累积上下文衰减问题，在Long-MT-Bench+上将评分从6.32提升至7.36（相对提升16.5%），并降低平均延迟2.91倍。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在多轮对话不断增长的过程中，常常会丢失持续性的指令和相关关键信息。论文将这种累积性上下文衰减归纳为三种失败模式：注意力污染（attention pollution）、稀释（dilution）和漂移（drift），旨在解决对话连续性与指令遵循能力下降的问题。
AI.method: 提出REA（角色感知启发式情景注意力，Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention）上下文管理框架，为指令与情景交互分配不同的持久性与表示策略。其中 Instructional Memory 将识别出的全局约束保留在专用前缀中；Episodic Memory 保存用户输入、压缩模型回复，并通过启发式检索为每个历史轮次选择原始文本、压缩表示或直接省略。
AI.result: 在Long-MT-Bench+上，REA将评判分数从6.32提升至7.36（10分制），相对Vanilla基线取得16.5%的提升，同时平均延迟降低2.91倍。在1.7B–7B参数范围的三个骨干模型上，以及中英文角色扮演任务中均取得总体增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，角色感知的上下文管理是维持对话连续性和指令遵循的一种实用方法。

title: Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

AI.tldr: GITA 将价值函数显式条件化于时间抽象尺度 k，并通过对多个 k 值的优势加权监督聚合训练单一策略，无需在局部分辨率与长程信号之间二选一，在 OGBench 上显著超越离线 GCRL 基线。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）在长时程任务上表现不佳：折扣会压缩远距离状态间的价值差异，使其低于函数逼近误差，导致智能体缺乏状态排序信号；而时间抽象（将 k 步环境交互视为一次转移）虽能恢复长程信号，却不存在适用于所有状态-目标距离的固定 k——大 k 保留长时距价值差异但抹平近邻状态区分，小 k 则相反。
AI.method: 作者将该权衡显式化，提出 Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction（GITA）：让单个价值函数以 k 为条件，并通过聚合多个 k 值上的优势加权监督来训练一个策略，使对某状态-目标对赋予更大正优势的尺度在更新中贡献更强。GITA 不需在单一 k 之间取舍，从而同时保留局部分辨率与长程信号。
AI.result: 在 OGBench 上，GITA 优于广泛的离线 GCRL 基线：相较 HIQL，全部任务平均成功率提升 25 个百分点（相对提升 73%）；相较最强的固定 k 方法 OTA，提升 7 个百分点（相对提升 14%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将时间抽象尺度 k 作为价值函数的显式条件并以多尺度优势加权聚合训练单一策略，GITA 有效解决了离线 GCRL 中局部分辨率与长程价值信号之间的固有权衡，在多个任务上取得显著性能提升，表明多尺度隐式时间抽象是提升长时程离线 GCRL 的有效途径。

title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现扩散模型中匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维源，提出分支空间变换编码，并推导出闭式解GCBT，在等率量化噪声代理下显著提升PTQ保真度且不改变原有量化管线。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型训练后量化虽已利用时间步、特征和层结构，并开始引入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，忽略了跨激活（跨分支）结构。作者观察到匹配的CFG激活是强相关的二维源，且固定比特预算下分支编码基的选择会实质影响量化保真度。
AI.method: 提出分支空间变换编码：用离线推导的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，对模型参数和量化管线改动极小。进一步推导引导-相关分支变换（GCBT），联合纳入CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩；在等率量化噪声代理下，GCBT具有逐层闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。
AI.result: 将GCBT叠加在现有扩散PTQ方法之上，在大多数比较中取得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著的性能退化，同时保持底层宿主量化管线不变。
AI.conclusion: CFG条件/无条件激活间的跨分支相关性是可利用的量化结构；通过分支空间正交变换与闭式GCBT解，可在不修改宿主管线的前提下提升扩散模型PTQ保真度。

title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM在财报电话会议记录(ECT)分析中的"有据分析"评估难题，提出数值证据评估方法以摆脱专家标注依赖，并构建ECTs-100基准数据集，同时考察"自觉无能"失败模式。实验显示LLM在有据性上表现良好，但在正确性与信息不足处理上存在明显局限。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly用于财务文档分析，用户偏好可验证引用的有据分析。然而评估此类分析claim通常需要大量专家标注，成本高、难扩展；真实财务分析常涉及长上下文-问题-答案三元组，进一步增加复杂度。因此需要无专家标注的有据性评估方法与基准。
AI.method: 1) 提出数值证据评估方法(numeric evidence evaluation)，无需专家标注即可进行有据性评估；2) 设计自动化数据集构建流水线；3) 基于标普500前100成分股构建ECTs-100数据集，支持有据性与正确性双维度基准；4) 考察"自觉无能"(conscious incompetence)失败模式，即模型需识别证据不足并避免产生无支撑幻觉。
AI.result: 实证结果显示：LLM在有据性(groundedness)方面表现良好，但在正确性(correctness)方面存在显著局限；信息不足(informational insufficiency)构成额外挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可扩展、无需专家标注的有据性评估方案与ECTs-100基准，揭示了当前LLM在财务有据分析中"重引用、轻正确"的能力不对称，并指出信息不足场景下的"自觉无能"是亟待解决的实用失败模式。

title: An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design
summary:
We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.
  We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. Qualitative analysis showed that staged disclosure sometimes withheld inaccurate details, supported selective uptake, or allowed later recovery, though some errors still shaped revisions. Survey responses from a self-selected sample favored delayed disclosure and student agency but noted indirectness and repetition.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由教师引导的LLM教学代理，用于概念数据库设计中的脚手架式反馈；通过将隐藏的、基于学生作品诊断与面向学生支持的披露控制流程分离，并以四阶段工作流实现，在三个ERD环境和383个反馈回合中验证其有效性与局限性。
AI.motivation: 概念数据库设计（如ERD）需要及时且恰当的反馈，但直接给出答案会削弱学生自主建构；需要一种既能基于学生作品与教学要求进行诊断，又能控制反馈形式与披露程度的机制，以在支持学习与保留学生能动性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 构建教师引导的LLM教学代理并集成到ERD编辑器中，反馈依据学生作品、作业要求、教师编写的评分标准与教学资源。架构将隐藏的、基于作品的诊断与面向学生的支持形式及披露程度控制流程分离；实例化为四阶段工作流：概念检查、引导应用、低细节反馈、局部澄清。每次反馈请求形成与版本化ERD状态关联的有状态回合。
AI.result: 在三个ERD环境、383个反馈回合的部署中，71.1%可观察的目标层级修改完全或部分纳入了隐藏诊断目标，其中不少发生在第1–2阶段之后。定性分析显示分阶段披露有时会保留不准确细节、支持选择性采纳或允许后续纠正，但部分错误仍影响了修改。自选样本问卷偏好延迟披露与学生能动性，同时指出反馈存在间接性与重复性问题。
AI.conclusion: 将隐藏诊断与披露控制解耦的四阶段教学代理可在真实ERD设计场景中促进目标层级修改，并体现延迟披露与学生能动性优势；但分阶段披露可能带来间接、重复甚至错误引导，需要进一步优化反馈准确性与清晰度。

title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
summary: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个可复用的"匹配预算"审计框架，用于评估重标注图文语料的监督分布，在固定文本预算下给出五维画像，并在七个配对比较上验证其有效性，同时发布约4.9亿规模的多源重标注语料及审计产物。
AI.motivation: 重标注图文语料已成为文生图训练的标配，但由标注策略、标注器与源语料共同诱导的监督分布难以在语料规模上被审计：基于长度相关的代理指标会遗漏标注语域伪影，而下游T2I基准又会把语料与训练选择纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 提出面向重标注监督分布 D_{π,V_c,C} 的可复用匹配预算审计框架，在固定文本预算 B=64 下报告跨五个轴的画像，涵盖提示侧覆盖度、图像条件忠实度与标注表层健康度，并以"可主张可控基本单元（CBU）"作为统一的主张单位；在五个公开源语料上的七个配对比较中实例化该框架。
AI.result: 在四个跨语料配对中，所发布的表层在 Qwen 与 Gemma 两种评判器下，将每条标注所支持的 CBU 提升 +3.39 至 +6.36；在 CC12M 上，同一框架揭示出一个在两种评判器与四个预算下均一致的"长标注 vs 密集标注"前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可复用、与训练解耦的语料级审计框架，能够揭示长度代理与下游基准所掩盖的标注语域差异，并公开了经审计的多源重标注语料（约4.9亿）与审计产物包以供后续研究复用。

title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究学习型PTQ的顺序量化优化过程，发现MSE损失导致跨阶段"优化不平衡"，提出RMSE变体通过隐式梯度归一化解耦优化强度与重建损失尺度，显著优于MSE。
AI.motivation: SOTA的PTQ方法多为学习型，通过梯度下降优化辅助量化参数以最小化重建损失，常见做法是使用MSE作为损失函数，但其诱导的优化行为尚未被充分探索。作者希望深入理解学习型PTQ方案中的优化机制。
AI.method: 从顺序量化的整体视角出发，系统研究优化从第一个量化阶段到最后一个阶段的演化过程。通过覆盖代表性学习型PTQ方法、LLM家族、模型规模、架构、量化设置及多种任务的大量实证研究；理论上分析RMSE变体（在样本、通道、token、元素级别定义）的隐式梯度归一化特性。
AI.result: 一致地发现"优化不平衡"现象：重建损失量级在各阶段差异巨大，伴随MSE下高度不均匀的梯度量级和参数更新。作者将跨阶段损失量级范围称为"重建损失尺度"，并揭示MSE将该尺度转化为不均匀梯度，导致各量化阶段优化强度不均。理论上证明RMSE变体可自然实现解耦原则，作为即插即用替代显著优于MSE。
AI.conclusion: 提出改进学习型PTQ的一般原则：跨阶段的优化强度应与重建损失尺度解耦。RMSE变体通过隐式梯度归一化自然实现该原则，作为drop-in替代方案显著优于MSE。

title: MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory
summary: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. Empirical results on three widely used benchmarks, LoCoMo, MemGallery, and LongMemEval-S, show that MemFit achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing memory construction time and cost several-fold, providing a scalable and efficient solution for persistent agentic memory.

AI.tldr: MemFit 是一种面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，通过免 LLM 的逐字追加存储与多路径检索，在降低构建成本与时延的同时实现 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 长期记忆系统依赖 LLM 智能体组织与整合记忆，写入操作昂贵且低效；而采用压缩方式又会丢失表层细节。
AI.method: 将每一轮对话逐字存入仅追加存储，实现近乎瞬时、免 LLM 的插入；用片段摘要（而非替代原文）对轮次建立索引；并采用免 LLM 的多路径检索策略，融合词法与语义信号，对字幕增强的片段进行交叉编码器重排序，同时支持文本与多模态场景。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo、MemGallery、LongMemEval-S 三个常用基准上达到 SOTA 性能，同时将记忆构建时间与成本降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: MemFit 为持久化的智能体记忆提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。

title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
summary: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

AI.tldr: 本文将掩码扩散多模态大模型（MLLM）中答案候选的"回顾性稳定"与"令牌承诺"区分开，并相对于理由（rationale）生成过程考察两条时间线。在三个VQA基准上，单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa运行中，稳定时理由画布仍有89.4–98.1%未写出；块长从128减到8使V*Bench上该比例从89.4%降至1.7%。EOS启用提示下，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上分别提升15.0和19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench下降11.0个百分点。对称分解表明各变化的较大绝对分量来自覆盖率而非条件准确率；匹配画布图像消融则分离出视觉敏感性与答案稳定两种时间读数。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散MLLM中，答案候选可能在理由尚未展开时就已稳定，这使"答案稳定"容易被误读为"令牌承诺"。作者希望厘清两个独立时间过程——答案稳定与理由展开，并叠加视觉敏感性，从而准确解释提示与块长等设置对性能的影响来源。
AI.method: 提出区分"回顾性稳定"与"令牌承诺"两种时间时钟，并在三个VQA基准上考察它们相对理由生成的位置。通过改变块长度（128→8）、EOS抑制/启用及直接指令提示进行受控实验，测量稳定时理由画布未写比例、答案覆盖率与合格观测窗口。采用对称分解将性能变化拆分为覆盖率与条件准确率两部分，并用匹配画布图像消融测量视觉敏感性以分离两种时间读数。
AI.result: 单块、EOS抑制的LaViDa运行中，稳定时理由侧画布有89.4–98.1%未写；V*Bench上块长128→8使该比例由89.4%变为1.7%，同时改变答案覆盖率与合格观测窗口。EOS启用提示下，直接指令使Nemotron整体准确率在M3CoT和ScienceQA上分别提升15.0与19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench下降11.0个百分点。对称分解显示各变化的较大绝对分量归因于覆盖率而非条件准确率；匹配画布图像消融成功分离视觉敏感性与答案稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这些测量将答案稳定、理由展开与视觉敏感性三者区分开来，并识别出覆盖率是提示差异的较大来源。结果提示：以答案稳定判断模型"已决定"具有误导性，评估与干预应同时考虑理由展开进度和覆盖率。

title: Distilling Directional Verification
summary: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/directional-verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向性标签蒸馏，利用冻结教师模型在其已知方向对候选答案打分，将最优候选作为学生模型的训练目标，以缓解教师生成答案中方向性局限带来的误差传播。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏旨在将大语言模型的事实知识迁移到小模型以实现高效部署。但教师模型可能在某个方向能回忆出关系，却无法在反方向生成答案；若直接蒸馏其生成的答案，这种方向性局限会传递给学生。
AI.method: 冻结教师模型在它掌握的方向上对候选答案进行打分，选取得分最高的候选作为学生的训练标签。方法在父母-子女事实上进行验证，并与按请求方向打分（含经调优的名称先验校正）进行比较；还通过词汇相似度将生成答案匹配到固定姓名列表，检验学生复现标签的情况。
AI.result: 在父母子女事实上，已知方向打分比按请求方向打分产生更准确的标签，即使后者经过名称先验的调优校正。经先验校正后，更优方向取决于事实本身而非模板，并在显著实体为父母而非子女的挖掘事实上发生反转。在屏蔽被评估子女的正向事实后，使用已知方向标签训练的学生在其训练查询上的开放式准确率比使用先验校正反向标签的学生高13至15个百分点；匹配固定姓名列表后，学生几乎复现所有选定标签，其准确率大体随标签质量变化；该标签优势在未筛选查询及不插入正确答案的候选检索情形下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 方向性验证通过提供更准确的训练目标，缓解了教师生成答案中的误差向学生转移，表明利用教师已知方向进行打分是提升蒸馏标签质量的有效途径。

title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures. Project website and code: https://autosaddler-projectpage.github.io/activesaddler/
summary: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ActiveSaddler，将"训练场景/课程选择"视为 harness 优化的新维度，用非平稳 bandit 建模动态课程，使课程与 harness 协同演化，在 GAIA2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上显著提升 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 自动优化方法只关注"如何更新 harness"（提示词、工具接口、控制逻辑），却固定了"由哪些训练场景产生反馈"这一维度。然而随着 harness 演化，最有用的训练场景会发生变化，固定的场景顺序/课程会成为瓶颈，因此课程本身也应与 harness 一同自适应。
AI.method: 将缺失的"课程选择"维度形式化为自动课程学习问题，提出 ActiveSaddler：把演化中的课程建模为非平稳 bandit，动态实例化优化目标；将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的"失败模式臂"，估计对各失败模式继续训练所能带来的潜在学习进展，并自适应平衡"重访已知弱点"与"探索未见场景以发现新失败"；优化结果持续更新失败模式集合及其优先级，实现课程与 harness 的共同演化。
AI.result: 在 GAIA2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，相较于使用优化前固定场景顺序的同一 harness 优化器，ActiveSaddler 的测试 Pass@1 分别提升 4.4 与 7.5 个百分点。消融实验表明，增益依赖于动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用，以及平衡持续优化与新失败发现这三个要素。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自动课程学习应被视为 harness 优化的一个新关键维度：让训练课程与 harness 协同演化，可持续发现更强的 harness，优于固定场景课程的做法。

title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
summary: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

AI.tldr: 提出"攻击金字塔"五级捷径攻击框架，审计115个视频基准，发现大量基准存在可利用的捷径；据此构建可复现的审计池并发布840条最难验证题目的Video-Index基准。
AI.motivation: 视频基准应奖励其声称衡量的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据等捷径作弊，导致基准分数虚高、无法真实反映模型能力，因此需要系统性地审计并筛选出真正抗捷径的评测数据。
AI.method: 提出"攻击金字塔"（attack pyramid），即五级、对每个条目访问权限递增的捷径攻击；用其审计115个视频基准。对来自112个基准的505,518个问答对进行筛选，构建审计池。利用智能体将评测请求转化为规范，并通过带红队门控的确定性选择器组题，生成可复现的基准。视频探针用于检验时间信息利用情况。
AI.result: 35个基准上，从未看到任何帧的攻击者接近完整视频准确率；51个带时间探针的基准中，打乱帧顺序后中位数仍保留96%的完整视频准确率；63个基准中近重复问题至少占一半条目。发布Video-Index，含四个能力组各210条最难验证条目，共840条，来自76个来源。固定输入下，Claude Opus 5比所有开源模型高37个百分点以上，智能体工具再增约20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频基准普遍存在捷径漏洞，导致评测效度不足；通过攻击金字塔审计与红队门控筛选构建的Video-Index可提供更严格、可复现的评测。当前所有系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。

title: Scaling and Distilling Text Embeddings for Better Diffusibility
comment: 28 pages, 12 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/la0ka1/diffusing-scaled-text-embeddings
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language generation. Recent advances in continuous DLMs, which apply latent diffusion to continuous text embeddings, raise a practical question: which embedding makes the best latent space, i.e., the most diffusible? To answer this, we search through different embeddings and find that scaling the embedding model to stronger ones within the same family (T5 to T5Gemma-1 to T5Gemma-2) greatly improves generative performance. But the raw T5Gemma-2 embeddings are still not optimal. They are so discriminative that even the embeddings of plausible alternative words are separated, which makes the generation vulnerable to imperfect sampling. Consequently, continuous diffusion often fails to reach any of them and ends up at an invalid embedding instead. To address this, we distill T5Gemma-2 into a student encoder that learns the teacher's decoded probabilities as soft labels. Learning from such soft labels makes the student pull the alternative embeddings closer while maintaining the encoding-decoding mechanism. The distilled embeddings form a more connected and diffusible latent space, improving over the vanilla T5Gemma-2 embeddings. As a result, our medium-sized DLM achieves Gen. PPL 17.8 (against real-text PPL 15.4) at real-text entropy on OpenWebText, outperforming GPT-2-M on Gen. PPL.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究连续扩散语言模型(DLM)中何种文本嵌入最适合作为潜在空间，发现通过将T5Gemma-2蒸馏为学习教师解码概率软标签的学生编码器，可构建更连通、更可扩散的潜在空间，从而提升生成性能。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型将潜在扩散应用于连续文本嵌入，但一个关键实用问题是：哪种嵌入能构成最佳（最可扩散）的潜在空间。现有强嵌入模型（如T5Gemma-2）虽然生成性能更优，但其嵌入过于判别式——即使是合理的候选词嵌入也被相互分离，导致扩散过程易受不完美采样影响，往往无法命中任何有效嵌入而落到无效嵌入上。
AI.method: 作者首先在不同嵌入间进行搜索，发现同一族内将嵌入模型扩展为更强模型（T5→T5Gemma-1→T5Gemma-2）可显著提升生成性能。针对原始T5Gemma-2嵌入过于判别式的缺陷，提出将T5Gemma-2蒸馏为学生编码器：学生以教师解码概率作为软标签进行学习。软标签促使学生将候选（替代）词嵌入拉近，同时保留编码-解码机制，从而形成更连通、更可扩散的潜在空间。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的嵌入优于原始T5Gemma-2嵌入。在OpenWebText上，中型DLM在真实文本熵下取得Gen. PPL 17.8（真实文本PPL为15.4），在Gen. PPL上超越GPT-2-M。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入模型的选择与潜在空间的可扩散性对连续DLM生成质量至关重要。通过软标签蒸馏缓解强嵌入的过度判别性，可构建更连通、更易扩散的潜在空间，从而在生成性能上超越基线模型GPT-2-M。

title: OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework
summary: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

AI.tldr: 提出OSCAR框架，用Simulator-Coder-Reviewer三组件验证并迭代搜索LLM生成的优化模型，在保持高准确率的同时显著降低成本并支持本地部署。
AI.motivation: LLM可将业务描述转为优化模型，但可执行代码可能错误表达约束或目标，求解器会给出"错误问题的最优解"；即便方案满足既定规则，也可能存在更优计划。组织反复使用优化建模时，需要低成本、准确、且可本地运行的LLM框架；同时需解决如何验证改进、如何在价格与能力不同的LLM间分配尝试次数的问题。
AI.method: 提出OSCAR（Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer）：用经标注决策示例认证的离线Simulator比较候选方案，并不止于可行性而持续搜索。将寻找下一次认证改进的搜索建模为在难度不可观测下的序贯决策问题（调用哪些LLM、何时停止）。在已知先验的简化设定下给出代价有序升级最优的条件；对一般菜单推导先验无关的竞争性保证。
AI.result: 在五个基准问题上，OSCAR用两个可单GPU本地部署的小型开源权重LLM达到95%–100%准确率，而两者单次尝试准确率平均仅29%和48%。每个问题五次运行中，Codex与Claude Code的平均token成本分别为OSCAR的3.1倍和5.8倍。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR支持开源权重模型本地或云端部署，取决于预算与保密要求。企业应维护可行/不可行决策的标注示例以澄清自然语言运营规则，并在LLM解释与之冲突时以标签为准。随着LLM能力与价格变化，OSCAR的简单操作规则与可调设置有助于企业适配模型选择并受益于技术进展。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出前馈、无需相机位姿的多视角3D空间关系分割新任务，并设计了RelationVGGT框架，融合视觉基础模型语义特征与3D几何基础模型表示，通过关系transformer实现跨视角关系预测，还构建了基于ScanNet++的自动标注流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建已从逐场景优化发展到前馈推理，语义场景理解也相应进步，但现有方法局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽略了物体之间的空间关系。同时该任务在前馈、无位姿、多视角设定下缺乏训练数据。
AI.method: 提出RelationVGGT前馈框架：整合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表示；利用关系transformer进行以主体为条件的跨视角关系预测；无需逐场景优化，也无需已知相机位姿。此外，基于ScanNet++结合VLM与LLM构建全自动标注流水线，用于可扩展地生成该新任务的训练数据。
AI.result: 构建了面向新任务的自动化标注流水线，可规模化生成训练数据（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了前馈、无位姿多视角3D空间关系分割这一新任务，RelationVGGT在无需逐场景优化与相机位姿的情况下完成跨视角关系目标分割，并通过自动标注流水线为该任务提供可扩展训练数据。

title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
summary: Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to $+7.41\%$, with co-evolving ($+5.03\%$) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone ($+2.83\%$). Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/FloWright/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FloWright，将工作流作为"训练骨架(harness)"来优化多智能体工作流：通过分层、结构感知的奖励范式，使单个角色可自我演化、多个角色可协同演化；并提出数据增强方法 DataWright，将已有数据集转化为更难的工作流级任务。在文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学与金融任务上，小规模开源模型性能最多提升 +7.41%，且多角色协同演化(+5.03%)优于仅优化单一角色(+2.83%)。
AI.motivation: 单一LLM难以应对复杂真实任务，多智能体工作流通过协调专用智能体协作来解决。现有方法训练LLM从执行结果中构建更好的工作流，但只优化工作流生成器，其他负责构建或执行工作流的智能体保持固定，而结果实际依赖所有智能体。仅训练生成器之外的扩展存在困难：智能体之间相互耦合，且工作流结果仅为一个稀疏的全局分数，无法定位哪个智能体导致失败。同时，现有工作流通常在单个智能体已能处理的数据上训练和评估，难度不足。
AI.method: FloWright：将工作流本身作为优化多智能体的"harness"，引入分层、结构感知的奖励范式，把原本稀疏的单一结果分数分解为可归因到各角色的信号，从而支持一个角色自我演化(self-evolve)、两个及以上角色协同演化(co-evolve)，且无需额外模型、标注或执行。DataWright：自适应数据硬化(adaptive data hardening)，将现有数据集转换为难度更高的工作流级任务，以解决训练/评估数据过于简单的问题。
AI.result: 在文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学和金融等任务上，用 FloWright 训练的小型开源模型性能最多提升 +7.41%；多角色协同演化带来 +5.03% 提升，优于仅优化单一角色的 +2.83%。
AI.conclusion: 超越仅训练工作流生成器的范式，通过分层结构感知奖励实现多角色协同演化，并配合数据硬化提升任务难度，可在无需额外模型、标注或执行的前提下显著提升多智能体工作流性能，且角色间协同优化比单角色优化收益更大。

title: Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks
summary: Choosing an agent system means choosing both a language model and the harness through which it acts. We ask whether a strong model, harness, or pairing stays strong when the setting changes. We evaluate 66 configurations: four configurable harnesses (OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness, PI, and openJiuwen) paired with five models on TUA-Bench, ALE-CLI, and Terminal-Bench 4, plus the native Codex-GPT and Claude Code-Claude pairings. Model rankings reverse across harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 4, Claude leads GPT by 7.94 points in OpenHands but trails it by 30.16 points in PI. For four of the five models, the best harness changes from one benchmark to another, yet some pairings hold: openJiuwen gives Kimi its highest score on all three benchmarks, by 5.61 to 11.11 points. A model's own vendor harness is not reliably its best, and higher cost does not reliably buy a higher score. On Terminal-Bench 4, GPT scores higher under PI than under DSH at less than a quarter of the cost per task. Matched trajectories suggest why fit varies. Models start almost all repairs themselves, so much depends on whether the harness hands failures back in a form the model can use. GPT does best with PI's lean scaffold, while Kimi, which often issues malformed tool calls, does best in openJiuwen. We argue that the model, the harness, and the task should be evaluated together, and we release the harness adapters, evaluation code, and all 6,204 scored trajectories at https://github.com/liyix/finding-the-right-fit and https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixuanli97/finding-the-right-fit.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过66种「模型×harness」配置在三个基准上的评测发现：模型排名会随harness反转，harness与任务的适配性无法可靠地由厂商绑定或成本推断，主张三者应被联合评估。
AI.motivation: 选择智能体系统实际上同时选择了语言模型和其执行所依赖的harness。作者质疑「强模型、强harness或强组合在任何场景下都强」这一隐含假设，希望检验性能排名是否随设置变化而稳健。
AI.method: 评测66种配置：4个可配置harness（OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen）× 5个模型，外加Codex-GPT与Claude Code-Claude的原生配对，测试基准为TUA-Bench、ALE-CLI和Terminal-Bench 4；并通过匹配轨迹（matched trajectories）分析适配性差异的成因。
AI.result: 模型排名在harness间发生反转：Terminal-Bench 4上Claude在OpenHands中领先GPT 7.94分，但在PI中落后30.16分。五个模型中四个的最佳harness随基准变化；但部分组合稳定，如openJiuwen让Kimi在三个基准上均取得最高分，提升5.61至11.11分。厂商自有harness并非最优，更高成本也不必然带来更高分：GPT在PI下比DSH得分更高且单任务成本不到其四分之一。
AI.conclusion: 匹配轨迹显示，模型几乎自行启动所有修复，因此harness能否以模型可用形式回传失败信息至关重要：GPT适配PI的轻量脚手架，而常产生畸形工具调用的Kimi则在openJiuwen中表现最佳。作者主张模型、harness与任务应联合评估，并开源harness适配器、评测代码及全部6,204条带分轨迹。

title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
summary: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"概念到示例的视频检索"问题，即教师用抽象科学概念而非画面描述来检索纪录片片段。为此提出概念驱动域适应（CDDA）三阶段框架，将概念作为中间语义锚点来适配双塔视觉-语言模型，在中学物理检索基准上取得优于多个多模态基线的概念检索性能。
AI.motivation: 科学教师检索纪录片片段时，通常查询的是想要讲授的抽象概念，而非屏幕上的可见内容。现有基于语言的视频时刻检索方法普遍假设查询描述的是可观察事件，无法满足教学中"检索体现科学原理的具体视觉现象"这一需求。这构成了一个概念到示例（concept-to-example）的检索难题：紧凑的课程概念必须落在时间上稀疏的纪录片证据上，抽象需求与具体素材之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出概念驱动域适应（CDDA）三阶段框架，用于将双塔视觉-语言模型适配到概念级检索，将概念作为中间语义锚点：第一阶段用教科书与教师手册中的"示例-概念"对来结构化文本嵌入空间；第二阶段在冻结视觉编码器的条件下，把这种概念感知的几何结构迁移到纪录片视觉表示；第三阶段利用稀疏的视觉概念监督对两个编码器进行联合适配。从几何角度看，这种分阶段对齐缩小了文本-概念与视觉-概念之间的角度差，在促进概念级适配的同时保留了预训练模型对具体图像描述的匹配能力。
AI.result: 在一个专门整理的中学物理检索基准上，CDDA 在面向教学的概念检索任务上优于多个有竞争力的多模态基线（包括 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B），同时适配后仍能保持具体的图文匹配性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作形式化了"概念到示例视频检索"这一抽象针-海捞问题，并提出以概念为语义锚点的三阶段域适应框架 CDDA，证明概念级几何对齐可在不牺牲原有图文对齐的前提下实现教学导向检索，为抽象概念驱动的视频检索提供了有效方案。

title: LawCompass: Navigating from Legal QA to Multi-Agent Deep Research with Grounded Evidence
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have significantly democratized access to legal information. Nevertheless, most existing legal assistants remain confined to multi-turn conversational QA, failing to support complex legal tasks that require systematic evidence retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and report-level synthesis. In this paper, we present LawCompass, an evidence-grounded legal assistant that navigates the transition from standard Legal QA to multi-agent deep research. LawCompass provides three task-oriented functions: Legal QA, which delivers precise, evidence-backed answers to legal questions; Professional Retrieval, which enables structured exploration of statutes and judicial cases via query rewriting; and Deep Research, which employs a multi-agent workflow to decompose complex legal tasks and synthesize comprehensive research reports. Crucially, LawCompass maintains explicit citation links across all modules, empowering users to directly verify system outputs against original legal sources. Evaluation results demonstrate that LawCompass provides a practical and scalable paradigm for transforming conversational AI into trustworthy and evidence-grounded legal research assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LawCompass，一个证据可溯源的法律助手，实现从标准法律问答到多智能体深度研究的转变，包含法律问答、专业检索与深度研究三大功能，并通过显式引文链接保障可验证性。
AI.motivation: 现有法律助手多局限于多轮对话式问答，无法支持需要系统性证据检索、多步推理与报告级综合的复杂法律任务。
AI.method: LawCompass 提供三项任务导向功能：(1) 法律问答，给出精准且有证据支撑的回答；(2) 专业检索，通过查询重写实现法条与判例的结构化探索；(3) 深度研究，采用多智能体工作流分解复杂法律任务并合成研究报告；各模块均保持显式引文链接。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，LawCompass 为将对话式 AI 转变为可信、证据可溯源的法律研究辅助，提供了实用且可扩展的范式。
AI.conclusion: LawCompass 展示了从法律问答向多智能体深度研究的可行路径，借助全程引文可溯源机制提升系统输出的可信度与可验证性。

title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a demonstration abstract in the Proceedings of COMMA 2026. Code at https://github.com/idaks/ABDA-NL and live demo at https://demo.abda-nl.org
summary: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

AI.tldr: ABDA-NL 为基于 ASPIC- 知识库与 grounded 语义的论证系统 ABDA 增加自然语言接口，由大语言模型负责在语言与形式化表示之间搭桥，而确定性 ABDA 引擎仍是论证、攻击与接受标签的唯一来源。
AI.motivation: 降低形式化论证系统的使用门槛：用户通常难以直接理解 grounded 语义下的接受/拒绝/未定结论及其理由，也难以用形式语言修改假设、规则和偏好。
AI.method: 在 ABDA 之上构建自然语言接口：用户可查看结论的接受、拒绝或未定状态，打开 grounded 讨论博弈的交互式渲染以理解原因，通过暂停假设与规则或更改偏好来探索 what-if 替代方案，就场景参考文档提问，并用自然英语撰写新事实、假设和规则。大语言模型负责从文档和场景当前状态回答问题，并将自然语言编辑翻译为候选形式化陈述；所有模型提议均需经系统验证并由用户确认后才生效。
AI.result: 实现了语言层与形式化层的分离：LLM 仅承担问答与翻译，论证、攻击和接受标签仍由确定性 ABDA 引擎计算，保证了形式化推理结果的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: ABDA-NL 以用户确认和验证机制约束 LLM 输出，在保持论证结果确定性的同时提供了可解释、可交互、可编辑的自然语言操作方式。

title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

AI.tldr: VIEScore2：一种统一的图像生成/编辑评估器，将图像表示为N×N网格，单次前向即可同时输出质量分数与缺陷位置，并通过GRPO后训练强化定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像评估器通常只给出一个标量质量分，无法指出支撑该分数的图像区域，缺乏可解释性与空间定位能力；同时图像生成与编辑任务（含可选条件图像）缺少统一的评估接口。
AI.method: 将图像表示为N×N网格的文本原生（text-native）表示，单模型单次前向联合预测质量分数与缺陷位置；该网格表示提供异构空间监督的统一接口并支持直接可验证的后训练目标。训练数据38K，覆盖仅分数、仅定位、联合监督三类，跨生成与编辑任务。以监督微调为起点，进一步用GRPO优化缺陷定位，奖励由单元格级Dice重叠、分数准确性和输出格式有效性组合而成；另用无参数解析器将结构化预测转为可读解释。
AI.result: 主测试集上总体分数SRCC达0.601，高于最强零样本通用VLM基线Gemini-3-Flash的0.491（输入匹配条件下）。缺陷定位方面，在六个基准中有三个的逐图像网格IoU优于通用VLM与专用空间评估器，五个基准进入前三，且包含训练来源之外的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 统一的质量评分与缺陷定位可经文本原生网格表示在单一模型中实现，配合GRPO与组合奖励可有效提升空间定位，并具备一定的跨数据集泛化能力，为可解释的合成图像评估提供了可行范式。

title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 12th International Conference on Collaboration and Internet Computing (CIC)
summary: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. Strict filtering and token-length adjustment change these patterns without reconciling them. In the Gemma set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 71.7% to 83.3% (+11.7 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval +1.7 to +21.7); in the GPT-OSS-120B set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 51.7% to 56.7% (+5.0 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval -6.7 to +16.7), and every primary single-score GPT-OSS-120B interval includes zero. These findings tie score interpretation and decision value to the predictor and candidate set.

title: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

AI.tldr: 该论文研究智能体轨迹监督微调中"获取新能力"与"保留原有能力"之间的权衡，提出 Privilege-Guided SFT（PG-SFT），利用轨迹的轮次级信息增益调整监督强度，从而在少量牺牲目标任务性能的前提下显著降低分布漂移与通用能力退化。
AI.motivation: 在离线智能体轨迹上做 SFT 是训练专用工具调用智能体的标准做法，但逐 token 强制模仿推理与动作会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用、代码生成等能力。已有做法（KL 惩罚、限制更新幅度）均未能避免这种回归，说明仅"是否锚定基座行为"不足以解决该问题，还需研究"在哪里、以多大强度偏离基座行为"。
AI.method: 提出 PG-SFT（Privilege-Guided SFT）：受近期 token 级自适应学习目标启发，以智能体轨迹的轮次级（turn-level）信息增益作为指标，自适应地调节监督强度，而非对所有 token 均匀施加监督。基线包括标准 SFT、KL 惩罚约束分布漂移、限制更新幅度等方法。
AI.result: 标准 SFT 提升目标任务基准，却使多个非目标基准分数下降；KL 惩罚与限制更新幅度均未阻断这一退化趋势。PG-SFT 在所评估基准上取得更优的观测权衡：大幅减少分布漂移与广域能力退化，代价是目标任务性能略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 获取—保留权衡的平衡不仅取决于模型是否被锚定于基座行为，还取决于监督应在何处、以多强强度偏离该行为。轮次级信息增益可作为调节监督强度的有效信号。

title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
summary: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

AI.tldr: 提出WYS框架，通过引入文本条件缓解视频到语音合成的一对多映射问题，在LRS2/LRS3上取得最优的视听同步性能并保持竞争性WER。
AI.motivation: 视频到语音合成需从静音说话人脸视频生成自然且音素准确的语音，但视觉动态信息不足，存在固有的一对多映射问题，导致生成语音的确定性不足。引入文本作为显式语言线索可缓解视觉歧义。
AI.method: WYS框架包含基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列协同整合；并采用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）目标实现高保真语音生成。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3数据集上，WYS取得优越性能，在视听同步指标（LSE-C/D）上刷新最优结果，同时保持极具竞争力的文本准确率（WER）；主观评测确认生成语音接近人类自然度。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件在内容可控的视频到语音合成中有效，验证了以显式语言线索缓解视觉歧义、提升合成保真度与同步性的可行性与优越性。

title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/task_operator.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Task Operator（TO），将 ICL 的前向过程建模为注意力头输出的仿射变换，并将其解析地重放为注意力输出投影的更新，从而在无需完整示例上下文的情况下近似 ICL，并在多类任务上优于已有压缩方法。
AI.motivation: ICL 每次推理都需处理全部示例，部署效率低，且其机制尚不完全清楚。已有压缩工作将 ICL 压缩为从特定层或位置提取的固定激活向量，但这些与输入无关的干预在输出依赖细粒度输入交互的复杂任务上失效。
AI.method: 作者分析 ICL 前向传播，发现每个注意力头的输出是其上下文掩码对应输出的仿射变换，且该变换参数在给定任务的样本间经验稳定。据此提出 Task Operator（TO），将该变换作为解析推导的更新重放到注意力输出投影上，从而以任务算子替代完整示例上下文。
AI.result: 在词汇、算法和推理任务上，TO 在已有方法中取得最佳整体性能，并显著缩小了零样本推理与 ICL 之间的差距。此外，提取的知识集中在跨层和位置的特定稀疏电路上，且对来自不相交示例批次的算子取平均可实现有效的 many-shot 扩展而无需扩展上下文窗口。
AI.conclusion: TO 通过解析地重放注意力输出的任务相关仿射变换，将 ICL 压缩为任务算子，兼顾效率与复杂任务性能，并揭示了 ICL 知识的稀疏电路分布及无需扩展上下文的 many-shot 扩展能力。

title: Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation
comment: Accepted at TAS 2026 (AAAI Fall Symposium Series), Nov 5-7, 2026, Arlington VA
summary: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

AI.tldr: 论文指出AI代码生成时代的瓶颈已从"写代码"转向"监督写代码的系统"，并揭示其中的"词汇鸿沟"：领域要求"人类监督"却未区分语言的两种功能——协调行动（控制论式）与协调理解（认识论式）。作者提出：把解释形态的输出用于控制论目的（为获得认可而非求真）即是失败所在。据此提出治理判据——每个重要选择都应携带"若非如此会怎样"的可第三方检验条件，并给出操作性形式（两部分重建测试）与记录约定（ORRCF）。
