AI.motivation: 随着代码生成日益委托给AI系统，瓶颈从编写代码转为监督书写代码的系统，CS教育研究者已开始命名这一转变。该转变暴露出一个词汇鸿沟：领域呼吁"人类监督"，却没有在语言于委托通道中所做的两件事之间建立可用的区分——协调行动（控制论：词语成功在于世界与其相符）与协调理解（认识论：成功在于应答世界且听者能核验其是否应答）。若缺乏此区分，监督可能退化为橡皮图章。
AI.method: 概念分析与框架提出。区分控制论语言与认识论形态语言，指出失败不是控制论语言本身，而是认识论形态语言在做控制论工作。通过三个委托片段（作为示例而非受控证据）展示认识论参与可行且可审计，包含一个公共记录中依据自身陈述条件撤回建议的案例，以及一个失败案例：监督对其自由裁量选择不要求给出理由。提出治理判据，并给出两部分重建测试（由第二读者能否预测智能体在扰动下的行为来为委托记录打分）与审议记录约定ORRCF。
AI.result: 提出一项智能体系统治理判据（与既有技术信任属性并列）：每一个重要选择都应携带其在何种条件下会得出不同结果的条件，且以第三方可检验的形式呈现。给出该判据的操作化形式：两部分重建测试，按第二读者能否预测智能体在扰动下的行为对委托记录打分。并提出审议记录约定ORRCF，使该条件成为每条记录选择的必需组成部分。示例显示认识论参与可实践且保持可审计。
AI.conclusion: 没有这种条件，第三方无法区分一个决策与橡皮图章；仅为"输出是否被批准"的监督可被盖章所满足，而要求问责的监督必须使智能体推理可检索、可核验。该判据与ORRCF为智能体系统治理提供了可操作的问责框架。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练稀疏注意力方法 VASC，通过值感知块选择与执行感知跨层记忆，在固定计算预算下提升 VGGT 类前馈 3D 视觉模型的效率与精度。
AI.motivation: VGGT 等前馈 3D 视觉模型统一了相机估计与稠密场景重建，但其二次复杂度全局注意力对长图像序列代价高昂；现有稀疏方法倾向于选择注意力高但价值冗余的区域，导致计算浪费与信息损失。
AI.method: VASC 为免训练稀疏注意力，包含两部分：(1) 值感知块选择，将池化后的 query–key 相关性（pooled query–key relevance）与邻域值对比度（neighboring value contrast）结合，减少冗余同时保留与查询相关且具区分度的内容；(2) 执行感知跨层记忆（execution-aware cross-layer memory），跟踪各层未被服务的需求，并依据实际执行更新该状态，使此前被忽略的块能在固定计算预算下参与竞争。
AI.result: 在 7Scenes 与 NeuralRGB-D 数据集上，结合 VGGT 和 π³ 进行实验，相比 FasterVGGT 在位姿估计与重建质量上均有提升，推理速度最高达稠密 VGGT 的 2.29 倍。
AI.conclusion: VASC 以免训练方式缓解了前馈 3D 视觉模型中全局注意力的二次开销与稀疏选择偏差问题，兼顾效率与精度，并已开源代码。

title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
summary: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

AI.tldr: JOINGR是一种将数据库连接图作为检索空间的表检索方法，通过在图上选择语义相似的锚表并沿类型化边进行查询条件化遍历，聚合边得分为表得分，在BEAVER等需要多跳表的基准上显著优于稠密检索与重排序基线。
AI.motivation: 在真实数据库的Text-to-SQL任务中，检索正确的表是前提。现有稠密表检索器独立地对模式元素打分，忽略了一个关键证据来源：某些必需的表并未在问题中被提及，只能通过其与已相关表的连接关系才能被识别出来。
AI.method: 提出JOINGR，将数据库连接图视为检索空间。列作为图节点，表内关系与外键关系作为类型化边。给定问题，先选择语义相似的锚表，使用查询条件化的打分器沿连接边遍历，并将得到的边沉积聚合为表得分。该打分器是构建在冻结的查询、节点与边嵌入之上的轻量级MLP，并以针对金标准表的成对间隔损失（pairwise margin loss）训练。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider数据集上，JOINGR与最强检索基线相比具有竞争力；在具有多跳表需求的企业级挑战性基准BEAVER上，其召回率显著优于稠密检索与重排序基线。跨域实验表明，所学的打分器可在不同基准间迁移，说明该方法捕捉到了可复用的连接图遍历行为。
AI.conclusion: 将连接图作为检索空间并显式建模连接关系，能有效识别问题中未提及但必需的表，提升多跳场景下的表检索召回，且所学的遍历打分器具有良好的跨域可迁移性。

title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VeriHarness，将LLM转化为具备工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能的智能体验证器，通过"分歧解析器"与"共识挑战者"提升长时程任务的验证能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体承担的任务日益复杂、时程更长，其输出验证愈发困难；且在测试时无法获得参考答案或评分标准，如何在固定基座模型下增强验证能力成为关键问题。
AI.method: 首先观察到：多次采样的rollout之间的分歧常暴露正确备选答案，而共识则可能掩盖错误。基于此提出VeriHarness，赋予生成所用LLM工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能，使其成为智能体验证器；其中分歧解析器依据环境证据核查相互竞争的断言，共识挑战者则检验共享断言并搜寻被遗漏的需求，二者结论指导最终产物的选择与修订。
AI.result: 在五个长时程工作区基准与两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness在评测基线中取得最高选择分数；基于证据的修订进一步提升平均表现，相较单次rollout分别提升6.2分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）和6.4分（Claude Opus 4.8）。验证技能还可从失败反馈中自我改进。
AI.conclusion: VeriHarness是一种新颖且关键的长时程智能体验证扩展方法。作者公开约26,000条rollout（覆盖五个基准与两个模型，成本超10万美元），以支持未来智能体验证研究。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

AI.tldr: FutureWorlds 框架统一了候选未来构建、历史维护与相对质量学习，通过多样束搜索、候选专属有界记忆与 MemSPO 策略优化，显著提升机器人世界模型的预测质量与运动一致性。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型可预测动作条件下的未来场景，但将候选预测转化为有效学习信号存在两大困难：候选间过于相似导致质量比较信息量不足；候选轨迹发散时需要持续维护各自独立的历史状态。
AI.method: 基于多模态离散自回归模型构建。在强化学习中使用多样束搜索（diverse beam search）生成兼顾置信度与多样性的候选未来；引入候选专属有界记忆（candidate-specific bounded memory）保存场景状态，确保生成与策略打分使用一致的历史；提出 MemSPO（记忆条件搜索引导策略优化），将视频轨迹奖励转化为组相对优势以优化世界模型。
AI.result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 上，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 相比各数据集最强基线分别降低 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%；固定评测配置下仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时域的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评测表明增益超越视觉质量，体现在更准确的运动预测与更一致的对象状态。
AI.conclusion: FutureWorlds 通过统一候选构建、历史维护与相对质量学习，有效提升了机器人世界模型的预测能力，且增益具有跨数据集、跨评测维度的稳健性，为动作结果理解提供了更强基础。

title: Probe with Participation Trophies: Random-Reward RL as a Probe of LLM Capability
summary: We connect the spurious-reward paradox to a model's reachability and propose random-reward reinforcement learning (RL) as a useful tool for the probing enterprise, addressing a decade-long debate over what probing performance actually reveals about a model. There are two prevailing explanations for the surprising finding that even random rewards can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs): one attributes the gains to particular mechanisms within RL training; the other to data contamination. Our results motivate a different view: spurious-reward RL can probe a model's reachability, or what further training can attain from its current state under specified constraints, beyond what is reflected in its current performance. Two OLMo checkpoints with the same accuracy on synthetic arithmetic (3.5%), for example, reach 8.5% and 55% in their best runs under the same correctness-rewarded RL. Examining OLMo checkpoints across pre-training and mid-training reveals three distinct regimes of training response: early on, RL produces little improvement even when correct answers are rewarded; later in pre-training, rewarding correct answers becomes effective while random rewards remain weak; and, upon entering mid-training, even random rewards can produce large gains. A similar ordering appears in a number-masked supervised fine-tuning (SFT) analysis of these checkpoints, suggesting that the pattern is not specific to a particular RL mechanism. Moreover, RL with random rewards offers a distinctive perspective on what training can make an LLM do, since its reward signal supplies no information about which answers are correct. By asking what training can attain without correctness feedback, it addresses the label-leakage side of a central problem in decodability-based probing: whether a successful probe reveals the model's capabilities or learns the task itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"虚假奖励悖论"与模型的可达性（reachability）联系起来，提出用随机奖励强化学习（RL）作为探测模型能力的工具，为"探测性能究竟揭示了模型什么"这一长达十年的争论提供了新视角。
AI.motivation: 学界对于"即使随机奖励也能提升大语言模型（LLM）性能"这一反直觉现象存在两种主流解释：一是归因于RL训练中的某些特定机制，二是归因于数据污染。作者认为这两种解释都不充分，希望提出第三种视角。
AI.method: 作者以OLMo检查点为实验对象，采用随机奖励RL和正确性奖励RL进行对比。具体地，比较合成算术任务上准确率相同（3.5%）的两个OLMo检查点，在相同正确奖励RL下的最佳表现；并跨预训练与中期训练阶段考察OLMo检查点的训练响应；此外还进行了数字掩码监督微调（SFT）分析以验证该模式是否依赖于特定RL机制。
AI.result: 两个在合成算术上准确率均为3.5%的OLMo检查点，在相同正确奖励RL下的最佳运行中分别达到8.5%和55%。跨预训练和中期训练的OLMo检查点呈现三种不同的训练响应区间：早期即使奖励正确答案，RL也几乎无提升；预训练后期，奖励正确答案开始有效而随机奖励仍然微弱；进入中期训练后，随机奖励也能带来大幅增益。数字掩码SFT分析中出现了类似的顺序，说明该模式并非特定RL机制所独有。
AI.conclusion: 虚假奖励RL可以探测模型的可达性，即在特定约束下从当前状态出发进一步训练所能达到的潜力，这超出了当前性能所反映的范围。随机奖励RL不提供关于答案正确性的信息，因而能问出"没有正确性反馈时训练能达到什么"，从而回应了基于可解码性探测中的核心问题——成功的探测是揭示了模型能力，还是学会了任务本身（标签泄漏）。

title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
summary: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

AI.tldr: RISED利用跨环境共享的评分量表（rubric）文本反馈，指导在线数据选择与策略监督，在多环境LLM智能体联合训练中取得最高平均通过率。
AI.motivation: 多环境联合训练通用LLM智能体时，现有课程与数据选择策略多停留在环境层级或基于局部标量奖励，未显式建模跨环境rollout之间的关系；且各环境学习速率不同，同一批次内会同时存在全失败与全成功组，导致这些数据缺乏组内相对奖励信号。
AI.method: 将rubric从奖励用途扩展为数据选择与策略监督信号：用LLM评判器按跨环境共享的rubric词表为每条rollout打标签；所得行为画像用于选择与混合环境批次整体行为构成一致、且与已选数据重叠最小的数据；正向rubric（期望行为）作为特权上下文供on-policy自蒸馏教师提供token级监督；负向rubric（不良行为）引导后续rollout生成规避重复失败模式。各组件构成RISED。
AI.result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED取得跨环境最高的平均通过率，并在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二；基于rubric的分析可刻画与性能提升相伴的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 标量奖励在多环境RL中存在信息局限（缺少跨环境关系与组内对比），而rubric式文本反馈可同时服务于数据选择与策略监督，有效提升多环境通用智能体的性能并提供可解释的行为分析。

title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出GPT与ASH两项无需训练的设计：GPT通过虚拟提示批处理将N个文本提示的图像编码成本从O(N)降至O(1)，ASH用重叠时序分块与基于IoU的跨块身份匹配把任意记忆-注意力式VIS跟踪器扩展到任意长度视频。二者在SAM3上实例化为SAM3-ASH，在MOTS20上于完全零样本条件下取得SOTA HOTA，并在七个额外基准上媲美训练专用方法，峰值显存低于25 GB，为可扩展、免训练的视频自动标注建立了实用基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆-注意力的视频实例分割方法具备较强零样本跟踪能力，但内存需求大，只能处理短片段；其单提示推理设计使多类别的开放词汇跟踪在计算上难以承受。该工作旨在实现任意视频的全自动跟踪标注，解决内存受限与多类别推理代价过高的问题。
AI.method: 提出两项组件：1）Generalized Presence Token（GPT），重构SAM3的推理流程，通过虚拟提示批处理（virtual prompt batching）同时处理N个文本提示，在不修改任何已学习组件的前提下将图像编码成本由O(N)降为O(1)。2）Annotation and Segmentation Handler（ASH），通过重叠时序分块与基于IoU的跨块身份匹配，将任意记忆-注意力式VIS跟踪器扩展到任意长度序列，且无需数据集特定训练。二者在SAM3上实例化为SAM3-ASH。
AI.result: 在完全零样本条件下，SAM3-ASH于MOTS20上取得SOTA HOTA，并在七个额外基准上与训练专用方法保持竞争力，峰值GPU显存占用低于25 GB。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可扩展、免训练的全自动视频标注提供了实用基线，将多提示开放词汇推理与长视频跟踪统一在无需训练与低显存的框架内。

title: Precision over Scale: A Polish-Silesian Benchmark and a Translation System Outperforming Open-Source and Commercial Models
summary: Dialectal machine translation remains challenging due to limited data and strong linguistic variation not captured by standard benchmarks, which often assume standardized and well-edited text. We study Polish-Silesian MT using neural and rule-based systems, evaluating on SiLTT - a new Pol-Szl testset, alongside established BOUQuET and FLORES benchmarks. Results show our rule-based system is consistently strongest on SiLTT and BOUQuET datasets and that TranslateGemma fine-tuned on a curated dataset improves over strong neural baselines but does not surpass the rule-based system in dialectal settings. We release SiLTT and our best neural model to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究波兰语-西里西亚语方言机器翻译，构建新测试集SiLTT，比较神经与规则系统，发现规则系统在方言场景下始终最强，而微调后的TranslateGemma优于强神经基线但未超越规则系统。
AI.motivation: 方言机器翻译面临数据稀缺和强烈语言变异问题，而标准基准通常假设文本已标准化且经过良好编辑，无法充分反映方言特性，因此需要专门的研究与评测资源。
AI.method: 以波兰语-西里西亚语翻译为研究对象，采用神经与规则两类系统进行对比；构建新测试集SiLTT，并结合已有BOUQuET与FLORES基准进行评测；同时在精选数据集上微调TranslateGemma模型。
AI.result: 规则系统在SiLTT和BOUQuET上表现一致最优；微调后的TranslateGemma优于强神经基线，但在方言场景中未能超过规则系统。
AI.conclusion: 在方言机器翻译中，规则方法仍具竞争力，神经模型尚难全面超越；作者发布SiLTT及最佳神经模型以支持后续研究。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了大语言模型（LLM）在航空出行、餐厅与消费品三个偏好领域所生成的分布，发现模型内部具有自洽性（self-coherence），但跨模型族与参数规模存在显著不一致（discordance），表明输出更依赖模型选择而非提示词措辞。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益被用作模拟、合成数据生成与决策支持的生成器，尤其在缺乏真实数据的场景中。但其所产生概率分布的结构与可靠性仍缺乏系统研究，且学界常默认能力足够的 LLM 会产生相似的偏好分布，这一假设需要检验。
AI.method: 系统分析 LLM 生成的偏好分布，覆盖 9 个开放权重模型、3 个选择领域（航空出行、餐厅、消费品）；通过重复采样考察最可能结果的稳定性（自洽性），并比较不同模型族与不同规模之间的分布差异；同时进行温度变化、贪心解码、提示词与选项顺序扰动等稳健性检验。
AI.result: 所有模型均表现出自洽性，最可能结果在重复采样下迅速稳定；但跨模型族与跨规模存在明显不一致，即使比较各自最可能的结果也缺乏共识。上述模式在温度变化、贪心解码及提示词、顺序扰动下均保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: LLM 生成的偏好分布结果更多受模型选择影响，而非提示词措辞影响。这挑战了"能力足够的 LLM 可作为调查受访者替代品并产生相似偏好分布"的常见假设，提示将 LLM 用于模拟人类偏好时需谨慎对待模型的选取与可迁移性。

title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
summary: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个生成可扩展、可控物理交互合成数据集的框架，通过状态引导采样（SGS）利用显式起止状态图像作为视觉锚点生成无伪影视频，并建立与人类判断一致的自动化评估系统，微调后显著提升视频模型的合理交互生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以呈现合理的物理交互及其状态转换，这是机器人、VR/AR等应用的关键瓶颈。核心问题在于缺乏可控、可扩展的交互数据，以及朴素条件生成易产生伪影。
AI.method: 1）构建基于结构化分类法和先进图像编辑模型的流水线，生成显式的"起始"与"结束"状态图像作为交互的视觉锚点；2）提出状态引导采样（State-Guided Sampling, SGS），一种缓解朴素条件生成伪影的新采样技术，以这些锚点生成无缝视频；3）开发并验证一套与人类判断对齐的自动化评估系统以保障数据质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，在所得数据集上微调基础模型可显著增强其生成合理物理交互的能力；同时提出并验证的自动化评估系统与人类判断保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过状态锚点驱动的数据生成与SGS采样，为视频模型提供了可扩展的可控交互数据方案，并配套可信的自动化评估，有效提升了模型对物理交互与状态转换的建模能力，对机器人、VR/AR等应用具有实用价值。

title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the corpus and draft-length policies that existing retrieval engines lack in coding-agent pipelines. AgSpec retrieves from session, workspace, and global corpora, retaining the ongoing session trajectory and indexing opened files in the agent's emission format. It bounds each agent's draft length with an offline-profiled cap and adapts the length online from verification feedback. On two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks, AgSpec outperforms five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3 in most evaluated settings, raising generation throughput over autoregressive decoding up to 4.37$\times$ at batch size 1 and 4.76$\times$ at batch size 16. AgSpec also remains effective on benchmarks without a repository or a multi-agent pipeline, showing that its gains generalize to coding agents broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgSpec框架，通过提供检索语料库与草稿长度策略，弥补现有基于检索的推测解码方法在编码智能体流水线中的不足。AgSpec从会话、工作区、全局三类语料库检索，按智能体输出格式索引文件，并用离线分析上限与在线反馈自适应草稿长度。在仓库级多智能体编码基准上，性能超越五种基于检索的草稿器和EAGLE-3，batch size为1时吞吐量提升达4.37倍，batch size为16时达4.76倍。
AI.motivation: 基于检索的推测解码通过复制已有文本的后续内容来草拟token，适合反复复现代码、日志和先前尝试的编码智能体。但现有方法在智能体流水线中存在三大缺陷：可复用文本缺失于语料库，或存储形式与智能体实际输出不一致；草稿长度固定，忽视了接受长度在不同智能体间存在差异且随轮次漂移的问题。因此需要为现有检索引擎补齐语料库与草稿长度策略。
AI.method: AgSpec从会话、工作区、全局三类语料库进行检索，保留正在进行的会话轨迹，并以智能体输出格式索引已打开文件；对每个智能体的草稿长度设置离线分析得到的上限，并通过验证反馈在线自适应调整该长度。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级多智能体编码基准上，AgSpec在多数评估设置中优于五种基于检索的草稿器和EAGLE-3；batch size为1时生成吞吐量相对自回归解码最高提升4.37倍，batch size为16时最高提升4.76倍。在没有仓库或多智能体流水线的基准上同样有效，表明增益可泛化到更广泛的编码智能体场景。
AI.conclusion: AgSpec通过补全检索语料库与自适应草稿长度策略，显著提升了编码智能体流水线中推测解码的吞吐量，并具备跨场景的泛化能力。

title: Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

AI.tldr: 提出Model-Corrected World Model（MC-WM），通过划分目标数据并基于标准化校准风险选择“修正模拟器”或“直接拟合目标”的模型族，缓解MBRL从仿真到目标的模型选择问题。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习虽有模拟经验优势，但仿真到目标存在分布偏移，造成模型选择难题：修正模拟器与直接拟合目标在目标数据有限时均可能失效。
AI.method: MC-WM将初始目标数据划分为不相交的拟合、选择与校准子集，依据更低的标准化校准风险选择模型族；并利用学习到的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词对一步想象策略更新进行加权，而不改写物理奖励。
AI.result: 在三个受控MuJoCo偏移设置中共评估540个唯一报告运行单元；其中1个精确路由单元在部署前人工制品门控后重复执行，合计完成541次执行。
AI.conclusion: MC-WM为仿真到目标偏移下的模型选择提供了基于校准风险的决策机制，并通过有效性约束稳定想象策略更新；报告层面强调可复现与部署前验证。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出DynSC-Eval框架，动态追踪主体可见生命周期评估长视频生成的主体一致性，并基于其构建奖励进行后训练优化。
AI.motivation: 视频生成时长不断延长，传统主体一致性指标在长视频中失效，需要针对动态主体集合的评估方法。
AI.method: DynSC-Eval动态追踪合格主体，用6个对象级互补指标衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件；用注入不一致事件的合成实验验证灵敏度；基于该评估构建奖励，在自动驾驶场景用DiffusionNFT后训练，并通过课程学习扩展到10s/30s。
AI.result: 合成实验证明DynSC-Eval的灵敏度及现有指标的局限；在5s/15s/60s生成中揭示被常规指标掩盖的一致性差异；5s生成时6项指标平均降低13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）、5.66%（SANA-2B），I2V模型ReSim亦有提升；扩展到10s/30s仍有效且基本保持其他能力。
AI.conclusion: DynSC-Eval既可作为长视频主体一致性的有效评估工具，也可作为奖励信号驱动后训练，实现一致性优化且不损害其他生成能力。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Madeleine，将"记忆关联"视为可学习的相关性（记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息），通过离线 LLM 生活模拟器生成"提示-触发"对来训练查询编码器，在冻结的相似度之上学习残差关联，从而以零在线 LLM 调用实现摊销式关联记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 长期对话助手需要在恰当时机召回恰当记忆，但最重要的记忆往往与用户当前话语并不相似。现有系统依赖 LLM 在写入或读取时进行推理来恢复此类关联，代价是每个记忆库需数百至上千次 LLM 调用，且每次查询消耗数千上下文 token，成本高昂。
AI.method: 核心洞察是：关联是一种可学习的相关性，即记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息。Madeleine 学习"摊销式关联"（amortized association）：离线阶段，由 LLM 生活模拟器生成模拟人生，其中的线索-触发对（cue-trigger pairs）教会查询编码器在冻结的相似度之上学习一个残差关联；在线阶段不调用任何 LLM，并可通过仅替换查询编码器的方式接入任意向量记忆系统。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo-Plus 官方协议下：(I) 接入 HyperMem 时达 66.6，为该协议下所有评估系统中的最高分；(II) 单独使用时达到 HyperMem 发布版本水平（52.4 vs. 52.9），且零 LLM 调用、答案上下文约为其 1/21；(III) 使 T-Mem 提升 26.2 分，在两套系统中均显著优于相同的未训练骨干，并在 4B 骨干上保持普通问答能力不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 关联可作为相关性被摊销学习：Madeleine 用离线模拟数据训练轻量查询编码器，即可在无在线 LLM 调用、极低上下文开销下取得与重型 LLM 推理系统相当甚至更优的记忆检索性能，且具备良好的可插拔性与通用性。

title: What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?
summary: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个评估他者意识类比证据的因果框架，区分"意识生成因素相似性"与"下游行为/认知效应相似性"，并按因果相关性加权。应用于生物系统可解释类比支持随因果距离增大而减弱；应用于当代AI则表明行为相似对意识仅提供有限证据。
AI.motivation: 主观体验只能第一人称直接通达，因此对他人、动物乃至AI是否具有意识的判断部分依赖类比推理。历史上此类推断集中于非人动物，而AI的进展使"有意识AI"成为可能议题，亟需一套更严谨的评估标准来判断这些类比证据的强度。
AI.method: 构建一个因果框架来评估意识类比证据：核心区分在于（1）产生意识的相关因素的相似性，与（2）下游行为或认知效应的相似性。该框架按因果相关性对源—目标相似性进行加权，同时允许存在未知原因、使差异失效的情形以及通往意识的替代路径。
AI.result: 应用于生物系统时，该框架解释了为何类比支持通常随着与人类因果距离的增加而减弱；应用于当代AI时，它表明行为相似性只能为意识提供有限证据，因为相关的因果对应关系仍未被很好地确立。
AI.conclusion: 该框架同时阐明：何种证据能够增强关于人工意识的论断，从而为AI意识问题提供更具因果基础的评估路径，而非仅依赖表面行为相似。

title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层级高斯场（HierGF），从层级几何感知视角重构稀疏视图三维重建，将有限的观测转化为可靠的自生成监督，缓解多视图一致性差与欠采样区域结构缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图仅含有限三维信息，带来两大挑战：可用于匹配的图像过少，难以建立多视图一致性；视角覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失，出现结构缺失。现有方法多依赖有限的重投影误差与正则项，易过拟合单视图并造成跨视图外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，易产生模糊和结构空洞。
AI.method: 提出层级高斯场（HierGF），从层级几何感知视角处理稀疏视图重建，将有限观测转化为超越固定先验与启发式密度控制的可靠自生成监督。具体地，通过两阶段几何感知主干网络，将粗粒度三维几何信息与额外二维生成先验转化为结构化伪监督，从而在极少输入视图下增强多视图一致性；并引入可学习置信度网络，将梯度引导至跨视图一致的内容，以及几何一致的致密化模块，改善多视图对齐与欠采样区域的重建。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量结果，仅说明所提方法旨在增强极少输入视图下的多视图一致性，并改善多视图对齐及欠采样区域的重建效果。
AI.conclusion: HierGF 通过层级几何感知与自生成伪监督、可学习置信度引导及几何一致致密化，为稀疏视图三维重建中多视图一致性与欠采样区域结构完整性问题提供了新的解决思路。

title: Counting and Min-Cost Encoding for Tokenization in Large Language Models
summary: Mainstream large language models rely on a tokenizer to encode text into a token sequence. Different tokenizers may yield token sequences of substantially different lengths for the same text. With a fixed model architecture, shorter token sequences correspond to lower inference time. We propose a tokenizer training approach named Counting and Filtering (CNF) and a text encoding algorithm called Min-Cost Encoding (MCE). MCE defines a cost function over a text segment, and determines the best segmentation by globally minimizing the overall segmentation cost. CNF builds a raw vocabulary by directly counting valid substrings, and then constructs the final vocabulary through a filtering step based on actual token usage when segmenting the training corpus with MCE. The CNF-MCE conbination offers several advantages over BPE, including higher token efficiency, greater scalability, and lower dependency. Across six text categories and two vocabulary-size groups, CNF-MCE consistently achieves better compression than the evaluated BPE tokenizers. With a 250K vocabulary, CNF-MCE increases compression rate by 26% and 30% on English web text over the o200k_base and qwen250k tokenizers. Experiments scaling the vocabulary to 1M entries on English web text demonstrate sustained improvements over BPE, with a token efficiency improvement of over 60% and vocabulary utilization rising from 52.9% to 96.9%. The MCE algorithm does not depend on a merge list (as in BPE) or token probability (as in UnigramLM), making it applicable to a wide range of vocabularies, including those built from BPE, UnigramLM, CNF, and others. Language models trained from scratch at the 1.8B and 8B scales achieve comparable average performance to models using the BPE tokenizers across 11 benchmarks. These results demonstrate that CNF-MCE can improve token efficiency significantly while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 提出分词器训练方法 CNF 与文本编码算法 MCE，通过全局最小化分段成本构建词表并编码，显著提升压缩率与词表利用率，下游性能与 BPE 相当。
AI.motivation: 主流大模型依赖分词器将文本转为 token 序列，相同文本下不同分词器产生的序列长度差异明显；在固定模型架构下，更短的序列意味着更低的推理时间。因此需要一种能提升 token 效率、可扩展性更强且依赖更少的分词方案，以突破 BPE 的局限。
AI.method: 提出分词器训练方法 Counting and Filtering（CNF）与文本编码算法 Min-Cost Encoding（MCE）。MCE 在文本片段上定义成本函数，通过全局最小化整体分段成本确定最优切分；CNF 先直接统计有效子串构建原始词表，再用 MCE 切分训练语料、依据实际 token 使用量进行过滤，得到最终词表。MCE 不依赖 BPE 的 merge list 或 UnigramLM 的 token 概率。
AI.result: 在六个文本类别与两个词表规模组上，CNF-MCE 压缩率均优于所评估的 BPE 分词器；250K 词表下，英文网页文本压缩率相对 o200k_base 与 qwen250k 分别提升 26% 和 30%。词表扩至 1M 时仍持续优于 BPE，token 效率提升超 60%，词表利用率由 52.9% 升至 96.9%。从头训练的 1.8B 与 8B 模型在 11 个基准上平均性能与使用 BPE 分词器的模型相当。
AI.conclusion: CNF-MCE 能在保持竞争性下游性能的同时显著提升 token 效率，具备更高压缩率、更强可扩展性与更低依赖，并可适用于 BPE、UnigramLM、CNF 等多种词表来源。

title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
summary: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计决策模型Jev的置信度是否能区分"随机性不确定性"与"知识缺失"，发现其置信度在熟悉闭式任务上校准良好，但无法指示知识边界，且表面线索会干扰黑箱知识审计。
AI.motivation: 决策模型输出的概率常用于路由、弃权和自动执行，校准只保证平均意义上的可用性，却无法回答低置信度究竟源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法说明模型越出已知范围时置信度是否下降。作者希望审计这一区分。
AI.method: 以决策模型Jev为对象，使用15个以上公开数据集和6类生成任务族，并采用配对干预：对同一固定条目改变所提供的信息量。此外引入针对性的是/否问题（如结果是否已定、证据是否充分、模型是否知道答案）作为读出手段。
AI.result: Jev在熟悉的闭式选择任务上校准良好，但作为知识缺失指标失败：无答案相关信息时对显著选项给出高达0.80的置信度；在超出已观察知识边界的新闻上，置信度超出准确率0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重新校准无法弥合该差距。是/否问题给出更清晰的读出：结果是否已定AUROC 1.00，证据是否充分0.95（同一批条目上置信度仅0.85）；"模型是否知道答案"可在0.91上标记虚构实体与边界后新闻，但换成真实姓名或去掉日期后，相对答案不确定性无优势。
AI.conclusion: 黑箱知识审计必须对表面线索设置显式控制，不能仅依赖答案置信度来判断模型是否"知道"。

title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
summary: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究可微逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为，发现朴素宽度缩放会导致逻辑核冗余与性能饱和，并提出动态逻辑核框架以提升核利用率与多样性，从而在提高精度的同时改善参数效率。
AI.motivation: 可微逻辑门网络作为传统神经网络的高效替代方案备受关注，但其缩放行为（尤其是宽度缩放）尚未被充分探索。深度神经网络中扩大模型容量通常能提升性能，这一差异引出核心问题：逻辑门网络能否获得类似的缩放收益？作者发现朴素宽度缩放会引入逻辑核间的冗余，限制额外核的有效利用并导致性能饱和，因此需要新的方法来克服该瓶颈。
AI.method: 以宽度作为主要缩放轴进行系统分析。提出动态逻辑核（dynamic logic kernel）框架，通过促进核组间的专门化来重组核利用率，并借助输入依赖的核路由提升增加宽度的利用效率；同时保证路由与计算在推理阶段完全由门级布尔运算实现。此外，作者发现核冗余在第一层门级最为显著，据此提出早期阶段动态逻辑核策略，将自适应性集中于该层。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法提高了核利用率并增加了核多样性，在提升精度的同时改善了参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络的宽度缩放并非简单增大宽度即可获益，朴素缩峰会因核冗余导致性能饱和；通过引入动态逻辑核与输入依赖路由，并将适应性集中于早期门级，可有效利用增加宽度带来的容量，实现更高精度与更优参数效率。

title: BanglaDial-Abuse: A Corpus-Grounded Dataset for Regional Dialect Identification in Abusive Bangla Text
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Dataset Version 1.0 available on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23074319
summary: Regional linguistic variation remains an important challenge for Bangla natural language processing, particularly in informal and non-standard text. This paper introduces BanglaDial-Abuse, a balanced Bengali-script dataset developed for regional dialect identification in abusive and hostile Bangla text. The dataset contains 1,000 sentences distributed equally across four linguistic varieties: Standard Bangla, Chattagram, Sylhet, and Barishal, with 250 samples per class. The resource was constructed using a corpus-grounded synthetic procedure incorporating regional variation in pronouns, possessive forms, verb morphology, negation, interrogative structures, postpositions, vocabulary, and Bengali-script spelling conventions while preserving the underlying hostile or abusive meaning. Descriptive analysis shows broadly comparable sentence-length distributions but partially distinct lexical spaces across the four classes. Pairwise Jaccard vocabulary similarity ranges from 0.37 to 0.56. The primary task is four-class regional dialect identification rather than binary abusive-text detection. The dataset is publicly available through Zenodo under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. The current version is intended as a research and prototyping corpus rather than a native-speaker-validated gold-standard linguistic resource. Keywords: Bangla, Bengali, dialect identification, regional dialect, abusive language, low-resource NLP, Chattagram, Sylhet, Barishal, dataset

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BanglaDial-Abuse数据集，一个包含1000句、四类孟加拉语区域方言（标准孟加拉语、Chattagram、Sylhet、Barishal）各250句的平衡语料，用于辱骂性文本中的区域方言识别任务，采用语料库接地的合成方法构建，公开于Zenodo。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语自然语言处理中，区域语言变异仍是重要挑战，尤其在非正式与非标准文本中。现有资源缺乏针对辱骂/敌意文本的区域方言标注数据，因此需要构建专门的方言识别资源。
AI.method: 构建BanglaDial-Abuse数据集：共1000句，四类方言均分（每类250句）。采用语料库接地的合成方法，在代词、所有格形式、动词形态、否定、疑问结构、后置词、词汇及孟加拉文字拼写规范上引入区域变异，同时保留底层辱骂或敌意语义。主任务为四类区域方言识别。
AI.result: 描述性分析显示四类句长分布大致可比，但词汇空间存在部分差异；两两Jaccard词汇相似度为0.37至0.56。数据集通过Zenodo以CC BY 4.0许可公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集定位为研究与原型开发语料，而非经母语者验证的金标准语言资源；主任务为四类方言识别而非二元辱骂文本检测。

title: From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting
summary: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

AI.tldr: 该论文刻画了LLM多响应投票中"发现-决策缺口"：发现正确答案后仍需在剩余预算内积累足够票数才能获胜。作者给出可达性恢复阈值、候选转化窗口与精确有限期终点概率，并提出无金标准锁定的证书。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展与集成推理中常用对多个LLM响应投票。在固定调用预算下，多采样可扩大候选池、提高正确答案被发现的概率；但被发现的答案还须在剩余调用中获得足够支持才能成为相对多数赢家，二者之间存在"发现-决策缺口"，现有工作缺乏对该缺口的理论刻画。
AI.method: 以已实现的投票状态与剩余调用预算为状态变量进行刻画：推导尖锐的可恢复性阈值；证明随采样推进，观测候选集单调扩张而可达终点赢家集单调收缩，形成候选级转化窗口；在指定iid响应律下由同一状态给出精确有限期终点概率；分析错误答案身份合并对单次正确率与多数投票准确率的影响，以及错误答案概率重分配依赖于已实现投票状态；以单例可达性构造无金标准精确锁定证书，首次触发点定义为所有可行延续给出相同固定预算输出的最早前缀。
AI.result: 经验上，多数"已发现但未入选"的正确答案在发现之后才失去可达性。受控Word16实验中，输入置换使原始多数投票准确率提升21.1个百分点，而单次调用正确率基本不变。精确锁定在16次调用预算下节省28–30%的调用量，同时保持所有固定预算输出不变。
AI.conclusion: 论文将多响应投票的固定预算决策形式化为带状态的发现-决策问题，给出可恢复性阈值、转化窗口、精确终点概率与无金标准锁定证书，并通过实验验证输入置换带来的显著收益与精确锁定带来的调用节省。

title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
summary: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego2Act，一个面向目标导向的自我中心视频生成基准，包含 110 个真实任务、2,640 个视频，并配套无参考评测管线 Ego2ActJudge，揭示现有视频生成模型在多步物理推理与精细操作动态上的不足。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型被视为具身规划与学习的"世界模拟器"，但现有基准主要关注单步短动作或逐步指令，缺乏对多步物理推理的评估，尤其缺少需要规划多步真实操作以完成高层目标的自我中心视频生成评测。
AI.method: 构建 Ego2Act 基准：涵盖 110 个真实世界任务的 2,640 个视频，变化物体杂乱度与多步复杂度；任务设定为给定初始场景图像与高层目标，评估模型能否生成手部操作物体完成任务的真实自我中心视频。同时提出无参考评测管线 Ego2ActJudge，实现可扩展评测。
AI.result: Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成度与物理合理性评估上与人类共识的对齐优于相关基线。模型生成的仿真常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺失依赖状态、目标无法完成；在细粒度物理动态上持续失败，尤其是复杂物体操作与持久世界建模。
AI.conclusion: Ego2Act 为推进视频模型走向物理合理、目标导向的仿真提供了严格的测试平台。

title: My FAULT: Self-Diagnosis as Credit Assignment in Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for training large language model agents on multi-step tasks, yet reliance on terminal outcome rewards creates two credit-assignment problems, particularly in long-horizon tasks. First, same-outcome rollout groups provide no learning signal from terminal rewards. Second, terminal rewards provide only trajectory-wide feedback, making it difficult to identify which decisions caused a failure. Recent work supplements terminal rewards with finer-grained information from trajectory analysis, such as natural-language reflections on intermediate decisions and errors. However, natural-language diagnoses are difficult to use directly for credit assignment: their error claims may be unreliable, and they do not quantify how much each error should affect learning. We propose Self-Diagnosis-guided Terminal Credit Redistribution (FAULT), which turns diagnosed errors into explicit step-level credit anchored by terminal outcomes. FAULT checks diagnostic evidence and learns relative error costs from task outcomes. During training, the policy and self-diagnoser co-evolve, while error costs are updated online from recent outcomes. On ALFWorld, FAULT recovers learning signals from same-outcome groups, reaching 95% signal coverage versus 41% for GRPO and 72% for GiGPO, while better localizing credit to specific error steps. Across two model scales, FAULT delivers strong. improvements on the long-horizon ALFWorld and WebShop tasks while remaining competitive on short-horizon Search-based QA.

AI.tldr: 提出FAULT方法，将自诊断出的错误转化为由终端结果锚定的步级信用，解决长时程智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体强化学习依赖终端的整体结果奖励，产生两个信用分配问题：一是相同结果的轨迹组无法提供学习信号；二是终端奖励只能给出整条轨迹的反馈，难以定位导致失败的具体决策。近期工作引入自然语言反思等细粒度信息，但自然语言诊断存在错误主张不可靠、无法量化各错误对学习的影响程度等问题，难以直接用于信用分配。
AI.method: FAULT将诊断出的错误转化为以终端结果为锚的显式步级信用。它核查诊断证据，并从任务结果中学习相对错误代价。训练过程中，策略模型与自诊断器协同演化，错误代价则根据近期任务结果在线更新。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，FAULT能从相同结果的轨迹组中恢复学习信号，信号覆盖率达95%，而GRPO为41%、GiGPO为72%，同时能更好地将信用定位到具体错误步骤。在两种模型规模下，FAULT在长时程ALFWorld和WebShop任务上取得显著提升，在短时程的搜索类问答任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FAULT通过自诊断引导的终端信用再分配，有效缓解了长时程智能体强化学习中的信用分配瓶颈，既提升了学习信号覆盖度与错误定位精度，又在长短时程任务上取得良好性能。

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InFlowOp，用统一的"无标签成本"来度量多智能体工作流中每个决策：该成本同时权衡"智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度"和"智能体的运行开销"。构建阶段，InFlowOp 依据该成本双向决定任务分解粒度与智能体分配；执行阶段，用同一成本做最廉价的故障修正。此外提出 Braid 基准，在多领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相比单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%，结合 in-flow 优化达 +9.64%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体工作流构建面临三大难题：任务应分解多细、每个子任务该信任哪个智能体、何时新建专家智能体。这些决策必须在流程运行前敲定，而子任务是否成功要等运行后才知道。改进工作流代价高昂：定位故障通常需要参考答案、分级结果或训练好的评估器，且修复只能靠整流程重执行、重搜索或重训练，缺乏轻量、无标签的决策与修复机制。
AI.method: InFlowOp 将每个决策统一"定价"为一个无标签成本，同时衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度以及智能体的运行开销。执行前，它不再依赖固定模板，而是依照该成本双向决定任务分解的粒度与智能体分配；执行中，它同样借助这一统一成本，以代价最小的动作修正故障，使同一成本在构建与运行时贯穿使用。作者还提出 Braid 基准，其任务需要超出单智能体能力的多智能体协同。
AI.result: 在多种领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相比单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%；引入 in-flow 优化后可取得 +9.64% 的提升。其项目主页为：https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/。
AI.conclusion: InFlowOp 用一个无标签、可统一复用的成本信号，将多智能体工作流的"分解粒度—智能体分配—故障修复"三类关键决策统一到同一框架内，兼顾能力匹配与运行开销，并在跨领域、跨骨干的评测中稳定优于单智能体基线；配套的 Braid 基准为工作流级评估提供了需要多智能体协同的任务集合。

title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
summary: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MVDG，一个基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的多视图消歧框架，用于解决 3D 重建与视觉定位中视觉相似但几何不同的“二重身”表面误匹配问题，通过单次编解码多视图实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉相似但实际不同的 3D 表面之间的“二重身”误匹配是大规模野外 3D 重建与视觉定位的核心障碍。已有方法依赖成对分类器，限制了多视图上下文推理能力，并使下游 SfM 推理复杂度高达 O(n^2)，难以扩展。
AI.method: 1) 基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 构建多视图消歧框架 MVDG，可对任意数量视图联合推理；2) 引入 3D 感知的多视图特征，在单次编码-解码中完成视图处理，减少对成对比较的依赖；3) 针对噪声监督下直接微调 VGGT 不稳定的问题，受 Doppelgangers 标签歧义启发，从 AerialMegaDepth 构建伪成对训练集，并在采样子集上微调以获得稳定优化；4) 为降低完整 SfM 评估成本，构建伪成对数据集进行高效验证，并推导常规 SfM 指标与伪成对分类精度之间的预测关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在成对准确率上与基线相当，同时在 SfM 准确率和推理速度上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: MVDG 通过多视图联合推理与伪成对训练策略，有效缓解了二重身误匹配问题，实现了可扩展、高效且泛化性强的 3D 消歧；同时提出的伪成对验证方案为昂贵的 SfM 评估提供了高效替代途径。

title: HeadEdit: Calibrating Language Model Behavior Through the Frozen Unembedding Matrix
summary: Alignment does not eliminate behavioral errors in language models. Models may still refuse benign requests, call unnecessary tools, or yield to false user claims. Current methods mitigate such errors as a computation problem, and rarely explore if the desired behavior is already encoded in the model's representation. Motivated by the observation that behavior-relevant information remains linearly decodable from the final hidden state even when the resulting logits produce the undesired behavior, we introduce HeadEdit, a gradient-free method that calibrates model behavior through the unembedding matrix. HeadEdit extracts a low-rank behavioral subspace from paired completions and uses each prompt's coordinates within it to generate a vocabulary-wide correction, thereby implementing implicitly adaptive steering without manually specified target tokens or parameter updates. HeadEdit improves all nine experimental settings across three tasks and three model families, with negligible inference overhead and no systematic loss of general capabilities. It also reveals a connection to gradient-based alignment. HeadEdit's low-dimensional representation partly predicts how preference tuning changes output logits on unseen prompts. The subspace learned from the model can also be reused after tuning, improving performance without re-extracting or retuning. These results show that HeadEdit provides a practical, lightweight, and interpretable way to calibrate model behavior through the unembedding matrix.

AI.tldr: HeadEdit 是一种免梯度方法，通过 unembedding 矩阵校准模型行为：从配对完成中提取低秩行为子空间，用每个 prompt 在该子空间中的坐标生成全词表修正，实现隐式自适应引导，在三个任务、三个模型家族的九个设置上均取得改进，推理开销可忽略且不损失通用能力。
AI.motivation: 对齐并不能消除语言模型的行为错误（如拒绝良性请求、调用不必要工具、屈从错误用户主张）。现有方法多将此类错误视作计算问题加以缓解，很少探讨期望行为是否已编码在模型表示中。作者观察到：即便最终 logits 产生非期望行为，行为相关信息仍可从最终隐藏状态线性解码，因此希望利用这一表示特性来校准行为。
AI.method: HeadEdit 是免梯度方法，不更新参数、不手工指定目标 token。它从配对完成（paired completions）中提取低秩行为子空间，利用每个 prompt 在该子空间中的坐标生成全词表范围的修正（vocabulary-wide correction），通过 unembedding 矩阵实现隐式自适应引导（implicitly adaptive steering）。
AI.result: 在三个任务、三个模型家族的九个实验设置上全部取得改进；推理开销可忽略，无系统性通用能力损失。方法还揭示了与基于梯度的对齐之间的联系：其低维表示能部分预测偏好调优（preference tuning）在未见 prompt 上如何改变输出 logits；从模型中学到的子空间在调优后仍可复用，无需重新提取或重新调优即可提升性能。
AI.conclusion: HeadEdit 提供了一种实用、轻量且可解释的方式，通过 unembedding 矩阵校准模型行为，说明期望行为已部分编码于模型表示中，可用于行为校准、预测对齐效应及跨调优复用。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ICR（独立推理—通信—修订）受控框架，将多智能体通信评估重构为“在独立推理之后进行答案修订”的问题，从而分离通信、架构与额外推理的贡献，并区分纠错与破坏。
AI.motivation: 多智能体通信虽能提升系统性能，但性能提升的来源存在根本歧义：难以判断提升来自有效通信、有利的智能体架构，还是仅仅增加了推理量。由于通信方法通常在其原设计的系统中被评估，这些因素难以解耦；同时，最终准确率把“纠正的错误”与“被污染的正确回答”合并为单一结果，掩盖了通信如何改变决策。
AI.method: 提出ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise）受控框架，将通信评估为独立推理之后的答案修订。该框架固定初始推理轨迹，在两位智能体初始正确性条件下分别度量“纠正（correction）”与“保持（preservation）”，并引入“无消息修订”作为对照，以量化超出额外推理本身的增益。在四个推理基准上对文本通信与潜在通信进行审计，并在MedQA与GPQA-D上比较接收方策略（含结构化验证策略）。
AI.result: 在四个推理基准上，相似的总体准确率可能掩盖显著不同的修订行为。与仅传递答案相比，传递完整推理在全部四个基准上提高纠正率、降低保持率，说明更丰富的信息同时放大有益与有害影响。MedQA与GPQA-D上的接收方策略比较显示，结构化验证策略使各通道均转向更高的保持率与更低的纠正率，而其对“选择性（selectivity）”的影响因通道与任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了将通信质量视为通道内在属性的观点。ICR将评估重心重新聚焦于“选择性修订”，为考察消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与损害提供了统一框架。

title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
summary: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

AI.tldr: 提出仿射图集（affine-atlas）规范高斯表示，将规范高斯构建于更大的仿射对齐图集空间中，用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，可即插即用地提升大相机运动视频的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示通常将视频分解为规范高斯与时间变形模型。当视频存在相机运动等大幅全局运动时，规范表示与各帧之间产生错位，加重了时间变形模型的负担，导致重建质量下降。
AI.method: 在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯；在规范高斯构建之前，先通过逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，从而缩小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可直接集成到现有基于规范高斯的方法中，额外参数开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量，尤其在相机运动幅度较大的序列上效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局运动交由逐帧仿射变换建模，可有效缓解规范高斯与帧的错位问题，是一种通用、低成本的高斯视频表示增强方案。

title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
summary: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 提出DLIG方法，将积分梯度扩展至扩散语言模型的任意层与去噪步，用于token归因分析。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的机制分析需要廉价、可解释的归因工具，而现有干预式分析成本高，缺乏对层与去噪步维度的细粒度归因方法。
AI.method: DLIG将Integrated Gradients扩展到DLM的任意层和去噪步，对模型对自生成或固定补全的渐进承诺进行token归因，并建立其与IG完整性、实现不变性、线性、对称保持公理的对应关系。
AI.result: 在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子填空任务上验证，揭示了DLM如何跨位置、层和去噪步利用输入信息。
AI.conclusion: DLIG可作为干预式分析的低成本补充，为跨去噪轨迹的机制假设提供快速初检。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"空承诺"(empty commitment)概念,指聊天机器人在当前对话轮之后承诺执行某行动,但其工具或运行时中并无任何机制可实现该承诺,并给出形式化定义、失败类型与测量协议。
AI.motivation: 现有关于承诺与失信的研究通常依赖后续轨迹来判断承诺是否被履行,但有一类承诺的空洞性仅由智能体自身的配置决定,与后续行为无关。此类"空承诺"(如"我明天提醒你")在用户再次发消息前根本不会触发,却被系统性忽视。
AI.method: 在承诺语义(commitment semantics)基础上定义空承诺,划分三种失败类型;提出"锚定条件"(anchoring condition),用于判定某承诺是否能被某工具真正落实;构建回应层面的结果分类法;并设计测量协议:在五种逐步增加一项持久化能力的配置中运行随访请求,同时将环境设置为隐式或显式说明两种情形。
AI.result: 建立了空承诺的形式化界定与失败类型体系、判定承诺可落实性的锚定条件,以及回应层面的结果分类框架;并提出一套以"逐项增加持久化能力"为核心变量的测量协议。
AI.conclusion: 承诺的"空洞性"可作为智能体配置层面的固有属性被静态识别,而无需依赖后续轨迹;该框架与测量协议为评估对话智能体持久化能力的缺失提供了可操作的分析工具。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Optical-Character-Recognition-From-Handwritten-Bangla-Texts
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对手写孟加拉语单词识别，采用SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及二者集成模型，并改进非极大值抑制，在自建9841张图像数据集上取得最优F1值92.61%。
AI.motivation: OCR能自动提取文本并减轻人工负担，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠OCR方案，手写场景尤为困难；而单词识别是OCR流程中承上启下的关键阶段，其失败会拖累整体性能。
AI.method: 将手写孟加拉语单词识别建模为目标检测任务，使用三种模型（SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及二者集成）进行训练与测试；引入改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）优化检测结果；自建含9841张手写孟加拉语单词图像、涵盖多种书写风格的数据集。
AI.result: 三模型均在测试集评估，集成模型表现最佳，F1-score达92.61%；在单词级别上，集成模型能在一定程度上正确识别96.12%的单词。
AI.conclusion: 集成检测模型可有效识别手写孟加拉语单词，改进NMS带来性能提升；后续可通过引入后处理阶段纠正系统错误以进一步改善系统。

title: AGO AI Quality Gate: Evidence-First Release Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted version (pre-review). Accepted at NFMCP 2026, ECML PKDD 2026 Workshops
summary: Enterprises adopting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) face a recurring operational decision: promote, revise, or block a system version. The evidence is incomplete and the metrics come from fallible LLM judges. We report on AGO AI Quality Gate (AGO), an evidence-first quality-gate framework deployed in industrial RAG assessment engagements. AGO integrates four key components: a four-state decision model that treats missing data and judge errors as explicit outcomes; layered scoring combining deterministic checks, local guardrails, and structured LLM evaluation; a stratified beta-binomial gate that quantifies regression risk probabilistically; and a mandatory meta-evaluation protocol to validate the LLM judge before it influences decisions. Since engagement data is proprietary, we evaluate the judge layer on RAGBench, a public benchmark of 100k annotated RAG traces across 12 datasets. On identical stratified test samples (N=1200 per judge), a low-cost judge (gpt-4.1-nano) detects non-adherent answers barely above chance (AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]), despite producing flawless protocol output, while gpt-4o reaches 0.783 [0.756, 0.807] -- yet its per-domain performance still ranges from 0.62 to 0.88. A fixed-seed gate study spanning regression, no change, and improvement quantifies unsafe promotion, false-alarm cost, and improvement throughput. Under regression, the decision-grade profile reduces unsafe promotion to 22.2%-35.1%, against 29.3%-41.8% for a naive gate. These results support the design choices that judge quality must be measured per engagement and that point estimates alone are not a release decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGO AI质量门框架，面向工业RAG评估，通过四状态决策、分层评分、分层beta-binomial门控与强制元评估，将缺失数据与评估器错误显式建模，并在RAGBench上验证评估器需按场景测量、点估计不足以支撑发布决策。
AI.motivation: 企业部署RAG系统时需反复决定版本推广、修订或阻断，但证据不完整且指标来自易错的LLM评估器；单点指标无法作为可靠发布依据，需明确处理缺失数据与评估器误差。
AI.method: AGO框架包含四部分：四状态决策模型（将缺失数据与评估器错误作为显式结果）；分层评分（确定性检查、本地护栏、结构化LLM评估）；分层beta-binomial门控（概率化量化回归风险）；强制元评估协议（在评估器影响决策前验证其质量）。在RAGBench（12个数据集、10万条标注RAG轨迹）上对评估器层进行评估，使用相同分层测试样本（每评估器N=1200），并以固定种子进行回归、无变化、改进三类门控研究。
AI.result: 低成本评估器gpt-4.1-nano检测不遵循答案几乎仅略高于随机（AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]），尽管协议输出完美；gpt-4o达0.783 [0.756, 0.807]，但分域性能仍为0.62至0.88。回归场景下，决策级配置将不安全推广降至22.2%-35.1%，而朴素门控为29.3%-41.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持两项设计选择：评估器质量必须在每次评估中单独测量；仅依赖点估计不能作为发布决策，需结合概率门控与元评估。

title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
summary: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作条件网络世界模型（NWM），学习网络在干预下的扩散动力学，作为快速评估器嵌入代码智能体驱动的算法设计闭环，在八类网络任务、五种扩散模型上设计的算法于141个设置中的138个达到或超越最强基线，且推演速度最高提升14.5倍。
AI.motivation: 网络干预（如种子节点选择、免疫节点选择）的效果具有延迟性，单步动作影响有限，真正重要的是后续多步展开的结果；因此动作选择算法需迭代式地为候选动作打分，而基于蒙特卡洛仿真的结果评估在多轨迹采样下成本高昂，成为瓶颈。作者希望用可学习的网络世界模型替代仿真，实现快速、可用于算法设计闭环的结果预测。
AI.method: 1）构建动作条件网络世界模型（Action-conditioned Network World Model）：以网络为对象，学习其在时间上受干预影响的扩散动力学，将动作施加于网络后直接预测后续展开的结果（outcome）。2）将该世界模型作为快速评估器，嵌入由编码智能体（coding agent）驱动的算法设计循环中，智能体基于三类反馈设计并精炼可执行算法：完整 rollout 反馈、动作级 credit 反馈，以及针对替代干预的反事实探针（counterfactual probes）。
AI.result: 在八类网络任务与五种扩散模型上共141个实验设置中，所设计算法在138个设置上匹配或超越已报告的最强基线；同时相比蒙特卡洛仿真，rollout 速度最高提升14.5倍。代码将在论文录用后发布。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的动作条件网络世界模型能够以远低于蒙特卡洛仿真的成本提供可靠的干预结果预测，配合智能体驱动的算法设计闭环，可自动生成在广泛网络任务上达到或超过强基线的干预算法，为高成本仿真下的算法发现提供了高效范式。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.tldr: RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建了RSNA-ICA数据集，包含来自12国21家机构4278名成年患者的7202例CTA/MRA/MRI序列，用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛，推动AI动脉瘤检测算法的发展与评估。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂具有高发病率和高死亡率，但动脉瘤检测仍具挑战性，尤其是小病灶及常规非血管造影影像检查。为支持和评估AI动脉瘤检测与定位算法，需要大规模、专家标注的公开数据集。
AI.method: RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR共同策划了RSNA-ICA数据集，纳入12个国家21家机构的7202例CTA、MRA和MRI序列（分别2566、2166、2470例），来自4278名成年患者，包含有和无颅内囊状动脉瘤病例。专家标注包含动脉瘤有无及位置信息，其中178例序列额外提供三维分割。该数据集用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛的算法开发与评估。
AI.result: 数据集具备显著的地理与影像多样性；7202例序列中5041例通过MIRA公开，其余用于挑战赛公开与私有测试集；数据集免费供研究社区非商业使用。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA为推进基于AI的动脉瘤检测提供了全面资源，覆盖血管造影与常规神经影像检查，有助于提升动脉瘤检测算法的发展与评估。

title: ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation
summary: Automatic SOAP note generation can ease the documentation burden on physicians, but existing reasoning methods often omit clinically important information and generate unsupported content. Progress in Thai is further hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets. We propose ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that ascribes a clinical-significance level to each extracted atomic fact in the conversation before summarization, making a general-purpose LLM a more reliable scribe. We also release ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark of real encounters, together with a synthetic training corpus derived from real clinical notes. As a prompt, ASCRIBE outperforms chain-of-thought prompting on GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro across the physician-aligned LLM-judge metrics and improves on standard prompting by up to 10.3 points on the completeness LLM-judge metric. As a GRPO reward, it enables a Gemma-4-E4B model trained solely on synthetic data to match Gemini 3.1 Pro in factual precision and surpass it in completeness. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASCRIBE——一个受医生启发的推理框架，通过对对话中每个原子事实赋予临床重要性等级，提升自动 SOAP 病历生成质量；同时发布首个去标识化的泰语真实临床摘要基准 ThaiClinicBench 及合成训练语料。
AI.motivation: 自动生成 SOAP 病历可减轻医生文书负担，但现有推理方法常遗漏临床重要信息并生成缺乏依据的内容；泰语领域还因缺乏公开数据集而发展受限。
AI.method: ASCRIBE 在摘要前对从对话中抽取的每个原子事实赋予临床重要性等级，使通用 LLM 成为更可靠的医疗记录员；该框架既可作为提示词使用，也可作为 GRPO 奖励信号。同时发布 ThaiClinicBench 基准及由真实临床记录衍生的合成训练语料。
AI.result: 作为提示词，ASCRIBE 在 GPT-5.4 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 上于医生对齐的 LLM 评判指标上优于思维链提示，在完整性指标上较标准提示提升最高达 10.3 分。作为 GRPO 奖励，仅用合成数据训练的 Gemma-4-E4B 在事实精确度上追平 Gemini 3.1 Pro，并在完整性上超越之。
AI.conclusion: 受医生启发的临床重要性分级推理可同时作为提示策略与强化学习奖励，在提升 SOAP 病历生成可靠性的同时，为泰语临床摘要提供首个公开基准与数据资源。

title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

AI.tldr: 提出 APIVIS 训练框架，将有限预算的 Gumbel 搜索适配到分块级数学推理，通过混合直接与搜索响应并选择性监督搜索改进的 token，缓解 GRPO 奖励均一化问题，并给出价值引导选择的期望奖励提升保证。
AI.motivation: RLVR 提升了大型语言模型的数学推理能力，近期工作将搜索引入 RLVR rollout 以增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身并不能保证搜索诱导的 rollout 策略优于当前策略，存在策略改进无保证的空白。
AI.method: APIVIS 是一个训练时框架：将有限预算 Gumbel 搜索适配到 chunk 级数学推理；在每个 rollout 组内混合直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索带来的改进产生有信息量的相对奖励；对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，在组内奖励均一导致 GRPO 失效时保留学习信号。
AI.result: 理论上证明精确价值引导选择在每个被搜索状态提升期望验证器奖励，并将该保证扩展到完整 rollout 策略，在有界价值估计误差下给出近似保证；在广泛认可的数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，相较竞争性搜索类方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: APIVIS 通过混合 rollout 与选择性监督有效利用搜索改进信号，理论保证与实验结果共同验证了其在数学推理 RLVR 中的有效性。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: OptimusMesh 提出用稀疏潜在枢轴（pivots）条件化的两阶段自回归框架，直接从点云生成紧凑的三角网格。
AI.motivation: 点云无序且稀疏，网格结构不规则且拓扑多变，直接生成困难；现有方法多依赖隐式表示再表面提取或重建，易产生稠密或过度平滑的网格，且需昂贵的后处理与简化。
AI.method: 将 2,048 个带方向输入点压缩为仅 16 个稀疏潜在枢轴，几何条件集缩小 128 倍；这些枢轴作为共享的紧凑结构表示，驱动两阶段自回归框架：先生成网格顶点，再基于生成顶点与同一枢轴预测三角面片。
AI.result: 相比被评估的近期点云条件自回归方法（使用 257 个解码器条件 token），OptimusMesh 仅用 16 个，条件序列缩短 16.1 倍；在对比方法中输出最紧凑，面片数减少 25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏潜在枢轴条件化为点云到紧凑网格的直接生成提供了高效方案，在大幅降低条件序列长度与面片数的同时维持几何质量。

title: Harness Annealing: Learning to Act with Less External Control
